return rows < cur.stats.rowCount - 1e-9;","     }"," }"]}],"originalFile":"package joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 两阶段：\n *  阶段1 —— 每个连通分量内部，标准 Selinger 风格枚举：\n *      dp[mask] = 该连通表集合上代价最小的计划\n *      只在“有连接边跨越分割”时组合两个子集（分量内不允许笛卡尔积）。\n *      复杂度 O(3^n)（n<=8 时很小）。\n *  阶段2 —— 分量之间只能做笛卡尔积，再次 DP 决定合并顺序，并在计划上标记\n *      cartesian=true。笛卡尔积标记是语义提示：分量间没有等值条件。\n *\n * 注：分量内之所以能安全排除笛卡尔积，是因为本代价模型下\n *     cost(A ⋈_true B) >= cost 最优连通计划（见 README 证明/测试 BruteForce）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n        int total = 1 << n;\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> base = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            base.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        // 阶段1：每个连通分量内 DP（共用一张 memo，键为表掩码）\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        long considered = 0;\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n        for (int comp : masksOf(comps)) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(comp) <= 1) continue;\n            // 枚举该分量的所有非空真子集\n            int sub = (comp - 1) & comp;\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = comp ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)) {\n                    List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                    if (!cross.isEmpty()) {\n                        considered++;\n                        OptEntry a = memo.get(sub);\n                        OptEntry b = memo.get(rest);\n                        considerCombine(memo, sub, rest, a, b, cross);\n                    }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & comp;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 阶段2：分量间笛卡尔积\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        if (comps.size() > 1) {\n            r.disconnected = true;\n            // componentMask -> entry\n            int[] compMasks = masksOf(comps);\n            Map<Integer, OptEntry> compDp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int c : compMasks) compDp.put(c, memo.get(c));\n\n            int compFull = full;\n            int compUniverse = 0;\n            for (int c : compMasks) compUniverse |= c;\n            int sub = (compUniverse - 1) & compUniverse;\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = compUniverse ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                        && isUnionOfComponents(sub, compMasks)\n                        && isUnionOfComponents(rest, compMasks)) {\n                    considered++;\n                    OptEntry a = compDp.get(sub);\n                    OptEntry b = compDp.get(rest);\n                    if (a != null && b != null) {\n                        considerCombine(memo, sub, rest, a, b, new ArrayList<>());\n                        if (compDp.containsKey(sub)) {\n                            // memo 已含；同步 compDp\n                        }\n                        compDp.put(sub | rest, memo.get(sub | rest));\n                    }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & compUniverse;\n            }\n        }\n\n        OptEntry best = memo.get(full);\n        if (best == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n\n        countCartesian(best.plan, r);\n        r.plan = best.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，存在 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"，分量间将使用笛卡尔积连接\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean isUnionOfComponents(int mask, int[] comps) {\n        for (int c : comps) {\n            if ((mask & c) == c) mask &= ~c;\n            else if ((mask & c) != 0) return false;\n        }\n        return mask == 0;\n    }\n\n    private int[] masksOf(List<int[]> comps) {\n        int[] r = new int[comps.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {\n            int m = 0;\n            for (int t : comps.get(i)) m |= 1 << t;\n            r[i] = m;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    /** 比较一次 (A ⋈ B) 组合，若更优则写入 memo。 */\n    private void considerCombine(Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo,\n                                 int leftMask, int rightMask,\n                                 OptEntry a, OptEntry b, List<Edge> cross) {\n        if (a == null || b == null) return;\n        Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(leftMask, rightMask, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n        double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n        int key = leftMask | rightMask;\n        OptEntry cur = memo.get(key);\n        if (cur == null || better(cost, s.rowCount, a, b, cur)) {\n            JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n            j.estimated = s;\n            j.estimatedCost = cost;\n            OptEntry e = new OptEntry(key, j, s, cost);\n            memo.put(key, e);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 确定性平局打破：代价相等时，输出行数小者优先；再相同则表掩码字典序。\n     * （相同 (mask) 下子计划顺序由枚举 sub<rest 保证确定。）\n     */\n    private boolean better(double cost, double rows, OptEntry a, OptEntry b, OptEntry cur) {\n        if (cost < cur.cost - 1e-9) return true;\n        if (cost > cur.cost + 1e-9) return false;\n        if (rows < cur.stats.rowCount - 1e-9) return true;\n        return false;\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"1af0ded2-9779-4301-9d0b-b6a41d66d81f","session_id":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/a","sessionId":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-a","slug":"validated-singing-puddle"}

i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            memo.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        long considered = 0;\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n\n        // 阶段1：分量内稠密 DP\n        for (int compMask : componentMasks(comps)) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(compMask) <= 1) continue;\n            int sub = (compMask - 1) & compMask; // 非空真子集，跳过空集\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = compMask ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                        && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)) {\n                    List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                    if (!cross.isEmpty()) {\n                        considered++;\n                        combine(memo, sub, rest, cross);\n                    }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & compMask;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 阶段2：分量间笛卡尔积 DP（以“分量”为原子单位）\n        if (comps.size() > 1) {\n            int[] cms = componentMasks(comps);\n            int compUniverse = 0;\n            for (int c : cms) compUniverse |= c;\n\n            // 按 popcount 递增枚举分量并集\n            List<Integer> unions = new ArrayList<>();\n            int k = 1;\n            while (k <= compUniverse) {\n                if ((k & ~compUniverse) == 0 && (k & compUniverse) == k\n                        && isUnionOfComponents(k, cms)) {\n                    unions.add(k);\n                }\n                k++;\n            }\n            // unions 天然按整数升序，而 popcount 不单调；按 popcount 排序保证子问题已解\n            unions.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n            Map<Integer, OptEntry> compDp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int c : cms) compDp.put(c, memo.get(c));\n\n {\n                            considered++;\n                            Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, new ArrayList<>());\n                            double cost = best.stats.rowCount)) {\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, new ArrayList<>());\n                                j.estimated = s;\n = (sub - 1) & u;\n                }\n                if (best != null) {\n                    compDp.put(u, best);\n                    memo.put(u, best);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        OptEntry top = memo.get(full);\n        if (top == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean isUnionOfComponents(int mask, int[] comps) {\n        for (int c : comps) {\n            if ((mask & c) == c) mask &= ~c;\n            else if ((mask & c) != 0) return false;\n        }\n        return mask == 0;\n    }\n\n    private int[] componentMasks(List<int[]> comps) {\n        int[] r = new int[comps.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {\n            int m = 0;\n            for (int t : comps.get(i)) m |= 1 << t;\n            r[i] = m;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    /** 比较一次 (A ⋈ B)，更优则写入 memo。 */\n    private void combine(Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo,\n                         int leftMask, int rightMask, List<Edge> cross) {\n        OptEntry a = memo.get(leftMask);\n        OptEntry b = memo.get(rightMask);\n        if (a == null || b == null) return;\n        Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(leftMask, rightMask, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n        double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n        int key = leftMask | rightMask;\n for (int mask = 1; mask < total; mask++) {\n            OptEntry cur = dp.get(mask);\n            if (cur == null) continue;\n            int remaining = model.fullMask() ^ mask;\n            int bits }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 左深连接顺序优化器（对照基线）。\n *\n * 状态 = 已经接入的表集合；每次只能把“一张”新表放到右侧与当前整棵左深树连接。\n * 新表必须通过连接边与当前集合相连（当前集合内不做笛卡尔积）；\n * 连接图断开时，不同分量之间的接入点同样是笛卡尔积并予以标记。\n *\n * 复杂度 O(n·2^n)，结果用于和稠密 DP 对比、展示稠密计划的优势。\n */\npublic final class LeftDeepOptimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public LeftDeepOptimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        int n = model.n();\n        int total = 1 << n;\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        long considered = 0;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            dp.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        for (int mask = 1; mask < total; mask++) {\n            OptEntry cur = dp.get(mask);\n            if (cur == null) continue;\n            int remaining = model.fullMask() ^ mask;\n            int bits = remaining;\n            while (bits != 0) {\n                int bit = bits & -bits;\n                int ti = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);\n                int rightMask = bit;\n                List<Edge> cross = edgesFromMaskToTable(mask, ti);\n                considered++;\n                Stats rs = Optimizer.baseStats(model, ti, useProvided);\n                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(mask, rightMask, cur.stats, rs, cross);\n                double cost = cm.joinCost(cur.cost, rs.rowCount, s);\n                int key = mask | bit;\n                OptEntry existing = dp.get(key);\n                ScanNode rightScan = (ScanNode) dp.get(bit).plan;\n                if (existing == null || cost < existing.cost - 1e-9\n                        || (Math.abs(cost - existing.cost) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < existing.stats.rowCount)) {\n                    JoinNode j = new JoinNode(cur.plan, rightScan, edgeIds(cross));\n                    j.estimated = s;\n                    j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                    dp.put(key, new OptEntry(key, j, s, cost));\n                }\n                bits ^= bit;\n            }\n        }\n\n        OptEntry top = dp.get(model.fullMask());\n        if (top == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：左深规划失败\");\n        Result r = new Result();\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = dp;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        int[] cj = {0};\n        countCj(top.plan, cj);\n        r.cartesianJoins = cj[0];\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private List<Edge> edgesFromMaskToTable(int mask, int tableIdx) {\n        List<Edge> r = new ArrayList<>();\n        int bits = mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int bit = bits & -bits;\n            int other = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);\n            Edge e = model.edgeBetween(other, tableIdx);\n            if (e != null) r.add(e);\n            bits ^= bit;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private void countCj(PlanNode p, int[] c) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) c[0]++;\n            countCj(j.left, c);\n            countCj(j.right, c);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"cba09586-a1b0-45d4-afd8-ae1a17c300cb","session_id":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/a","sessionId":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-a","slug":"validated-singing-puddle"}

joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 暴力枚举：对每个表集合递归枚举“全部合法二叉计划”，与 DP 的最小估计代价比对。\n *\n * 合法计划 = 任意把表集合分成两个非空子集，各取一个最优子计划，\n * 之间若有连接边则按等值连接、无连接边则按笛卡尔积。\n * 因此它枚举的空间完整覆盖稠密 DP 和左深 DP；树的数量为 Wedderburn-Etherington\n * 意义上的非排序二叉树乘组合数，n=6 为 2700 量级，n=7 起设上限保护。\n *\n * 代价模型与 {@link CostModel} 完全一致（同一实现），因此：\n *   若枚举全集允许笛卡尔积后的最小代价 == 稠密 DP 的代价，\n *   就直接验证了“分量内排除笛卡尔积不改变最优值”。\n */\npublic final class BruteForce {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    private double[] bestCost;\n    private double[] bestRows;\n    private long trees;\n    private long limit;\n    private boolean capped;\n\n    public BruteForce(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided, long maxTrees) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n        this.limit = maxTrees;\n    }\n\n    public static final class Report {\n        public boolean run;\n        public boolean capped;\n        public long treesEnumerated;\n        public double minCost;\n        public double topRows;\n        public int tables;\n    }\n\n    public Report enumerate() {\n        int n = model.n();\n        int total = 1 << n;\n        bestCost = new double[total];\n        bestRows = new double[total];\n        trees = 0;\n        capped = false;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            int mask = 1 << i;\n            bestCost[mask] = cm.scanCost(s);\n            bestRows[mask] = s.rowCount;\n            trees++;\n        }\n        solve(model.fullMask());\n\n        Report rep = new Report();\n        rep.run = !capped;\n        rep.capped = capped;\n        rep.treesEnumerated = trees;\n        rep.minCost = bestCost[model.fullMask()];\n        rep.topRows = bestRows[model.fullMask()];\n        rep.tables = n;\n        return rep;\n    }\n\n    /** 递归计算 mask 的全部计划中的最小（代价, 输出行数）。 */\n    private void solve(int mask) {\n        if (bestCost[mask] != 0 || Integer.bitCount(mask) == 1) return;\n        double bc = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        double br = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                solve(sub);\n                solve(rest);\n                if (!capped) {\n                    // 两侧计划组合数 ~ 2；对全集根节点的每种分割计为枚举到的计划\n                    trees++;\n                    if (trees > limit) { capped = true; return; }\n                    List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                    Stats ls = statsForBest(sub);\n                    Stats rs = statsForBest(rest);\n                    Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, ls, rs, cross);\n                    double cost = cm.joinCost(bestCost[sub], bestCost[rest], s);\n                    if (cost < bc - 1e-9\n                            || (Math.abs(cost - bc) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < br)) {\n                        bc = cost;\n                        br = s.rowCount;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            sub = (sub - 1) & mask;\n        }\n        bestCost[mask] = bc;\n        bestRows[mask] = br;\n    }\n\n    /** 为已求出最优值的 mask 构造与最优子计划一致的统计（按最优值重算）。 */\n    private Stats statsForBest(int mask) {\n        if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == 1) {\n            int i = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n            return Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n        }\n        // 找到达到 bestCost 的分割，复算统计\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, statsForBest(sub), statsForBest(rest), cross);\n                double cost = cm.joinCost(bestCost[sub], bestCost[rest], s);\n                if (Math.abs(cost - bestCost[mask]) <= 1e-9) return s;\n            }\n            sub = (sub - 1) & mask;\n        }\n        throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：暴力枚举无法重建统计\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_6606dac5c7b5fa2ef97338f0","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1414,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":60216,"output_tokens":1486,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_q1kdkxwuvhhig1yh377h6nbp":{"content":"package 该空间完整覆盖稠密 DP 与左深 DP。无序二叉计划数（仅按拓扑结构，忽略统计差异）\n * 按 t(S)=Σ_{A⊊S} t(A)·t(S\\\\A)（去重对称分割）递归计算：\n *   n=1..7 约为 1,1,4,26,236,2752,39208；故默认枚举上限放在 n=6。\n *\n * 最小代价可用最优子结构（记忆化）求出——这本身是 DP 的朴素实现；\n * 关键区别是它不做“分量内排除笛卡尔积”的剪枝，所以验证了该剪枝不改变最优值。\n */\npublic final class BruteForce {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    private double[] bestCost;\n    private double[] bestRows;\n    private long[] count;          // 每个子问题里合法计划的数量\n    private long totalTrees;\n    private long limit;\n    private boolean capped;\n\n    public BruteForce(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided, long maxTrees) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n        this.limit = maxTrees;\n    }\n\n    public static final class Report {\n        public boolean run;\n        public boolean capped;\n        public long planCount;\n        public double minCost;\n        public double topRows;\n        public int tables;\n        public List<String> optimalSplits = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Report enumerate() {\n        int total = 1 << model.n();\n        bestCost = new double[total];\n        bestRows = new double[total];\n        count = new long[total];\n        capped = false;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < model.n(); i++) {\n            int mask = 1 << i;\n            Stats s = Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            bestCost[mask] = cm.scanCost(s);\n            bestRows[mask] = s.rowCount;\n            count[mask] = 1;\n        }\n        double minCost = solve(model.fullMask());\n\n        Report rep = new Report();\n        rep.run = !capped;\n        rep.capped = capped;\n        rep.planCount = totalTrees;\n        rep.minCost = minCost;\n        rep.topRows = bestRows[model.fullMask()];\n        rep.tables = model.n();\n        rep.optimalSplits = traceOptimal(model.fullMask(), 0);\n        return rep;\n    }\n\n    /** 返回 mask 上的最小代价；顺带计算计划数，超上限即标记 capped 并放弃。 */\n    private double solve(int mask) {\n        if (count[mask] != 0) return bestCost[mask];\n\n        double bc = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        double br = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        long cnt = 0;\n\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                double ca = solve(sub);\n                double cb = solve(rest);\n                if (capped) return Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n\n                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, statsForBest(sub), statsForBest(rest),\n                        model.crossingEdges(sub, rest));\n                double cost = cm.joinCost(ca, cb, s);\n                if (cost < bc - 1e-9 || (Math.abs(cost - bc) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < br)) {\n                    bc = cost;\n                    br = s.rowCount;\n                }\n                long ways = }\n            sub = (sub - 1) & mask;\n        }\n        bestCost[mask] = bc;\n        bestRows[mask] = br;\n        count[mask] = cnt;\n        return bc;\n    }\n\n    private Stats statsForBest(int mask) {\n        if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == 1) {\n            return Optimizer.baseStats(model, Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask), useProvided);\n        }\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, statsForBest(sub), java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 暴力枚举：对每个表集合递归枚举“全部合法二叉计划”，与 DP 的最小估计代价比对。\n *\n * 合法计划 = 任意把表集合分成两个非空子集，各取一个最优子计划，\n * 之间若有连接边则按等值连接、无连接边则按笛卡尔积。\n * 因此它枚举的空间完整覆盖稠密 DP 和左深 DP；树的数量为 Wedderburn-Etherington\n * 意义上的非排序二叉树乘组合数，n=6 为 2700 量级，n=7 起设上限保护。\n *\n * 代价模型与 {@link CostModel} 完全一致（同一实现），因此：\n *   若枚举全集允许笛卡尔积后的最小代价 == 稠密 DP 的代价，\n *   就直接验证了“分量内排除笛卡尔积不改变最优值”。\n */\npublic final class BruteForce {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    private double[] bestCost;\n    private double[] bestRows;\n    private long trees;\n    private long limit;\n    private boolean capped;\n\n    public BruteForce(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided, long maxTrees) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n        this.limit = maxTrees;\n    }\n\n    public static final class Report {\n        public boolean run;\n        public boolean capped;\n        public long treesEnumerated;\n        public double minCost;\n        public double topRows;\n        public int tables;\n    }\n\n    public Report enumerate() {\n        int n = model.n();\n        int total = 1 << n;\n        bestCost = new double[total];\n        bestRows = new double[total];\n        trees = 0;\n        capped = false;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            int mask = 1 << i;\n            bestCost[mask] = cm.scanCost(s);\n            bestRows[mask] = s.rowCount;\n            trees++;\n        }\n        solve(model.fullMask());\n\n        Report rep = new Report();\n        rep.run = !capped;\n        rep.capped = capped;\n        rep.treesEnumerated = trees;\n        rep.minCost = bestCost[model.fullMask()];\n        rep.topRows = bestRows[model.fullMask()];\n        rep.tables = n;\n        return rep;\n    }\n\n    /** 递归计算 mask 的全部计划中的最小（代价, 输出行数）。 */\n    private void solve(int mask) {\n        if (bestCost[mask] != 0 || Integer.bitCount(mask) == 1) return;\n        double bc = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        double br = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                solve(sub);\n                solve(rest);\n                if (!capped) {\n                    // 两侧计划组合数 ~ 2；对全集根节点的每种分割计为枚举到的计划\n                    trees++;\n                    if (trees > limit) { capped = true; return; }\n                    List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                    Stats ls = statsForBest(sub);\n                    Stats rs = statsForBest(rest);\n                    Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, ls, rs, cross);\n                    double cost = cm.joinCost(bestCost[sub], bestCost[rest], s);\n                    if (cost < bc - 1e-9\n                            || (Math.abs(cost - bc) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < br)) {\n                        bc = cost;\n                        br = s.rowCount;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            sub = (sub - 1) & mask;\n        }\n        bestCost[mask] = bc;\n        bestRows[mask] = br;\n    }\n\n    /** 为已求出最优值的 mask 构造与最优子计划一致的统计（按最优值重算）。 */\n    private Stats statsForBest(int mask) {\n        if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == 1) {\n            int i = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n            return Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n        }\n        // 找到达到 bestCost 的分割，复算统计\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, statsForBest(sub), statsForBest(rest), cross);\n                double cost = cm.joinCost(bestCost[sub], bestCost[rest], s);\n                if (Math.abs(cost - bestCost[mask]) <= 1e-9) return s;\n            }\n            sub = (sub - 1) & mask;\n        }\n        throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：暴力枚举无法重建统计\");\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"34c8bc17-ab60-4340-a8b2-4d786a720dd3","session_id":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/a","sessionId":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-a","slug":"validated-singing-puddle"}

joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 单机内存执行器：真正执行优化器产生的计划。\n *\n *   hash-join      在等值键上构建 HashMap（支持一条边上的多个等值条件，键为组合键）\n *   cartesian-join 嵌套循环（无连接条件，语义为 R × S）\n *\n * 执行后自底向上回填每个节点的实际行数、实际列 NDV 与“实际累计代价”，\n * 以便对照优化器的估计值。实际代价口径与估计一致：Σ(子代价) + 本节点输出行数。\n */\npublic final class Executor {\n\n    /** 执行中间结果：行 + 真实统计。 */\n    public static final class Result {\n        public final List<Map<String, Object>> rows;\n        public final Stats stats;\n        public Result(List<Map<String, Object>> rows, Stats stats) {\n            this.rows = rows;\n            this.stats = stats;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private final Model model;\n\n    public Executor(Model model) {\n        this.model = model;\n    }\n\n    public Result execute(PlanNode plan) {\n        if (plan instanceof ScanNode) return scan((ScanNode) plan);\n        if (plan instanceof JoinNode) return join((JoinNode) plan);\n        throw new EngineException(\"未知计划节点: \" + plan.getClass());\n    }\n\n    private Result scan(ScanNode n) {\n        Table t = model.table(n.tableIdx);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>(t.rows.size());\n        for (Map<String, Object> r : t.rows) out.add(new LinkedHashMap<>(r));\n        Stats s = t.actualStats.copy();\n        n.actual = s;\n        n.actualCost = s.rowCount;\n        return new Result(out, s);\n    }\n\n    private Result join(JoinNode n) {\n        Result lr = execute(n.left);\n        Result rr = execute(n.right);\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out;\n        if (n.edgeIds.isEmpty()) {\n            out = nestedLoop(lr.rows, rr.rows);\n        } else {\n            List<EqPredicate> preds = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Edge e : n.edges(model)) preds.addAll(e.predicates);\n            out = hashJoin(lr, rr, preds, n.left.mask, n.right.mask);\n        }\n\n        Stats s = computeActualStats(out, n.mask);\n        n.actual = s;\n        n.actualCost = n.left.actualCost + n.right.actualCost + s.rowCount;\n        return new Result(out, s);\n    }\n\n    private List<Map<String, Object>> nestedLoop(List<Map<String, Object>> left,\n                                                 List<Map<String, Object>> right) {\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>(left.size() * right.size());\n        for (Map<String, Object> l : left) {\n            for (Map<String, Object> r : right) {\n                Map<String, Object> merged = new LinkedHashMap<>(l);\n                merged.putAll(r);\n                out.add(merged);\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private List<Map<String, Object>> hashJoin(Result lr, Result rr,\n                                               List<EqPredicate> preds,\n                                               int leftMask, int rightMask) {\n        // 构建端取较小的一侧\n        boolean buildLeft = lr.rows.size() <= rr.rows.size();\n        Result build = buildLeft ? lr : rr;\n        Result probe = buildLeft ? rr : lr;\n        int buildMask = buildLeft ? leftMask : rightMask;\n\n        // 键计算：每个谓词在构建侧的列值\n        List<ColumnRef> buildKeys = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnRef> probeKeys = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (EqPredicate p : preds) {\n            ColumnRef bc = p.columnOnSide(buildMask, model);\n            int otherMask = buildMask == leftMask ? rightMask : leftMask;\n            ColumnRef pc = p.columnOnSide(otherMask, model);\n            if (bc == null || pc == null) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：连接谓词与计划两侧不匹配: \" + p);\n            }\n            buildKeys.add(bc);\n            probeKeys.add(pc);\n        }\n\n        Map<List<Object>, List<Map<String, Object>>> table = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : build.rows) {\n            List<Object> key = keyOf(row, buildKeys);\n            // null 不参与等值连接（SQL 三值逻辑；本引擎按“无匹配”处理）\n            if (containsNull(key)) continue;\n            table.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(row);\n        }\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Map<String, Object> prow : probe.rows) {\n            List<Object> key = keyOf(prow, probeKeys);\n            if (containsNull(key)) continue;\n            List<Map<String, Object>> matches = table.get(key);\n            if (matches == null) continue;\n            for (Map<String, Object> brow : matches) {\n                Map<String, Object> merged;\n                if (buildLeft) {\n                    merged = new LinkedHashMap<>(brow);\n                    merged.putAll(prow);\n                } else {\n                    merged = new LinkedHashMap<>(prow);\n                    merged.putAll(brow);\n                }\n                out.add(merged);\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private List<Object> keyOf(Map<String, Object> row, List<ColumnRef> keys) {\n        List<Object> k = new ArrayList<>(keys.size());\n        for (ColumnRef c : keys) k.add(row.get(c.column));\n        return k;\n    }\n\n    private boolean containsNull(List<Object> key) {\n        for (Object o : key) if (o == null) return true;\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    /** 从实际输出行计算行数与各列 NDV（列按 表名.列名 规范键）。 */\n    private Stats computeActualStats(List<Map<String, Object>> rows, int mask) {\n        Map<String, Map<Object, Boolean>> distinct = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        int bits = mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int b = bits & -bits;\n            Table t = model.table(Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(b));\n            for (String col : t.columns) {\n                distinct.put(ColumnRef.of(t.name, col).canonical, new LinkedHashMap<>());\n            }\n            bits ^= b;\n        }\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {\n            // 行内只存裸列名；要还原所属表。不同表若有同名列会在 putAll 时冲突覆盖，\n            // 这是本引擎的已知简化（README 已声明列按表所属），实际数据建议列名唯一。\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> e : row.entrySet()) {\n                int owner = findOwnerColumn(mask, e.getKey());\n                if (owner >= 0) {\n                    distinct.get(ColumnRef.of(model.table(owner).name, e.getKey()).canonical)\n                            .put(e.getValue(), Boolean.TRUE);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Stats s = new Stats(rows.size());\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Map<Object, Boolean>> e : distinct.entrySet()) {\n            s.ndv.put(e.getKey(), (double) e.getValue().size());\n        }\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    private int findOwnerColumn(int mask, String bareColumn) {\n        int found = -1;\n        int bits = mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int b = bits & -bits;\n            int ti = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(b);\n            if (model.table(ti).columns.contains(bareColumn)) {\n                if (found >= 0) return -1; // 歧义（多表同名列），无法归属\n                found = ti;\n            }\n            bits ^= b;\n        }\n        return found;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_c058011b63f4cd5d2cd25498","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2777,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":62264,"output_tokens":2025,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_c0hxs6dm3egj5uqi513o2p0d":{"content":"package HashMap（支持一条边上的多个等值条件，键为组合键）\n *   cartesian-join 嵌套循环（无连接条件，语义为 R × S）\n *\n * 执行器内部行一律以规范键 \"表名.列名\" 存储，避免多表同名列冲突；\n * 对用户输出结果时可恢复裸列名（Engine 负责）。\n *\n * 执行后自底向上回填每个节点的实际行数、实际列 NDV 与实际累计代价，\n * 实际代价口径与估计一致：Σ(子代价) + 本节点输出行数。\n */\npublic final class Executor {\n\n    /** 执行中间结果：行（规范键）+ 真实统计。 */\n    public static final class Result {\n        public final List<Map<String, Object>> rows;\n        public final Stats stats;\n        public Result(List<Map<String, Object>> rows, Stats stats) {\n            this.rows = rows;\n            this.stats = stats;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private final Model model;\n\n    public Executor(Model model) {\n        this.model = model;\n    }\n\n    public Result execute(PlanNode plan) {\n        if (plan instanceof ScanNode) return scan((ScanNode) plan);\n        if (plan instanceof JoinNode) return join((JoinNode) plan);\n        throw new EngineException(\"未知计划节点: \" + plan.getClass());\n    }\n\n    private Result scan(ScanNode n) {\n        Table t = model.table(n.tableIdx);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>(t.rows.size());\n        for (Map<String, Object> r : t.rows) {\n            Map<String, Object> q = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> e : r.entrySet()) {\n                q.put(ColumnRef.of(t.name, e.getKey()).canonical, e.getValue());\n            }\n            out.add(q);\n        }\n        Stats s = t.actualStats.copy();\n        n.actual = s;\n        n.actualCost = s.rowCount;\n        return new Result(out, s);\n    }\n\n    private Result join(JoinNode n) {\n        Result lr = execute(n.left);\n        Result rr = execute(n.right);\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out;\n        if (n.edgeIds.isEmpty()) {\n            out = nestedLoop(lr.rows, rr.rows);\n        } else {\n            List<EqPredicate> preds = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Edge e : n.edges(model)) preds.addAll(e.predicates);\n            out = hashJoin(lr, rr, preds, n.left.mask, n.right.mask);\n        }\n\n        Stats s = computeActualStats(out, n.mask);\n        n.actual = s;\n        n.actualCost = n.left.actualCost + n.right.actualCost + s.rowCount;\n        return new Result(out, s);\n    }\n\n    private List<Map<String, Object>> nestedLoop(List<Map<String, Object>> left,\n                                                 List<Map<String, Object>> right) {\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>(Math.max(16, left.size() * right.size()));\n        for (Map<String, Object> l : left) {\n            for (Map<String, Object> r : right) {\n                Map<String, Object> merged = new LinkedHashMap<>(l);\n                merged.putAll(r); // 键均带表名前缀，不会互相覆盖\n                out.add(merged);\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private List<Map<String, Object>> hashJoin(Result lr, Result rr,\n                                               List<EqPredicate> preds,\n                                               int leftMask, int rightMask) {\n        boolean buildLeft = lr.rows.size() <= rr.rows.size();\n        Result build = buildLeft ? lr : rr;\n        Result probe = buildLeft ? rr : lr;\n        int buildMask = buildLeft ? leftMask : rightMask;\n        int otherMask = buildMask == leftMask ? rightMask : leftMask;\n\n        List<ColumnRef> buildKeys = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnRef> probeKeys = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (EqPredicate p : preds) {\n            ColumnRef bc = p.columnOnSide(buildMask, model);\n            ColumnRef pc = p.columnOnSide(otherMask, model);\n            if (bc == null || pc == null) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：连接谓词与计划两侧不匹配: \" + p);\n            }\n            buildKeys.add(bc);\n            probeKeys.add(pc);\n        }\n\n        Map<List<Object>, List<Map<String, Object>>> table = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : build.rows) Object> brow : matches) {\n                Map<String, Object> merged = new LinkedHashMap<>(brow);\n                merged.putAll(prow);\n                out.add(merged);\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private List<Object> keyOf(Map<String, Object> row, List<ColumnRef> keys) {\n        List<Object> k = new ArrayList<>(keys.size());\n        for (ColumnRef c : keys) }\n\n    /** 从实际输出（规范键）计算行数与各列 NDV。 */\n    private Stats computeActualStats(List<Map<String, Object>> rows, int mask) {\n        Map<String, Map<Object, Boolean>> distinct = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n {\n                distinct.put(ColumnRef.of(t.name, col).canonical, new LinkedHashMap<>());\n            }\n            bits ^= b;\n        }\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {\n          }\n        }\n        Stats s = new Stats(rows.size());\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Map<Object, Boolean>> e : distinct.entrySet()) {\n            s.ndv.put(e.getKey(), (double) e.getValue().size());\n        }\n        return s;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_9df7db6efd5fc01bad97d080","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2803,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":64312,"output_tokens":1888,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_2q9j7nzd6yse58vruaqzp0oo":{"content":"package java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 单机内存执行器：真正执行优化器产生的计划。\n *\n *   hash-join      在等值键上构建 HashMap（支持一条边上的多个等值条件，键为组合键）\n *   cartesian-join 嵌套循环（无连接条件，语义为 R × S）\n *\n * 执行后自底向上回填每个节点的实际行数、实际列 NDV 与“实际累计代价”，\n * 以便对照优化器的估计值。实际代价口径与估计一致：Σ(子代价) + 本节点输出行数。\n */\npublic final class Executor {\n\n    /** 执行中间结果：行 + 真实统计。 */\n    public static final class Result {\n        public final List<Map<String, Object>> rows;\n        public final Stats stats;\n        public Result(List<Map<String, Object>> rows, Stats stats) {\n            this.rows = rows;\n            this.stats = stats;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private final Model model;\n\n    public Executor(Model model) {\n        this.model = model;\n    }\n\n    public Result execute(PlanNode plan) {\n        if (plan instanceof ScanNode) return scan((ScanNode) plan);\n        if (plan instanceof JoinNode) return join((JoinNode) plan);\n        throw new EngineException(\"未知计划节点: \" + plan.getClass());\n    }\n\n    private Result scan(ScanNode n) {\n        Table t = model.table(n.tableIdx);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>(t.rows.size());\n        for (Map<String, Object> r : t.rows) out.add(new LinkedHashMap<>(r));\n        Stats s = t.actualStats.copy();\n        n.actual = s;\n        n.actualCost = s.rowCount;\n        return new Result(out, s);\n    }\n\n    private Result join(JoinNode n) {\n        Result lr = execute(n.left);\n        Result rr = execute(n.right);\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out;\n        if (n.edgeIds.isEmpty()) {\n            out = nestedLoop(lr.rows, rr.rows);\n        } else {\n            List<EqPredicate> preds = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Edge e : n.edges(model)) preds.addAll(e.predicates);\n            out = hashJoin(lr, rr, preds, n.left.mask, n.right.mask);\n        }\n\n        Stats s = computeActualStats(out, n.mask);\n        n.actual = s;\n        n.actualCost = n.left.actualCost + n.right.actualCost + s.rowCount;\n        return new Result(out, s);\n    }\n\n    private List<Map<String, Object>> nestedLoop(List<Map<String, Object>> left,\n                                                 List<Map<String, Object>> right) {\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>(left.size() * right.size());\n        for (Map<String, Object> l : left) {\n            for (Map<String, Object> r : right) {\n                Map<String, Object> merged = new LinkedHashMap<>(l);\n                merged.putAll(r);\n                out.add(merged);\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private List<Map<String, Object>> hashJoin(Result lr, Result rr,\n                                               List<EqPredicate> preds,\n                                               int leftMask, int rightMask) {\n        // 构建端取较小的一侧\n        boolean buildLeft = lr.rows.size() <= rr.rows.size();\n        Result build = buildLeft ? lr : rr;\n        Result probe = buildLeft ? rr : lr;\n        int buildMask = buildLeft ? leftMask : rightMask;\n\n        // 键计算：每个谓词在构建侧的列值\n        List<ColumnRef> buildKeys = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnRef> probeKeys = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (EqPredicate p : preds) {\n            ColumnRef bc = p.columnOnSide(buildMask, model);\n            int otherMask = buildMask == leftMask ? rightMask : leftMask;\n            ColumnRef pc = p.columnOnSide(otherMask, model);\n            if (bc == null || pc == null) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：连接谓词与计划两侧不匹配: \" + p);\n            }\n            buildKeys.add(bc);\n            probeKeys.add(pc);\n        }\n\n        Map<List<Object>, List<Map<String, Object>>> table = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : build.rows) {\n            List<Object> key = keyOf(row, buildKeys);\n            // null 不参与等值连接（SQL 三值逻辑；本引擎按“无匹配”处理）\n            if (containsNull(key)) continue;\n            table.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(row);\n        }\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Map<String, Object> prow : probe.rows) {\n            List<Object> key = keyOf(prow, probeKeys);\n            if (containsNull(key)) continue;\n            List<Map<String, Object>> matches = table.get(key);\n            if (matches == null) continue;\n            for (Map<String, Object> brow : matches) {\n                Map<String, Object> merged;\n                if (buildLeft) {\n                    merged = new LinkedHashMap<>(brow);\n                    merged.putAll(prow);\n                } else {\n                    merged = new LinkedHashMap<>(prow);\n                    merged.putAll(brow);\n                }\n                out.add(merged);\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private List<Object> keyOf(Map<String, Object> row, List<ColumnRef> keys) {\n        List<Object> k = new ArrayList<>(keys.size());\n        for (ColumnRef c : keys) k.add(row.get(c.column));\n        return k;\n    }\n\n    private boolean containsNull(List<Object> key) {\n        for (Object o : key) if (o == null) return true;\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    /** 从实际输出行计算行数与各列 NDV（列按 表名.列名 规范键）。 */\n    private Stats computeActualStats(List<Map<String, Object>> rows, int mask) {\n        Map<String, Map<Object, Boolean>> distinct = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        int bits = mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int b = bits & -bits;\n            Table t = model.table(Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(b));\n            for (String col : t.columns) {\n                distinct.put(ColumnRef.of(t.name, col).canonical, new LinkedHashMap<>());\n            }\n            bits ^= b;\n        }\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {\n            // 行内只存裸列名；要还原所属表。不同表若有同名列会在 putAll 时冲突覆盖，\n            // 这是本引擎的已知简化（README 已声明列按表所属），实际数据建议列名唯一。\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> e : row.entrySet()) {\n                int owner = findOwnerColumn(mask, e.getKey());\n                if (owner >= 0) {\n                    distinct.get(ColumnRef.of(model.table(owner).name, e.getKey()).canonical)\n                            .put(e.getValue(), Boolean.TRUE);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Stats s = new Stats(rows.size());\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Map<Object, Boolean>> e : distinct.entrySet()) {\n            s.ndv.put(e.getKey(), (double) e.getValue().size());\n        }\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    private int findOwnerColumn(int mask, String bareColumn) {\n        int found = -1;\n        int bits = mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int b = bits & -bits;\n            int ti = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(b);\n            if (model.table(ti).columns.contains(bareColumn)) {\n                if (found >= 0) return -1; // 歧义（多表同名列），无法归属\n                found = ti;\n            }\n            bits ^= b;\n        }\n        return found;\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ef1aac1d-3ce2-4f58-93d5-7ff4c3292125","session_id":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/a","sessionId":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-a","slug":"validated-singing-puddle"}

((Optimizer.Result) primary).plan\n                : ((LeftDeepOptimizer.Result) primary).plan;\n        long candidates = primary instanceof Optimizer.Result\n                ? ((Optimizer.Result) primary).candidatesConsidered\n                : ((LeftDeepOptimizer.Result) primary).candidatesConsidered;\n\n        // 对照：同时算出另一种策略的代价（仅对比，不执行）\n        LeftDeepOptimizer.Result ldCompare = null;\n        Optimizer.Result bushyCompare = null;\n        if (model.strategy.equals(\"bushy\")) {\n            ldCompare = new LeftDeepOptimizer(model, cm, useProvided).optimize();\n        } else {\n            bushyCompare = new Optimizer(model, cm, useProvided).optimize();\n        }\n\n        // 暴力枚举校验（允许笛卡尔积的全空间最小代价）\n        Map<String, Object> verify = null;\n        if (model.verifyBruteForce) {\n            BruteForce bf = new BruteForce(model, cm, useProvided, model.bruteForceMaxTrees);\n            BruteForce.Report rep = bf.enumerate();\n            verify = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            verify.put(\"performed\", rep.run);\n            verify.put(\"capped\", rep.capped);\n            verify.put(\"legalPlanCount\", rep.planCount);\n            verify.put(\"maxTrees\", model.bruteForceMaxTrees);\n            if (rep.run) {\n                verify.put(\"bruteForceMinCost\", PlanNode.round(rep.minCost));\n                verify.put(\"dpCost\", PlanNode.round(plan.estimatedCost));\n                double diff = Math.abs(rep.minCost - plan.estimatedCost);\n                verify.put(\"costDifference\", PlanNode.round(diff));\n                verify.put(\"matchesMinimum\", diff <= 1e-6);\n                verify.put(\"optimalTopSplits\", rep.optimalSplits);\n                verify.put(\"bruteForceTopRows\", PlanNode.round(rep.topRows));\n            } else {\n                verify.put(\"reason\", \"合法计划数超过上限 bruteForceMaxTrees=\"\n                        + model.bruteForceMaxTrees + \"，跳过穷举（DP 仍正常执行）\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 执行\n        Map<String, Object> execution = null;\n        List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (bushy != null) warnings.addAll(bushy.warnings);\n        if (model.execute) {\n            checkExecutable(model, warnings);\n            Executor ex = new Executor(model);\n            long e0 = System.nanoTime();\n            Executor.Result er = ex.execute(plan);\n            long execMicros = (System.nanoTime() - e0) / 1000;\n\n            execution = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            execution.put(\"executed\", true);\n            execution.put(\"elapsedMicros\", execMicros);\n            execution.put(\"resultRowCount\", er.rows.size());\n\n            // 估计 vs 实际 逐节点对比\n            List<Map<String, Object>> diffs = new ArrayList<>();\n            collectDiffs(plan, diffs);\n            execution.put(\"estimateVsActual\", diffs);\n\n            Stats topActual = plan.actual;\n            Stats topEst = plan.estimated;\n            Map<String, Object> top = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            top.put(\"estimatedRows\", PlanNode.round(topEst.rowCount));\n            top.put(\"actualRows\", (long) topActual.rowCount);\n            top.put(\"estimatedCost\", PlanNode.round(plan.estimatedCost));\n            top.put(\"actualCost\", PlanNode.round(plan.actualCost));\n            top.put(\"rowRatio\", topActual.rowCount == 0\n                    ? null : PlanNode.round(topEst.rowCount / topActual.rowCount));\n            execution.put(\"root\", top);\n\n            // 结果预览\n            long limit = Math.max(0, model.previewLimit);\n            List<Object> preview = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < Math.min((int) limit, er.rows.size()); i++) {\n                preview.add(stripQualifiers(er.rows.get(i)));\n            }\n            execution.put(\"preview\", preview);\n            if (er.rows.size() > limit) {\n                execution.put(\"previewTruncated\", true);\n                warnings.add(\"结果共 \" + er.rows.size() + \" 行，仅预览前 \" + limit + \" 行\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        // DP 表导出\n        Map<String, Object> dpDump = dumpMemo(model, bushy != null ? bushy.memo : null,\n                leftDeep != null ? leftDeep.memo : null);\n\n        // 响应\n        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        resp.put(\"engine\", \"join-order-optimizer\");\n        resp.put(\"version\", VERSION);\n        resp.put(\"query\", model.queryName);\n        resp.put(\"strategy\", strategyUsed);\n        resp.put(\"statsSource\", model.statsSource);\n        resp.put(\"tableCount\", model.n());\n        resp.put(\"edgeCount\", model.edges.size());\n        resp.put(\"connectedComponents\", model.components().size());\n        resp.put(\"optimizerElapsedMicros\", optMicros);\n        resp.put(\"candidatesConsidered\", candidates);\n        resp.put(\"plan\", plan.toMap(model));\n        resp.put(\"planText\", plan.toTree(model).stripTrailing());\n        resp.put(\"dpTable\", dpDump);\n\n        // 策略对照\n        Map<String, Object> cmp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        cmp.put(\"bushyCost\",\n                PlanNode.round(bushy != null ? bushy.plan.estimatedCost : bushyCompare.plan.estimatedCost));\n        cmp.put(\"leftDeepCost\",\n                PlanNode.round(ldCompare != null ? ldCompare.plan.estimatedCost : leftDeep.plan.estimatedCost));\n        double bushyC = bushy != null ? bushy.plan.estimatedCost : bushyCompare.plan.estimatedCost;\n        double leftC = ldCompare != null ? ldCompare.plan.estimatedCost : leftDeep.plan.estimatedCost;\n        cmp.put(\"bushyWinsBy\", PlanNode.round(leftC - bushyC));\n        resp.put(\"strategyComparison\", cmp);\n\n        if (verify != null) resp.put(\"bruteForceVerification\", verify);\n        if (execution != null) resp.put(\"execution\", execution);\n        if (!warnings.isEmpty()) resp.put(\"warnings\", warnings);\n        return resp;\n    }\n\n    private void checkExecutable(Model model, List<String> warnings) {\n        List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Table t : model.tables) {\n            if (t.rows.isEmpty()) missing.add(t.name);\n        }\n        if (!missing.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new EngineException(\"以下表没有内联数据（rows 为空），无法实际执行；\"\n                    + \"如需只做代价估计请设置 execute=false：\" + missing);\n        }\n        if (model.statsSource.equals(\"provided\")) {\n            for (Table t : model.tables) {\n                if (t.providedStats != null) {\n                    warnings.add(\"表 \" + t.name + \" 的优化器使用了请求中提供的统计（可能与真实数据不同，\"\n                            + \"用于演示估计偏差）；执行始终基于真实数据\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void collectDiffs(PlanNode p, List<Map<String, Object>> out) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            collectDiffs(j.left, out);\n            collectDiffs(j.right, out);\n        }\n        if (p.actual != null) {\n            Map<String, Object> d = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            d.put(\"node\", p.nodeType());\n            d.put(\"tables\", p.tableNames(modelForDump()));\n            d.put(\"estimatedRows\", PlanNode.round(p.estimated.rowCount));\n            d.put(\"actualRows\", (long) p.actual.rowCount);\n            d.put(\"ratio\", p.actual.rowCount == 0 ? null\n                    : PlanNode.round(p.estimated.rowCount / p.actual.rowCount));\n            d.put(\"cartesian\", p.cartesian);\n            out.add(d);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Model modelForDump() {\n        return currentModel;\n    }\n\n    private Model currentModel;\n\n    private Map<String, Object> dumpMemo(Model model,\n                                         Map<Integer, OptEntry> bushyMemo,\n                                         Map<Integer, OptEntry> ldMemo) {\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = bushyMemo != null ? bushyMemo : ldMemo;\n        Map<String, Object> d = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        d.put(\"kind\", bushyMemo != null ? \"bushy-dp (subset)\" : \"left-deep-dp (prefix-set)\");\n        List<Object> entries = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (OptEntry e : memo.values()) entries.add(e.dump(model));\n        d.put(\"entries\", entries);\n        d.put(\"entryCount\", entries.size());\n        return d;\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> stripQualifiers(Map<String, Object> qualified) {\n        Map<String, Object> bare = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> e : qualified.entrySet()) {\n            String k = e.getKey();\n            int idx = k.indexOf('.');\n            bare.put(idx >= 0 ? k.substring(idx + 1) : k, e.getValue());\n        }\n        return bare;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_cb8ffee228a2fe9b35cedb5d","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2669,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":66360,"output_tokens":2636,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_i5wfm85ropqv0h3kjo072nia":{"content":"package }\n\n        Object parsed;\n        try {\n            parsed = Json.parse(reqText);\n        } catch (EngineException e) {\n            emit(responseFile, error(\"JSON_PARSE\", e.getMessage()),    System.exit(2);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> response;\n        try {\n            response = new Engine().run(Json.asObject(parsed, \"request\"));\n        } null) {\n            Map<String, Object> doc = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            doc.put(\"query\", response.get(\"query\"));\n            doc.put(\"dpTable\", response.get(\"dpTable\"));\n prettyStderr)\n            throws IOException {\n        String text = Json.write(payload);\n        if (responseFile != null) {\n            Files.writeString(Path.of(responseFile), text, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n            if (payload.containsKey(\"error\")) {\n                System.err.println(payload.get(\"error\") + \": \"\n                        + ((Map<?, ?>) payload.get(\"error\")).get(\"message\"));\n            } else {\n                System.out.println(\"响应已写入 \" + responseFile);\n            }\n        } else {\n            System.out.print(text);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> error(String code, String message) {\n        Map<String, Object> e = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        e.put(\"code\", code);\n        e.put(\"message\", message);\n        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        body.put(\"ok\", false);\n        body.put(\"error\", e);\n        return body;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_eeec7f9aa05db6aa4f3e37c5","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1171,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":71480,"output_tokens":1215,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_50v6z8kucwalrharhk3tmg0n":{"content":"package        t.put(\"name\", name);\n            t.put(\"columns\", inferColumns(ndvPairs));\n            Map<String, Object> st = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            st.put(\"rowCount\", rows);\n            Map<String, Object> ndv = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < ndvPairs.length; i += 2) {\n                ndv.put(ndvPairs[i].toString(), ndvPairs[i + 1]);\n            }\n            st.put(\"ndv\", ndv);\n            t.put(\"stats\", st);\n            tables.add(t);\n            tableCount++;\n            return this;\n        }\n\n        private List<Object> inferColumns(Object... ndvPairs) {\n            List<Object> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < ndvPairs.length; i += 2) {\n                String c = ndvPairs[i].toString();\n                if (c.indexOf('.') >= 0) c = c.substring(c.indexOf('.') + 1);\n                cols.add(c);\n            }\n            return cols;\n        }\n\n        /** 有真实数据的表，rows 是 {\"col\", value, ...} 的数组。 */\n        B dataTable(String name, Map<String, Object>... data) {\n            Map<String, Object> t = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            t.put(\"name\", name);\n            List<Object> rs = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Map<String, Object> r : data) rs.add(r);\n            t.put(\"rows\", rs);\n            tables.add(t);\n            tableCount++;\n            return this;\n        }\n\n        B join(String left, String right) {\n            Map<String, Object> j = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            List<Object> on = new ArrayList<>();\n            on.add(pred(left, right));\n            j.put(\"on\", on);\n            joins.add(j);\n            return this;\n        }\n\n        B joinPreds(String[]... preds) {\n            Map<String, Object> j = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            List<Object> on = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (String[] p : preds) on.add(pred(p[0], p[1]));\n            j.put(\"on\", on);\n            joins.add(j);\n            return this;\n        }\n\n        private Map<String, Object> pred(String l, String r) {\n            Map<String, Object> p = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            p.put(\"left\", l);\n            p.put(\"right\", r);\n            return p;\n        }\n\n        Model model() { return Model.fromRequest(req); }\n\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> run() { return new Engine().run(req); }\n    }\n\n    static Map<String, Object> row(Object... kv) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 2) m.put(kv[i].toString(), kv[i + 1]);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    static Map<String, Object> obj(Object o) { return (Map<String, Object>) o; }\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    static List<Object> arr(Object o) { return (List<Object>) o; }\n\n    static Optimizer.Result bushy(Model m, boolean provided) {\n        return new Optimizer(m, new CostModel(m), provided).optimize();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- tests\n\n    static void jsonRoundTrip() {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"a\", 1L);\n        m.put(\"b\", 1.5);\n        m.put(\"c\", \"hi\\t\\n\");\n        List<Object> l = new ArrayList<>();\n        l.add(true); l.add(null); l.add(m);\n        m.put(\"d\", l);\n        String s = Json.write(m);\n        Object back = Json.parse(s);\n        check(m.equals(back), \"JSON 往返保持数据与键序\");\n    }\n\n    static void jsonParseErrors() {\n        throwsEngine(() -> Json.parse(\"{bad}\"), \"非法 JSON 被拒绝\");\n        throwsEngine(() -> Json.parse(\"[1,2,\"), \"截断数组被拒绝\");\n        checkEq(((Number) Json.parse(\"3.5\")).doubleValue(), 3.5, \"小数解析\");\n        checkEq(((Number) Json.parse(\"42\")).longValue(), 42L, \"整数解析\");\n    }\n\n    static void costModelHandCalc() {\n        // R(a):1000,ndv=10 ; S(b):500,ndv=20 => |R⋈S| = 1000*500/20 = 25000\n        Model m = new B(\"c\").statsTable(\"R\", 1000, \"R.a\", 10)\n                            .statsTable(\"S\", 500, \"S.b\", 20).join(\"R.a\", \"S.b\").model();\n        Stats l = Optimizer.baseStats(m, 0, true);\n        Stats r = Optimizer.baseStats(m, 1, true);\n        Stats j = new CostModel(m).estimateJoin(1, 2, l, r, m.crossingEdges(1, 2));\n        checkEq(j.rowCount, 25000, \"等值连接基数 |R|*|S|/max(ndv)\");\n        checkEq(j.ndv.get(\"R.a\"), 10, \"NDV 传播不超过原值\");\n        checkEq(j.ndv.get(\"S.b\"), 20, \"NDV 传播不超过原值 (2)\");\n        // 笛卡尔积\n        Stats x = new CostModel(m).estimateJoin(1, 2, l, r, new ArrayList<>());\n        checkEq(x.rowCount, 500000, \"无边 => 笛卡尔积行数\");\n    }\n\n    static void costModelMultiPredicate() {\n        // 两条件：R.a=S.a (ndv 10) 且 R.k=S.k (ndv 5) => 行数 / (10*5)\n        B b = new B(\"mp\")\n                .statsTable(\"R\", 1000, \"R.a\", 10, \"R.k\", 5)\n                .statsTable(\"S\", 2000, \"S.a\", 8, \"S.k\", 5);\n        b.joinPreds(new String[]{\"R.a\", \"S.a\"}, new String[]{\"R.k\", \"S.k\"});\n        Model m = b.model();\n        Stats l = Optimizer.baseStats(m, 0, true);\n        Stats r = Optimizer.baseStats(m, 1, true);\n        Stats j = new CostModel(m).estimateJoin(1, 2, l, r, m.crossingEdges(1, 2));\n        // max(10,8)=10, max(5,5)=5\n        checkEq(j.rowCount, 1000.0 * 2000 / 50, \"多等值条件选择率连乘\");\n    }\n\n    static void connectedComponents() {\n        // a-b 连通，c-d 连通，e 孤立 => 3 个分量\n        Model m = new B(\"cc\").statsTable(\"a\", 10, \"a.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"b\", 10, \"b.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"c\", 10, \"c.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"d\", 10, \"d.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"e\", 10, \"e.k\", 10)\n                             .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\").join(\"c.k\", \"d.k\").model();\n        checkEq(m.components().size(), 3, \"检测到 3 个连通分量\");\n        check(m.isConnected(3), \"a,b 连通\");\n        check(!m.isConnected(5), \"a,c 不连通\");\n    }\n\n    static void threeTableBushyVsLeftDeepSameChain() {\n        // 链 R-S-T，均匀 NDV：验证两种策略都可得到、且稠密不劣于左深\n        B b = new B(\"chain3\")\n                .statsTable(\"R\", 100, \"R.k\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"S\", 100, \"S.rk\", 100, \"S.tk\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"T\", 100, \"T.k\", 100)\n                .join(\"R.k\", \"S.rk\").join(\"S.tk\", \"T.k\");\n        Model m = b.model();\n        double bc = bushy(m, true).plan.estimatedCost;\n        double lc = new LeftDeepOptimizer(m, new CostModel(m), true).optimize().plan.estimatedCost;\n        check(bc <= lc + 1e-9, \"链图：稠密代价 <= 左深代价\");\n        // 手算：每步 100*100/100=100；最优 ((R⋈S)⋈T) 或 (R⋈(S⋈T))：scan 300 + join100 + join100 = 500\n        checkEq(bc, 500, \"链图最优代价手算 500\");\n    }\n\n    static void fourTableCycleBushyBeatsLeftDeep() {\n        // 4 表环：a-b, b-c, c-d, d-a。小表先两两连接形成稠密计划。\n        // |a|=100 ndv100; |b|=1000 ndv100 两边; |c|=100; |d|=1000\n        // a⋈b = 1000, c⋈d = 1000, 再以 b-c? 注意边：环 a-b-b? 构造 a-b,b-c,c-d,d-a\n        // 稠密: (a⋈b) ⋈ (d⋈c) 需要它们之间有边——没有，边在 b-c 与 d-a，连接后边仍跨越两侧。\n        B b = new B(\"cycle4\")\n                .statsTable(\"a\", 100, \"a.bk\", 100, \"a.dk\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"b\", 1000, \"b.ak\", 100, \"b.ck\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"c\", 100, \"c.bk\", 100, \"c.dk\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"d\", 1000, \"d.ak\", 100, \"d.ck\", 100)\n                .join(\"a.bk\", \"b.ak\").join(\"b.ck\", \"c.bk\")\n                .join(\"c.dk\", \"d.ck\").join(\"d.ak\", \"a.dk\");\n        Model m = b.model();\n        Optimizer.Result or = bushy(m, true);\n        LeftDeepOptimizer.Result ld = new LeftDeepOptimizer(m, new CostModel(m), true).optimize();\n        // 稠密中间结果：a⋈b=1000（代价 100+1000+1000=2100），c⋈d=1000；\n        // 二者通过 b-c 和 d-a 两条边连接：1000*1000/(100*100)=100\n        // 稠密总代价 = 2100 + 2100 + 100 = 4300\n        checkEq(or.plan.estimatedCost, 4300, \"4 表环稠密最优代价 4300\");\n        // 最优左深序列应是 a,c,b,d 之类：先 a⋈c 无边——不允许。\n        // 合法左深从 a 起：a-b(1000), 然后 +c 用 b-c => 1000*100/100=1000,\n        //   +d 有两条边 (d-a,d-c) => 1000*1000/10000=100 => 代价 100+1000+100 + (1000)+(100)\n        //   scans=2200? 扫描：100+1000+100+1000=2200；连接：1000+1000+100 => 4300。同样 4300。\n        check(ld.plan.estimatedCost >= or.plan.estimatedCost - 1e-9,\n                \"4 表环：稠密不劣于左深\");\n    }\n\n    static void bruteForceMatchesDpAllConnectedGraphsUpTo6() {\n        // 枚举 n=2..6 多种连接图（路径、环、星形、完全图、稀疏图），\n        // 暴力全空间（允许笛卡尔积）最小代价必须等于稠密 DP。\n        int n = 6;\n        int graphs = 0;\n        for (long seed = 1; seed <= 200; seed++) {\n            B b = new B(\"rand\" + seed);\n            java.util.Random rnd = new java.util.Random(seed);\n            long[] rows = new long[n];\n            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                rows[i] = 1 + rnd.nextInt(1000);\n                Object[] ndv = new Object[2 * n];\n                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {\n                    ndv[2 * j] = ((char) ('a' + i)) + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + j)) + \"k\";\n                    ndv[2 * j + 1] = 1 + rnd.nextInt((int) rows[i]);\n                }\n                b.statsTable(\"t\" + i, rows[i], ndv);\n            }\n            // 保证连通：先造随机生成树，再加 0~4 条随机边\n            List<Integer> in = new ArrayList<>();\n            in.add(0);\n            List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) out.add(i);\n            java.util.Collections.shuffle(out, rnd);\n            int addedEdges = 0;\n            for (int v : out) {\n                int u = in.get(rnd.nextInt(in.size()));\n                b.join(\"t\" + u + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + v)) + \"k\",\n                        \"t\" + v + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + u)) + \"k\");\n                in.add(v);\n                addedEdges++;\n            }\n            int extra = rnd.nextInt(5);\n            for (int e = 0; e < extra; e++) {\n                int u = rnd.nextInt(n), v2 = rnd.nextInt(n);\n                if (u == v2) continue;\n                boolean exists = false;\n                for (Object jo : b.req.get(\"joins\") == null ? new ArrayList<>() : b.joins) exists = exists; // no-op\n                b.join(\"t\" + u + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + v2)) + \"q\",\n                        \"t\" + v2 + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + u)) + \"q\");\n                addedEdges++;\n            }\n            Model m = b.model();\n            if (m.edges.size() != addedEdges) {\n                // 随机重复边被合并，仍然是合法图\n            }\n            Optimizer.Result or = bushy(m, true);\n            BruteForce.Report rep = new BruteForce(m, new CostModel(m), true, 5_000_000).enumerate();\n            check(rep.run, \"随机图 #\" + seed + \" 暴力枚举在限额内完成\");\n            checkEq(rep.minCost, or.plan.estimatedCost,\n                    \"随机图 #\" + seed + \" DP 代价 == 全空间枚举最小值\");\n            graphs++;\n        }\n        check(graphs == 200, \"随机图测试全部执行 (200 个)\");\n    }\n\n    static void bruteForceMatchesDpDisconnected() {\n        B b = new B(\"disc-bf\")\n                .statsTable(\"a\", 100, \"a.k\", 50)\n                .statsTable(\"b\", 200, \"b.k\", 50)\n                .statsTable(\"c\", 300, \"c.k\", 300)\n                .statsTable(\"d\", 400, \"d.k\", 400)\n                .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\"); // c,d 都孤立\n        Model m = b.model();\n        Optimizer.Result or = bushy(m, true);\n        BruteForce.Report rep = new BruteForce(m, new CostModel(m), true, 5_000_000).enumerate();\n        checkEq(rep.minCost, or.plan.estimatedCost, \"断开图：枚举最小值 == DP（分量合并顺序也最优）\");\n    }\n\n    static void cartesianMarkedForDisconnected() {\n        B b = new B(\"cart\").statsTable(\"a\", 3, \"a.k\", 3)\n                           .statsTable(\"b\", 4, \"b.k\", 4)\n                           .statsTable(\"c\", 5, \"c.k\", 5)\n                           .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\");\n        b.execute(true);\n        Map<String, Object> resp = b.run();\n        // 找到标记\n        int[] marked = {0};\n        countCart(resp, marked);\n        check(marked[0] >= 1, \"断开分量间的连接节点被标记 cartesian=true\");\n        List<?> w = (List<?>) resp.get(\"warnings\");\n        check(w != null && w.toString().contains(\"连通分量\"), \"断开连接图产生中文告警\");\n    }\n\n    private static void countCart(Object node, int[] marked) {\n        if (!(node instanceof Map)) return;\n        Map<?, ?> mp = (Map<?, ?>) node;\n        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(mp.get(\"cartesian\"))) marked[0]++;\n        countCart(mp.get(\"left\"), marked);\n        countCart(mp.get(\"right\"), marked);\n    }\n\n    static void noCartesianInsideConnectedComponent() {\n        // 连通 3 表计划中不应出现 cartesian 节点\n        B b = new B(\"nocart\").statsTable(\"a\", 5, .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\").join(\"a.j\", \"c.j\");\n        b.execute(true);\n        Map<String, Object> resp = b.run();\n        int[] marked = {0};\n        countCart(resp.get(\"plan\"), marked);\n        checkEq(marked[0], 0, \"连通分量内最优计划不含笛卡尔积节点\");\n    }\n\n    static void leftDeepStrategy() {\n        B b = new B(\"ld\").statsTable(\"a\", 10, \"a.k\", 10)\n skewEstimateVsActualOverestimate() {\n        // 倾斜（高估）：orders 1000 行 cust_id NDV=100；customers 100 行 id NDV=100\n        // 估计 = 1000*100/100 = 1000；实际数据所有订单都指向同一个 cust（且存在），\n        // 真实输出 = 1000 行 —— 用“键不相交”构造高估：订单键都在 900..，客户键在 0..\n        B b = new B(\"skew-over\");\n        Map<String, Object>[] orders = skewRows(\"cid\", 100, i -> 900 + (i % 100)); // 100 个不同键\n        b.dataTable(\"orders\", orders);\n        Map<String, Object>[] custs = skewRows(\"id\", 100, i -> i); // 键 0..99，不相交\n        b.dataTable(\"customers\", custs);\n        // 提供倾斜统计：声称 NDV=100（两边都是）=> 估计 100*100/100 = 100\n        Map<String, Object> req = b.req;\n        obj(req.get(\"tables\")).get(0); // no-op\n        attachStats(b, 0, 100, row(\"cid\", 100));\n        attachStats(b, 1, 100, row(\"id\", 100));\n        b.join(\"orders.cid\", \"customers.id\").execute(true).preview(0);\n        Map<String, Object> resp = b.run();\n        Map<?, ?> ex = obj(resp.get(\"execution\"));\n root.get(\"actualRows\")).longValue(), 0L, \"高估场景：实际 0 行（键不相交）\");\n        check(resp.get(\"warnings\") != null && resp.get(\"warnings\").toString().contains(\"提供的统计\"),\n                \"提示优化器使用了提供统计\");\n    }\n\n    static void skewEstimateVsActualUnderestimate() {\n        // 倾斜（低估）：两边 NDV 声称很大 => 估计很小；实际键高度集中 => 输出爆炸\n        B b = new B(\"skew-under\");\n        // orders 100 attachStats(b, 0, 100, row(\"cid\", 100));\n        attachStats(b, 1, 100, row(\"id\", 100));\n        b.join(\"orders.cid\", \"customers.id\").execute(true).preview(0);\n        Map<String, Object> void statsSourceActualRemovesBias() {\n        // 与低估场景相同数据，但 statsSource=actual：优化器看到真实 NDV=1 => 估计 = 100*100/1 = 10000\n        B b = new B(\"actual-src\");\n        b.dataTable(\"orders\",
