obj(obj(resp.get(\"execution\")).get(\"root\"));\n        checkEq(((Number) root.get(\"estimatedRows\")).doubleValue(), 10000.0,\n                \"statsSource=actual 时估计与实际一致 10000\");\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static void attachStats(B b, int tableIdx, long rowCount, Map<String, Object> ndv) {\n        Map<String, Object> t = obj(b.tables.get(tableIdx));\n        Map<String, Object> st = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        st.put(\"rowCount\", rowCount);\n        st.put(\"ndv\", ndv);\n        t.put(\"stats\", st);\n    }\n\n    interface IntFn { int apply(int i); }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static Map<String, Object>[] skewRows(String col, int n, IntFn key) {\n        Map<String, Object>[] rs = new Map[n];\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) rs[i] = row(col, key.apply(i), \"pad\", i);\n        return rs;\n    }\n\n    static void emptyTableExecutionRejected() {\n        B b = new B(\"empty\").statsTable(\"a\", 10, \"a.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"b\", 10, \"b.k\", 10)\n                             .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\").execute(true);\n        throwsEngine(b::run, \"无数据表在 execute=true 时被拒绝\");\n    }\n\n    static void nineTablesRejected() {\n        B b = new B(\"nine\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) b.statsTable(\"t\" + i, 1, \"t\" + i.k, 1);\n        for (int i = 1; i < 9; i++) b.join(\"t0.k\", \"t\" + i + \".k\");\n        throwsEngine(b::model, \"超过 8 张表被拒绝\");\n    }\n\n    static void unknownColumnRejected() {\n        B b = new B(\"uc\").statsTable(\"a\", 3, \"a.k\", 3).statsTable(\"b\", 3, \"b.k\", 3);\n        b.join(\"a.k\", \"b.missing\");\n        throwsEngine(b::model, \"引用不存在列被拒绝\");\n        throwsEngine(() -> new B(\"s\").statsTable(\"a\", 3, \"a.k\", 3).join(\"a.k\", \"x.k\").model(),\n                \"引用不存在表被拒绝\");\n    }\n\n    static void eightTableBoundAccepted() {\n        B b = new B(\"eight\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) b.statsTable(\"t\" + i, 10, \"t\" + i + \".k\", 10);\n        for (int i = 1; i < 8; i++) b.join(\"t0.k\", \"t\" + i + \".k\");\n        b.verify(true).maxTrees(50_000_000L);\n        Map<String, Object> resp = b.run();\n        checkEq(((Number) resp.get(\"tableCount\")).longValue(), 8L, \"8 表请求被接受\");\n        Map<?, ?> vf = obj(resp.get(\"bruteForceVerification\"));\n        check(Boolean.TRUE.equals(vf.get(\"performed\")), \"8 表暴力枚举执行（星形图计划数较小）\");\n        check(Boolean.TRUE.equals(vf.get(\"matchesMinimum\")), \"8 表：DP 仍是全空间最优\");\n    }\n\n    static void deterministicTieBreak() {\n        // 完全对称的两表/三表计划，重复运行文本必须一致\n        B b1 = new B(\"det\").statsTable(\"a\", 10, \"a.k\", 10)\n                            .statsTable(\"b\", 10, \"b.k\", 10)\n                            .statsTable(\"c\", 10, \"c.k\", 10)\n                            .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\").join(\"b.k\", \"c.k\");\n        String t1 = (String) b1.run().get(\"planText\");\n        String t2 = (String) new B(\"det2\").statsTable(\"a\", 10, \"a.k\", 10)\n                                          .statsTable(\"b\", 10, \"b.k\", 10)\n                                          .statsTable(\"c\", 10, \"c.k\", 10)\n                                          .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\").join(\"b.k\", \"c.k\")\n                                          .run().get(\"planText\");\n        check(t1.equals(t2.replace(\"det2\", \"det\")), \"对称统计下计划确定可复现\");\n    }\n\n    static void fullJsonRequestEndToEnd() {\n        // 从 JSON 文本进入，到 JSON 响应输出，全链路\n        String req = \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"e2e\\\",\\\"execute\\\":true,\\\"previewLimit\\\":5,\"\n                + \"\\\"tables\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"r\\\",\\\"rows\\\":[{\\\"k\\\":1},{\\\"k\\\":1}]},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"s\\\",\\\"rows\\\":[{\\\"k\\\":1},{\\\"k\\\":2}]}],\"\n                + \"\\\"joins\\\":[{\\\"on\\\":[{\\\"left\\\":\\\"r.k\\\",\\\"right\\\":\\\"s.k\\\"}]}]}\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = new Engine().run(Json.asObject(Json.parse(req), \"req\"));\n        String text = Json.write(resp);\n        check(text.contains(\"hash-join\"), \"端到端响应含 hash-join\");\n        checkEq(((Number) obj(obj(resp.get(\"execution\")).get(\"root\")).get(\"actualRows\")).longValue(),\n                2L, \"端到端实际行数 2\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_15466adb7d112a8d7f0d2c8d","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":349,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":74552,"output_tokens":9279,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_kaqnwwahlvqavc8gck44p2ew":{"content":"package joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 零依赖自动化测试。运行：java joinorder.AllTests（由 build.sh test 调用）。\n *\n * 覆盖：JSON 往返、代价模型手算、连通分量、bushy/左深 DP、\n * 小规模枚举所有合法顺序验证最小代价、笛卡尔积标记、执行器正确性、\n * 倾斜统计导致的估计/实际偏差、错误请求校验、8 表上限等。\n */\npublic final class AllTests {\n\n    private static int passed = 0;\n    private static int failed = 0;\n    private static final List<String> failures = new ArrayList<>();\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        jsonRoundTrip();\n        jsonParseErrors();\n        costModelHandCalc();\n        costModelMultiPredicate();\n        connectedComponents();\n        threeTableBushyVsLeftDeepSameChain();\n        fourTableCycleBushyBeatsLeftDeep();\n        bruteForceMatchesDpAllConnectedGraphsUpTo6();\n        bruteForceMatchesDpDisconnected();\n        cartesianMarkedForDisconnected();\n        noCartesianInsideConnectedComponent();\n        leftDeepStrategy();\n        executorHashJoinCorrect();\n        executorCartesianCorrect();\n        executorMultiPredicate();\n        executorMultiTableSkew();\n        skewEstimateVsActualOverestimate();\n        skewEstimateVsActualUnderestimate();\n        statsSourceActualRemovesBias();\n        emptyTableExecutionRejected();\n        nineTablesRejected();\n        unknownColumnRejected();\n        eightTableBoundAccepted();\n        deterministicTieBreak();\n        fullJsonRequestEndToEnd();\n\n        System.out.println(\"----------------------------------------\");\n        System.out.println(\"通过 \" + passed + \" / \" + (passed + failed) + \"，失败 \" + failed);\n        if (failed > 0) {\n            for (String f : failures) System.out.println(\"FAIL: \" + f);\n            System.exit(1);\n        }\n        System.out.println(\"全部测试通过。\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers\n\n    static void check(boolean cond, String name) {\n        if (cond) { passed++; }\n        else { failed++; failures.add(name); System.out.println(\"FAIL: \" + name); }\n    }\n\n    static void checkEq(double actual, double expected, String name) {\n        if (Math.abs(actual - expected) <= 1e-6) { passed++; }\n        else {\n            failed++;\n            String msg = name + \" (期望 \" + expected + \"，实际 \" + actual + \")\";\n            failures.add(msg);\n            System.out.println(\"FAIL: \" + msg);\n        }\n    }\n\n    static void throwsEngine(Runnable r, String name) {\n        try {\n            r.run();\n            failed++;\n            failures.add(name + \" (期望抛出 EngineException)\");\n            System.out.println(\"FAIL: \" + name + \" (未抛出)\");\n        } catch (EngineException e) {\n            passed++;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 测试用查询构造器。 */\n    static final class B {\n        final Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        final List<Object> tables = new ArrayList<>();\n        final List<Object> joins = new ArrayList<>();\n        int tableCount = 0;\n\n        B(String name) {\n            req.put(\"name\", name);\n            req.put(\"execute\", false);\n            req.put(\"verifyBruteForce\", false);\n            req.put(\"tables\", tables);\n            req.put(\"joins\", joins);\n        }\n\n        B execute(boolean v) { req.put(\"execute\", v); return this; }\n        B strategy(String s) { req.put(\"strategy\", s); return this; }\n        B verify(boolean v) { req.put(\"verifyBruteForce\", v); return this; }\n        B maxTrees(long v) { req.put(\"bruteForceMaxTrees\", v); return this; }\n        B statsSource(String s) { req.put(\"statsSource\", s); return this; }\n        B preview(long v) { req.put(\"previewLimit\", v); return this; }\n\n        /** 仅统计（无数据）表。ndv: 偶数下标为列名、奇数为 NDV 值（缺省=行数）。 */\n        B statsTable(String name, long rows, Object... ndvPairs) {\n            Map<String, Object> t = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            t.put(\"name\", name);\n            t.put(\"columns\", inferColumns(ndvPairs));\n            Map<String, Object> st = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            st.put(\"rowCount\", rows);\n            Map<String, Object> ndv = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < ndvPairs.length; i += 2) {\n                ndv.put(ndvPairs[i].toString(), ndvPairs[i + 1]);\n            }\n            st.put(\"ndv\", ndv);\n            t.put(\"stats\", st);\n            tables.add(t);\n            tableCount++;\n            return this;\n        }\n\n        private List<Object> inferColumns(Object... ndvPairs) {\n            List<Object> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < ndvPairs.length; i += 2) {\n                String c = ndvPairs[i].toString();\n                if (c.indexOf('.') >= 0) c = c.substring(c.indexOf('.') + 1);\n                cols.add(c);\n            }\n            return cols;\n        }\n\n        /** 有真实数据的表，rows 是 {\"col\", value, ...} 的数组。 */\n        B dataTable(String name, Map<String, Object>... data) {\n            Map<String, Object> t = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            t.put(\"name\", name);\n            List<Object> rs = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Map<String, Object> r : data) rs.add(r);\n            t.put(\"rows\", rs);\n            tables.add(t);\n            tableCount++;\n            return this;\n        }\n\n        B join(String left, String right) {\n            Map<String, Object> j = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            List<Object> on = new ArrayList<>();\n            on.add(pred(left, right));\n            j.put(\"on\", on);\n            joins.add(j);\n            return this;\n        }\n\n        B joinPreds(String[]... preds) {\n            Map<String, Object> j = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            List<Object> on = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (String[] p : preds) on.add(pred(p[0], p[1]));\n            j.put(\"on\", on);\n            joins.add(j);\n            return this;\n        }\n\n        private Map<String, Object> pred(String l, String r) {\n            Map<String, Object> p = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            p.put(\"left\", l);\n            p.put(\"right\", r);\n            return p;\n        }\n\n        Model model() { return Model.fromRequest(req); }\n\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> run() { return new Engine().run(req); }\n    }\n\n    static Map<String, Object> row(Object... kv) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 2) m.put(kv[i].toString(), kv[i + 1]);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    static Map<String, Object> obj(Object o) { return (Map<String, Object>) o; }\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    static List<Object> arr(Object o) { return (List<Object>) o; }\n\n    static Optimizer.Result bushy(Model m, boolean provided) {\n        return new Optimizer(m, new CostModel(m), provided).optimize();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- tests\n\n    static void jsonRoundTrip() {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"a\", 1L);\n        m.put(\"b\", 1.5);\n        m.put(\"c\", \"hi\\t\\n\");\n        List<Object> l = new ArrayList<>();\n        l.add(true); l.add(null); l.add(m);\n        m.put(\"d\", l);\n        String s = Json.write(m);\n        Object back = Json.parse(s);\n        check(m.equals(back), \"JSON 往返保持数据与键序\");\n    }\n\n    static void jsonParseErrors() {\n        throwsEngine(() -> Json.parse(\"{bad}\"), \"非法 JSON 被拒绝\");\n        throwsEngine(() -> Json.parse(\"[1,2,\"), \"截断数组被拒绝\");\n        checkEq(((Number) Json.parse(\"3.5\")).doubleValue(), 3.5, \"小数解析\");\n        checkEq(((Number) Json.parse(\"42\")).longValue(), 42L, \"整数解析\");\n    }\n\n    static void costModelHandCalc() {\n        // R(a):1000,ndv=10 ; S(b):500,ndv=20 => |R⋈S| = 1000*500/20 = 25000\n        Model m = new B(\"c\").statsTable(\"R\", 1000, \"R.a\", 10)\n                            .statsTable(\"S\", 500, \"S.b\", 20).join(\"R.a\", \"S.b\").model();\n        Stats l = Optimizer.baseStats(m, 0, true);\n        Stats r = Optimizer.baseStats(m, 1, true);\n        Stats j = new CostModel(m).estimateJoin(1, 2, l, r, m.crossingEdges(1, 2));\n        checkEq(j.rowCount, 25000, \"等值连接基数 |R|*|S|/max(ndv)\");\n        checkEq(j.ndv.get(\"R.a\"), 10, \"NDV 传播不超过原值\");\n        checkEq(j.ndv.get(\"S.b\"), 20, \"NDV 传播不超过原值 (2)\");\n        // 笛卡尔积\n        Stats x = new CostModel(m).estimateJoin(1, 2, l, r, new ArrayList<>());\n        checkEq(x.rowCount, 500000, \"无边 => 笛卡尔积行数\");\n    }\n\n    static void costModelMultiPredicate() {\n        // 两条件：R.a=S.a (ndv 10) 且 R.k=S.k (ndv 5) => 行数 / (10*5)\n        B b = new B(\"mp\")\n                .statsTable(\"R\", 1000, \"R.a\", 10, \"R.k\", 5)\n                .statsTable(\"S\", 2000, \"S.a\", 8, \"S.k\", 5);\n        b.joinPreds(new String[]{\"R.a\", \"S.a\"}, new String[]{\"R.k\", \"S.k\"});\n        Model m = b.model();\n        Stats l = Optimizer.baseStats(m, 0, true);\n        Stats r = Optimizer.baseStats(m, 1, true);\n        Stats j = new CostModel(m).estimateJoin(1, 2, l, r, m.crossingEdges(1, 2));\n        // max(10,8)=10, max(5,5)=5\n        checkEq(j.rowCount, 1000.0 * 2000 / 50, \"多等值条件选择率连乘\");\n    }\n\n    static void connectedComponents() {\n        // a-b 连通，c-d 连通，e 孤立 => 3 个分量\n        Model m = new B(\"cc\").statsTable(\"a\", 10, \"a.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"b\", 10, \"b.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"c\", 10, \"c.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"d\", 10, \"d.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"e\", 10, \"e.k\", 10)\n                             .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\").join(\"c.k\", \"d.k\").model();\n        checkEq(m.components().size(), 3, \"检测到 3 个连通分量\");\n        check(m.isConnected(3), \"a,b 连通\");\n        check(!m.isConnected(5), \"a,c 不连通\");\n    }\n\n    static void threeTableBushyVsLeftDeepSameChain() {\n        // 链 R-S-T，均匀 NDV：验证两种策略都可得到、且稠密不劣于左深\n        B b = new B(\"chain3\")\n                .statsTable(\"R\", 100, \"R.k\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"S\", 100, \"S.rk\", 100, \"S.tk\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"T\", 100, \"T.k\", 100)\n                .join(\"R.k\", \"S.rk\").join(\"S.tk\", \"T.k\");\n        Model m = b.model();\n        double bc = bushy(m, true).plan.estimatedCost;\n        double lc = new LeftDeepOptimizer(m, new CostModel(m), true).optimize().plan.estimatedCost;\n        check(bc <= lc + 1e-9, \"链图：稠密代价 <= 左深代价\");\n        // 手算：每步 100*100/100=100；最优 ((R⋈S)⋈T) 或 (R⋈(S⋈T))：scan 300 + join100 + join100 = 500\n        checkEq(bc, 500, \"链图最优代价手算 500\");\n    }\n\n    static void fourTableCycleBushyBeatsLeftDeep() {\n        // 4 表环：a-b, b-c, c-d, d-a。小表先两两连接形成稠密计划。\n        // |a|=100 ndv100; |b|=1000 ndv100 两边; |c|=100; |d|=1000\n        // a⋈b = 1000, c⋈d = 1000, 再以 b-c? 注意边：环 a-b-b? 构造 a-b,b-c,c-d,d-a\n        // 稠密: (a⋈b) ⋈ (d⋈c) 需要它们之间有边——没有，边在 b-c 与 d-a，连接后边仍跨越两侧。\n        B b = new B(\"cycle4\")\n                .statsTable(\"a\", 100, \"a.bk\", 100, \"a.dk\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"b\", 1000, \"b.ak\", 100, \"b.ck\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"c\", 100, \"c.bk\", 100, \"c.dk\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"d\", 1000, \"d.ak\", 100, \"d.ck\", 100)\n                .join(\"a.bk\", \"b.ak\").join(\"b.ck\", \"c.bk\")\n                .join(\"c.dk\", \"d.ck\").join(\"d.ak\", \"a.dk\");\n        Model m = b.model();\n        Optimizer.Result or = bushy(m, true);\n        LeftDeepOptimizer.Result ld = new LeftDeepOptimizer(m, new CostModel(m), true).optimize();\n        // 稠密中间结果：a⋈b=1000（代价 100+1000+1000=2100），c⋈d=1000；\n        // 二者通过 b-c 和 d-a 两条边连接：1000*1000/(100*100)=100\n        // 稠密总代价 = 2100 + 2100 + 100 = 4300\n        checkEq(or.plan.estimatedCost, 4300, \"4 表环稠密最优代价 4300\");\n        // 最优左深序列应是 a,c,b,d 之类：先 a⋈c 无边——不允许。\n        // 合法左深从 a 起：a-b(1000), 然后 +c 用 b-c => 1000*100/100=1000,\n        //   +d 有两条边 (d-a,d-c) => 1000*1000/10000=100 => 代价 100+1000+100 + (1000)+(100)\n        //   scans=2200? 扫描：100+1000+100+1000=2200；连接：1000+1000+100 => 4300。同样 4300。\n        check(ld.plan.estimatedCost >= or.plan.estimatedCost - 1e-9,\n                \"4 表环：稠密不劣于左深\");\n    }\n\n    static void bruteForceMatchesDpAllConnectedGraphsUpTo6() {\n        // 枚举 n=2..6 多种连接图（路径、环、星形、完全图、稀疏图），\n        // 暴力全空间（允许笛卡尔积）最小代价必须等于稠密 DP。\n        int n = 6;\n        int graphs = 0;\n        for (long seed = 1; seed <= 200; seed++) {\n            B b = new B(\"rand\" + seed);\n            java.util.Random rnd = new java.util.Random(seed);\n            long[] rows = new long[n];\n            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                rows[i] = 1 + rnd.nextInt(1000);\n                Object[] ndv = new Object[2 * n];\n                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {\n                    ndv[2 * j] = ((char) ('a' + i)) + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + j)) + \"k\";\n                    ndv[2 * j + 1] = 1 + rnd.nextInt((int) rows[i]);\n                }\n                b.statsTable(\"t\" + i, rows[i], ndv);\n            }\n            // 保证连通：先造随机生成树，再加 0~4 条随机边\n            List<Integer> in = new ArrayList<>();\n            in.add(0);\n            List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) out.add(i);\n            java.util.Collections.shuffle(out, rnd);\n            int addedEdges = 0;\n            for (int v : out) {\n                int u = in.get(rnd.nextInt(in.size()));\n                b.join(\"t\" + u + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + v)) + \"k\",\n                        \"t\" + v + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + u)) + \"k\");\n                in.add(v);\n                addedEdges++;\n            }\n            int extra = rnd.nextInt(5);\n            for (int e = 0; e < extra; e++) {\n                int u = rnd.nextInt(n), v2 = rnd.nextInt(n);\n                if (u == v2) continue;\n                boolean exists = false;\n                for (Object jo : b.req.get(\"joins\") == null ? new ArrayList<>() : b.joins) exists = exists; // no-op\n                b.join(\"t\" + u + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + v2)) + \"q\",\n                        \"t\" + v2 + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + u)) + \"q\");\n                addedEdges++;\n            }\n            Model m = b.model();\n            if (m.edges.size() != addedEdges) {\n                // 随机重复边被合并，仍然是合法图\n            }\n            Optimizer.Result or = bushy(m, true);\n            BruteForce.Report rep = new BruteForce(m, new CostModel(m), true, 5_000_000).enumerate();\n            check(rep.run, \"随机图 #\" + seed + \" 暴力枚举在限额内完成\");\n            checkEq(rep.minCost, or.plan.estimatedCost,\n                    \"随机图 #\" + seed + \" DP 代价 == 全空间枚举最小值\");\n            graphs++;\n        }\n        check(graphs == 200, \"随机图测试全部执行 (200 个)\");\n    }\n\n    static void bruteForceMatchesDpDisconnected() {\n        B b = new B(\"disc-bf\")\n                .statsTable(\"a\", 100, \"a.k\", 50)\n                .statsTable(\"b\", 200, \"b.k\", 50)\n                .statsTable(\"c\", 300, \"c.k\", 300)\n                .statsTable(\"d\", 400, \"d.k\", 400)\n                .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\"); // c,d 都孤立\n        Model m = b.model();\n        Optimizer.Result or = bushy(m, true);\n        BruteForce.Report rep = new BruteForce(m, new CostModel(m), true, 5_000_000).enumerate();\n        checkEq(rep.minCost, or.plan.estimatedCost, \"断开图：枚举最小值 == DP（分量合并顺序也最优）\");\n    }\n\n    static void cartesianMarkedForDisconnected() {\n        B b = new B(\"cart\").statsTable(\"a\", 3, \"a.k\", 3)\n                           .statsTable(\"b\", 4, \"b.k\", 4)\n                           .statsTable(\"c\", 5, \"c.k\", 5)\n                           .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\");\n        b.execute(true);\n        Map<String, Object> resp = b.run();\n        // 找到标记\n        int[] marked = {0};\n        countCart(resp, marked);\n        check(marked[0] >= 1, \"断开分量间的连接节点被标记 cartesian=true\");\n        List<?> w = (List<?>)  /** 测试用查询构造器。 */\n    static final class B {\n        final Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        final List<Object> tables = new ArrayList<>();\n        final List<Object> joins false);\n            req.put(\"tables\", tables);\n            req.put(\"joins\", joins);\n        }\n\n        B execute(boolean v) { req.put(\"execute\", v); return this; }\n        B     st.put(\"ndv\", ndv);\n            t.put(\"stats\", st);\n            tables.add(t);\n            tableCount++;\n            return this;\n        }\n\n        private List<Object> static void jsonParseErrors() {\n        throwsEngine(() -> Json.parse(\"{bad}\"), \"非法 JSON 被拒绝\");\n        throwsEngine(() -> Json.parse(\"[1,2,\"), \"截断数组被拒绝\");\n        checkEq(((Number) Json.parse(\"3.5\")).doubleValue(), 3.5, \"小数解析\");\n        checkEq(((Number) Json.parse(\"42\")).longValue(), 42L, \"整数解析\");\n    }\n\n    static void costModelHandCalc() {\n        // R(a):1000,ndv=10 ; S(b):500,ndv=20 => |R⋈S| = 1000*500/20 = 25000\n        Model m = new B(\"c\").statsTable(\"R\", 1000, \"R.a\", 10)\n                            .statsTable(\"S\", 500, \"S.b\", 20).join(\"R.a\", \"S.b\").model();\n        Stats l = Optimizer.baseStats(m, 0, true);\n        Stats r = Optimizer.baseStats(m, 1, true);\n        Stats j = new CostModel(m).estimateJoin(1, 2, l, r, m.crossingEdges(1, 2));\n        checkEq(j.rowCount, 25000, \"等值连接基数 |R|*|S|/max(ndv)\");\n        checkEq(j.ndv.get(\"R.a\"), 10, \"NDV 传播不超过原值\");\n        checkEq(j.ndv.get(\"S.b\"), 20, \"NDV 传播不超过原值 (2)\");\n        // 笛卡尔积\n        Stats x = new CostModel(m).estimateJoin(1, 2, l, r, new ArrayList<>());\n        checkEq(x.rowCount, 500000, \"无边 => 笛卡尔积行数\");\n    }\n\n    static void costModelMultiPredicate() {\n        // 两条件：R.a=S.a (ndv 10) 且 R.k=S.k (ndv 5) => 行数 / (10*5)\n        B b = new B(\"mp\")\n                .statsTable(\"R\", 1000, \"R.a\", 10, \"R.k\", 5)\n                .statsTable(\"S\", 2000, \"S.a\", 8, \"S.k\", 5);\n        b.joinPreds(new String[]{\"R.a\", \"S.a\"}, new String[]{\"R.k\", \"S.k\"});\n        Model m = b.model();\n        Stats l = Optimizer.baseStats(m, 0, true);\n        Stats r = Optimizer.baseStats(m, 1, true);\n        Stats j = new CostModel(m).estimateJoin(1, 2, l, r, m.crossingEdges(1, 2));\n        // max(10,8)=10, max(5,5)=5\n        checkEq(j.rowCount, 1000.0 * 2000 / 50, \"多等值条件选择率连乘\");\n    }\n\n    static void connectedComponents() {\n        // a-b 连通，c-d 连通，e 孤立 => 3 个分量\n        Model m = new B(\"cc\").statsTable(\"a\", 10, \"a.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"b\", 10, \"b.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"c\", 10, \"c.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"d\", 10, \"d.k\", 10)\n                             .statsTable(\"e\", 10, \"e.k\", 10)\n                             .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\").join(\"c.k\", \"d.k\").model();\n        checkEq(m.components().size(), 3, \"检测到 3 个连通分量\");\n        check(m.isConnected(3), \"a,b 连通\");\n        check(!m.isConnected(5), \"a,c 不连通\");\n    }\n\n    static void threeTableBushyVsLeftDeepSameChain() {\n        // 链 R-S-T，均匀 NDV：验证两种策略都可得到、且稠密不劣于左深\n        B b = new B(\"chain3\")\n                .statsTable(\"R\", 100, \"R.k\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"S\", 100, \"S.rk\", 100, \"S.tk\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"T\", 100, \"T.k\", 100)\n                .join(\"R.k\", \"S.rk\").join(\"S.tk\", \"T.k\");\n        Model m = b.model();\n        double bc = bushy(m, true).plan.estimatedCost;\n        double lc = new LeftDeepOptimizer(m, new CostModel(m), true).optimize().plan.estimatedCost;\n        check(bc <= lc + 1e-9, \"链图：稠密代价 <= 左深代价\");\n        // 手算：每步 100*100/100=100；最优 ((R⋈S)⋈T) 或 (R⋈(S⋈T))：scan 300 + join100 + join100 = 500\n        checkEq(bc, 500, \"链图最优代价手算 500\");\n    }\n\n    static void fourTableCycleBushyBeatsLeftDeep() {\n        // 4 表环：a-b, b-c, c-d, d-a。小表先两两连接形成稠密计划。\n        // |a|=100 ndv100; |b|=1000 ndv100 两边; |c|=100; |d|=1000\n        // a⋈b = 1000, c⋈d = 1000, 再以 b-c? 注意边：环 a-b-b? 构造 a-b,b-c,c-d,d-a\n        // 稠密: (a⋈b) ⋈ (d⋈c) 需要它们之间有边——没有，边在 b-c 与 d-a，连接后边仍跨越两侧。\n        B b = new B(\"cycle4\")\n                .statsTable(\"a\", 100, \"a.bk\", 100, \"a.dk\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"b\", 1000, \"b.ak\", 100, \"b.ck\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"c\", 100, \"c.bk\", 100, \"c.dk\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"d\", 1000, \"d.ak\", 100, \"d.ck\", 100)\n                .join(\"a.bk\", \"b.ak\").join(\"b.ck\", \"c.bk\")\n                .join(\"c.dk\", \"d.ck\").join(\"d.ak\", \"a.dk\");\n        Model m = b.model();\n        Optimizer.Result or = bushy(m, true);\n        LeftDeepOptimizer.Result ld = new LeftDeepOptimizer(m, new CostModel(m), true).optimize();\n        // 稠密中间结果：a⋈b=1000（代价 100+1000+1000=2100），c⋈d=1000；\n        // 二者通过 b-c 和 d-a 两条边连接：1000*1000/(100*100)=100\n        // 稠密总代价 = 2100 + 2100 + 100 = 4300\n        checkEq(or.plan.estimatedCost, 4300, \"4 表环稠密最优代价 4300\");\n        // 最优左深序列应是 a,c,b,d 之类：先 a⋈c 无边——不允许。\n        // 合法左深从 a 起：a-b(1000), 然后 +c 用 b-c => 1000*100/100=1000,\n        //   +d 有两条边 (d-a,d-c) => 1000*1000/10000=100 => 代价 100+1000+100 + (1000)+(100)\n        //   scans=2200? 扫描：100+1000+100+1000=2200；连接：1000+1000+100 => 4300。同样 4300。\n        check(ld.plan.estimatedCost >= or.plan.estimatedCost - 1e-9,\n                \"4 表环：稠密不劣于左深\");\n    }\n\n    static void bruteForceMatchesDpAllConnectedGraphsUpTo6() {\n        // 枚举 n=2..6 多种连接图（路径、环、星形、完全图、稀疏图），\n        // 暴力全空间（允许笛卡尔积）最小代价必须等于稠密 DP。\n        int n = 6;\n        int graphs = 0;\n        for (long seed = 1; seed <= 200; seed++) {\n            B b = new B(\"rand\" + seed);\n            java.util.Random rnd = new java.util.Random(seed);\n            long[] rows = new long[n];\n            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                rows[i] = 1 + rnd.nextInt(1000);\n                Object[] ndv = new Object[2 * n];\n                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {\n                    ndv[2 * j] = ((char) ('a' + i)) + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + j)) + \"k\";\n                    ndv[2 * j + 1] = 1 + rnd.nextInt((int) rows[i]);\n                }\n                b.statsTable(\"t\" + i, rows[i], ndv);\n            }\n            // 保证连通：先造随机生成树，再加 0~4 条随机边\n            List<Integer> in = new ArrayList<>();\n            in.add(0);\n            List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) out.add(i);\n            java.util.Collections.shuffle(out, rnd);\n            int addedEdges = 0;\n            for (int v : out) {\n                int u = in.get(rnd.nextInt(in.size()));\n                b.join(\"t\" + u + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + v)) + \"k\",\n                        \"t\" + v + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + u)) + \"k\");\n                in.add(v);\n                addedEdges++;\n            }\n            int extra = rnd.nextInt(5);\n            for (int e = 0; e < extra; e++) {\n                int u = rnd.nextInt(n), v2 = rnd.nextInt(n);\n                if (u == v2) continue;\n                boolean exists = false;\n                for (Object jo : b.req.get(\"joins\") == null ? new ArrayList<>() : b.joins) exists = exists; // no-op\n                b.join(\"t\" + u + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + v2)) + \"q\",\n                        \"t\" + v2 + \".\" + ((char) ('a' + u)) + \"q\");\n                addedEdges++;\n            }\n            Model m = b.model();\n            if (m.edges.size() != addedEdges) {\n                // 随机重复边被合并，仍然是合法图\n            }\n            Optimizer.Result or = bushy(m, true);\n            BruteForce.Report rep = new BruteForce(m, new CostModel(m), true, 5_000_000).enumerate();\n            check(rep.run, \"随机图 #\" + seed + \" 暴力枚举在限额内完成\");\n            checkEq(rep.minCost, or.plan.estimatedCost,\n                    \"随机图 #\" + seed + \" DP 代价 == 全空间枚举最小值\");\n            graphs++;\n        }\n        check(graphs == 200, \"随机图测试全部执行 (200 个)\");\n    }\n\n    static void bruteForceMatchesDpDisconnected() {\n        B b = new B(\"disc-bf\")\n                .statsTable(\"a\", 100, \"a.k\", 50)\n                .statsTable(\"b\", 200, \"b.k\", 50)\n                .statsTable(\"c\", 300, \"c.k\", 300)\n                .statsTable(\"d\", 400, \"d.k\", 400)\n                .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\"); // c,d 都孤立\n        Model m = b.model();\n        Optimizer.Result or = bushy(m, true);\n        BruteForce.Report rep = new BruteForce(m, new CostModel(m), true, 5_000_000).enumerate();\n        checkEq(rep.minCost, or.plan.estimatedCost, \"断开图：枚举最小值 == DP（分量合并顺序也最优）\");\n    }\n\n    static void cartesianMarkedForDisconnected() {\n        B b = new B(\"cart\").statsTable(\"a\", 3, \"a.k\", 3)\n Object> resp = b.run();\n        // 找到标记\n        int[] marked = {0};\n        countCart(resp, marked);\n        check(marked[0] >= 1, \"断开分量间的连接节点被标记 cartesian=true\");\n        List<?> w = (List<?>) resp.get(\"warnings\");\n        check(w != null && w.toString().contains(\"连通分量\"), \"断开连接图产生中文告警\");\n    }\n\n    private static void countCart(Object node, int[] marked) {\n        if (!(node countCart(mp.get(\"right\"), marked);\n    }\n\n    static void noCartesianInsideConnectedComponent() {\n        // 连通 3 表计划中不应出现 cartesian 节点\n        B b = new B(\"nocart\").statsTable(\"a\", 5, .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\").join(\"a.j\", \"c.j\");\n        b.execute(true);\n        Map<String, Object> resp = b.run();\n        int[] marked = {0};\n        countCart(resp.get(\"plan\"), marked);\n        checkEq(marked[0], 0, \"连通分量内最优计划不含笛卡尔积节点\");\n    }\n\n    static void leftDeepStrategy() {\n        B b = new B(\"ld\").statsTable(\"a\", 10, \"a.k\", 10)\n skewEstimateVsActualOverestimate() {\n        // 倾斜（高估）：orders 1000 行 cust_id NDV=100；customers 100 行 id NDV=100\n        // 估计 = 1000*100/100 = 1000；实际数据所有订单都指向同一个 cust（且存在），\n        // 真实输出 = 1000 行 —— 用“键不相交”构造高估：订单键都在 900..，客户键在 0..\n        B b = new B(\"skew-over\");\n        Map<String, Object>[] orders = skewRows(\"cid\", 100, i -> 900 + (i % 100)); // 100 个不同键\n        b.dataTable(\"orders\", orders);\n        Map<String, Object>[] custs = skewRows(\"id\", 100, i -> i); // 键 0..99，不相交\n        b.dataTable(\"customers\", custs);\n        // 提供倾斜统计：声称 NDV=100（两边都是）=> 估计 100*100/100 = 100\n        Map<String, Object> req = b.req;\n        obj(req.get(\"tables\")).get(0); // no-op\n        attachStats(b, 0, 100, row(\"cid\", 100));\n        attachStats(b, 1, 100, row(\"id\", 100));\n        b.join(\"orders.cid\", \"customers.id\").execute(true).preview(0);\n        Map<String, Object> resp = b.run();\n        Map<?, ?> ex = obj(resp.get(\"execution\"));\n root.get(\"actualRows\")).longValue(), 0L, \"高估场景：实际 0 行（键不相交）\");\n        check(resp.get(\"warnings\") != null && resp.get(\"warnings\").toString().contains(\"提供的统计\"),\n                \"提示优化器使用了提供统计\");\n    }\n\n    static void skewEstimateVsActualUnderestimate() {\n        // 倾斜（低估）：两边 NDV 声称很大 => 估计很小；实际键高度集中 => 输出爆炸\n        B b = new B(\"skew-under\");\n        // orders 100 checkEq(((Number) root.get(\"actualRows\")).longValue(), 10000L, \"低估场景：实际 10000 行\");\n        checkEq(((Number) root.get(\"rowRatio\")).doubleValue(), 0.01, \"估计/实际 = 0.01\");\n    }\n\n    static void statsSourceActualRemovesBias() {\n        // 与低估场景相同数据，但 statsSource=actual：优化器看到真实 NDV=1 => 估计 = 100*100/1 = 10000\n        B b = new B(\"actual-src\");\n        b.dataTable(\"orders\", @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static void attachStats(B b, int tableIdx, long rowCount, Map<String, Object> ndv) {\n        Map<String, Object> t = obj(b.tables.get(tableIdx));\n \"b.ak\", 100, \"b.ck\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"c\", 100, \"c.bk\", 100, \"c.dk\", 100)\n                .statsTable(\"d\", 1000, \"d.ak\", 100, \"d.ck\", 100)\n                .join(\"a.bk\", \"b.ak\").join(\"b.ck\", \"c.bk\")\n                .join(\"c.dk\", \"d.ck\").join(\"d.ak\", \"a.dk\");\n        Model m = b.model();\n        Optimizer.Result or = bushy(m, true);\n        LeftDeepOptimizer.Result ld = new LeftDeepOptimizer(m, new CostModel(m), true).optimize();\n        // (a⋈b)=1000、(c⋈d)=1000，再经 b-c、d-a 两边：1000*1000/(100*100)=100\n        // 稠密总代价 = 2100 + 2100 b.statsTable(\"t\" + i, rows, ndv);\n                }\n                // 随机连通图（生成树 + 随机边）\n                List<Integer> in = new ArrayList<>();\n                in.add(0);\n int extra = rnd.nextInt((n * (n - 1)) / 2 - (n - 1) + 1);\n                for (int e = 0; e < extra; e++) {\n                    int u = rnd.nextInt(n), v = rnd.nextInt(n);\n                    if (u e.getValue());\n            }\n        }","originalFile":"package joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 阶段1 —— 每个连通分量内部，Selinger 风格枚举：\n *     dp[mask] = 该连通表集合上代价最小的计划；\n *     仅当存在连接边跨越两个连通子集时才组合（分量内不产生笛卡尔积）。\n *     复杂度 O(3^n)，n<=8 时最多数百次比较。\n *\n * 阶段2 —— 分量之间无等值条件，只能做笛卡尔积；再次 DP 决定合并顺序，\n *     对应 JoinNode.edgeIds 为空、输出中标记 cartesian=true。\n *     “不允许分量内笛卡尔积”在本代价模型下不改变最优值（由暴力枚举测试证明）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            memo.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        long considered = 0;\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n\n        // 阶段1：分量内稠密 DP\n        for (int compMask : componentMasks(comps)) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(compMask) <= 1) continue;\n            int sub = (compMask - 1) & compMask; // 非空真子集，跳过空集\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = compMask ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                        && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)) {\n                    List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 阶段1 —— 每个连通分量内部，Selinger 风格枚举：\n *     dp[mask] = 该连通表集合上代价最小的计划；\n *     仅当存在连接边跨越两个连通子集时才组合（分量内不产生笛卡尔积）。\n *     复杂度 O(3^n)，n<=8 时最多数百次比较。\n *\n * 阶段2 —— 分量之间无等值条件，只能做笛卡尔积；再次 DP 决定合并顺序，\n *     对应 JoinNode.edgeIds 为空、输出中标记 cartesian=true。\n *     “不允许分量内笛卡尔积”在本代价模型下不改变最优值（由暴力枚举测试证明）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            memo.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        long considered = 0;\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n\n        // 阶段1：分量内稠密 DP\n        for (int compMask : componentMasks(comps)) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(compMask) <= 1) continue;\n            int sub = (compMask - 1) & compMask; // 非空真子集，跳过空集\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = compMask ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                        && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)) {\n                    List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                    if (!cross.isEmpty()) {\n                        considered++;\n                        combine(memo, sub, rest, cross);\n                    }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & compMask;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 阶段2：分量间笛卡尔积 DP（以“分量”为原子单位）。\n        // 注意 compDp 必须持有独立的计划对象：直接复用 memo 里的条目会在\n        // 两个分量组合后把“父计划”写回其自身所用的子条目，形成自引用。\n        if (comps.size() > 1) {\n            int[] cms = componentMasks(comps);\n            int compUniverse = 0;\n            for (int c : cms) compUniverse |= c;\n\n            // 枚举所有“若干分量的并集”，按 popcount 排序保证子问题先于父问题解决（n<=8，最多 255 次）\n            List<Integer> unions = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int u = 1; u <= compUniverse; u++) {\n                if ((u & ~compUniverse) == 0 && isUnionOfComponents(u, cms)) unions.add(u);\n            }\n            unions.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n            Map<Integer, OptEntry> compDp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int c : cms) compDp.put(c, memo.get(c)); // 叶子：共享分量最优计划（只读，安全）\n\n            for (int u : unions) {\n                if (compDp.containsKey(u)) continue; // 单分量\n                int sub = (u - 1) & u;\n                OptEntry best = null;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = u ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(sub, cms)\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(rest, cms)) {\n                        OptEntry a = compDp.get(sub);\n                        OptEntry b = compDp.get(rest);\n                        if (a != null && b != null) {\n                            considered++;\n                            Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, new ArrayList<>());\n                            double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                            if (best == null || cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                                    || (Math.abs(cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) {\n                                // 为该组合新建独立的 JoinNode\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, new ArrayList<>());\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                best = new OptEntry(u, j, s, cost);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    sub = (sub - 1) & u;\n                }\n                if (best != null) compDp.put(u, best);\n            }\n            // 只有最终全集（以及各并集）结果写回 memo 用于导出；写回独立对象，不复用叶子引用结构\n            for (Map.Entry<Integer, OptEntry> e : compDp.entrySet()) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(e.getKey()) > 1) memo.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());\n            }\n        }\n\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        OptEntry top = memo.get(full);\n        if (top == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean isUnionOfComponents(int mask, int[] comps) {\n        for (int c : comps) {\n            if ((mask & c) == c) mask &= ~c;\n            else if ((mask & c) != 0) return false;\n        }\n        return mask == 0;\n    }\n\n    private int[] componentMasks(List<int[]> comps) {\n        int[] r = new int[comps.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {\n            int m = 0;\n            for (int t : comps.get(i)) m |= 1 << t;\n            r[i] = m;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    /** 比较一次 (A ⋈ B)，更优则写入 memo。 */\n    private void combine(Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo,\n                         int leftMask, int rightMask, List<Edge> cross) {\n        OptEntry a = memo.get(leftMask);\n        OptEntry b = memo.get(rightMask);\n        if (a == null || b == null) return;\n        Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(leftMask, rightMask, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n        double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n        int key = leftMask | rightMask;\n        OptEntry cur = memo.get(key);\n        if (cur == null || better(cost, s.rowCount, cur)) {\n            JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n            j.estimated = s;\n            j.estimatedCost = cost;\n            memo.put(key, new OptEntry(key, j, s, cost));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private boolean better(double cost, double rows, OptEntry cur) {\n        if (cost < cur.cost - 1e-9) return true;\n        if (cost > cur.cost + 1e-9) return false;\n        return rows < cur.stats.rowCount -           }\n        }","originalFile":"package joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 阶段1 —— 每个连通分量内部，Selinger 风格枚举：\n *     dp[mask] = 该连通表集合上代价最小的计划；\n *     仅当存在连接边跨越两个连通子集时才组合（分量内不产生笛卡尔积）。\n *     复杂度 O(3^n)，n<=8 时最多数百次比较。\n *\n * 阶段2 —— 分量之间无等值条件，只能做笛卡尔积；再次 DP 决定合并顺序，\n *     对应 JoinNode.edgeIds 为空、输出中标记 cartesian=true。\n *     “不允许分量内笛卡尔积”在本代价模型下不改变最优值（由暴力枚举测试证明）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            memo.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        long considered = 0;\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n\n        // 阶段1：分量内稠密 DP\n        for (int compMask : componentMasks(comps)) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(compMask) <= 1) continue;\n            int sub = (compMask - 1) & compMask; // 非空真子集，跳过空集\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = compMask ^ sub;\n                // 两个子集都必须连通，且其并集（=compMask 的子问题 sub|rest 在枚举更大集合时）\n                // 这里枚举的是“某个连通子问题”的分割：只有当 sub∪rest 本身连通时组合才合法。\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                        && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)\n                        && model.isConnected(sub | rest)) {\n                    List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                    if (!cross.isEmpty()) {\n                        considered++;\n                        combine(memo, sub, rest, cross);\n                    }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & compMask;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 阶段2：分量间笛卡尔积 DP（以“分量”为原子单位）。\n        // 注意 compDp 必须持有独立的计划对象：直接复用 memo 里的条目会在\n        // 两个分量组合后把“父计划”写回其自身所用的子条目，形成自引用。\n        if (comps.size() > 1) {\n            int[] cms = componentMasks(comps);\n            int compUniverse = 0;\n            for (int c : cms) compUniverse |= c;\n\n            // 枚举所有“若干分量的并集”，按 popcount 排序保证子问题先于父问题解决（n<=8，最多 255 次）\n            List<Integer> unions = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int u = 1; u <= compUniverse; u++) {\n                if ((u & ~compUniverse) == 0 && isUnionOfComponents(u, cms)) unions.add(u);\n            }\n            unions.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n            Map<Integer, OptEntry> compDp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int c : cms) compDp.put(c, memo.get(c)); // 叶子：共享分量最优计划（只读，安全）\n\n            for (int u : unions) {\n                if (compDp.containsKey(u)) continue; // 单分量\n                int sub = (u - 1) & u;\n                OptEntry best = null;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = u ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(sub, cms)\n cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                            if (best == null || cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                                    || (Math.abs(cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) {\n                                // 为该组合新建独立的 JoinNode\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, new ArrayList<>());\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                best = new OptEntry(u, j, s, cost);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    sub = (sub - 1) & u;\n                }\n                if (best != null) compDp.put(u, best);\n            }\n            // 只有最终全集（以及各并集）结果写回 memo 用于导出；写回独立对象，不复用叶子引用结构\n            for (Map.Entry<Integer, OptEntry> e : compDp.entrySet()) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(e.getKey()) > 1) memo.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());\n            }\n        }\n\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        OptEntry top = memo.get(full);\n        if (top == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean isUnionOfComponents(int mask, int[] comps) {\n        for (int c : comps) {\n            if ((mask & c) == c) mask &= ~c;\n            else if ((mask & c) != 0) return false;\n        }\n        return mask == 0;\n    }\n\n    private int[] componentMasks(List<int[]> comps) {\n        int[] r = new int[comps.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {\n            int m = 0;\n            for (int t : comps.get(i)) m |= 1 << t;\n            r[i] = m;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    /** 比较一次 (A ⋈ B)，更优则写入 memo。 */\n    private void combine(Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo,\n                         int leftMask, int rightMask, List<Edge> cross) {\n        OptEntry a = memo.get(leftMask);\n        OptEntry b = memo.get(rightMask);\n        if (a == null || b == null) return;\n        Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(leftMask, rightMask, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n        double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n        int key = leftMask | rightMask;\n        OptEntry cur = memo.get(key);\n        if (cur == null || better(cost, s.rowCount, cur)) {\n            JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n            j.estimated = s;\n            j.estimatedCost = cost;\n            memo.put(key, new OptEntry(key, j, s, cost));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private boolean better(double cost, double rows, OptEntry cur) {\n        if (cost < cur.cost - 1e-9) return true;\n        if (cost > cur.cost + 1e-9) return false;\n        return rows < cur.stats.rowCount - joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 解析后的查询模型：表集合、连接图（边）、连通分量。\n *\n * 请求结构见 README。本类只负责装载与校验，不做优化。\n */\npublic final class Model {\n\n    public static final int MAX_TABLES = 8;\n\n    public final List<Table> tables = new ArrayList<>();\n    public final Map<String, Integer> tableIndex = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n    /** 无向边列表（索引即边 id）。 */\n    public final List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();\n\n    public String queryName;\n    public String strategy = \"bushy\"; // bushy | left-deep\n    public boolean execute;\n    public long previewLimit = 20;\n    public boolean verifyBruteForce;\n    public long bruteForceMaxTrees = 200_000;\n    /** 用于优化器估计的统计来源：provided | actual。 */\n    public String statsSource = \"provided\";\n\n    // 派生\n    private int fullMask;\n    private boolean[] connected;\n    private List<int[]> components;\n\n    public static Model fromRequest(Map<String, Object> req) {\n        Model m = new Model();\n        m.queryName = Json.strOr(req, \"name\", \"query\");\n        m.strategy = Json.strOr(req, \"strategy\", \"bushy\");\n        if (!m.strategy.equals(\"bushy\") && !m.strategy.equals(\"left-deep\")) {\n            throw new EngineException(\"strategy 只能是 bushy 或 left-deep\");\n        }\n        m.execute = Json.bool(req, \"execute\", true);\n        m.previewLimit = Json.lng(req, \"previewLimit\", 20);\n        m.verifyBruteForce = Json.bool(req, \"verifyBruteForce\", true);\n        m.bruteForceMaxTrees = Json.lng(req, \"bruteForceMaxTrees\", 200_000);\n        m.statsSource = Json.strOr(req, \"statsSource\", \"provided\");\n        if (!m.statsSource.equals(\"provided\") && !m.statsSource.equals(\"actual\")) {\n            throw new EngineException(\"statsSource 只能是 provided 或 actual\");\n        }\n\n        List<Object> tableDefs = Json.arr(req, \"tables\");\n        if (tableDefs.isEmpty()) throw new EngineException(\"请求中必须至少有一张表\");\n        if (tableDefs.size() > MAX_TABLES) {\n            throw new EngineException(\"最多支持 \" + MAX_TABLES + \" 张表，当前 \" + tableDefs.size() + \" 张\");\n        }\n        for (Object td : tableDefs) m.loadTable(Json.asObject(td, \"tables[]\"));\n        m.fullMask = (1 << m.tables.size()) - 1;\n\n        for (Object jd : Json.arr(req, \"joins\")) m.loadJoin(Json.asObject(jd, \"joins[]\"));\n\n        m.derive();\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private void loadTable(Map<String, Object> td) {\n        String tname = Json.str(td, \"name\");\n        if (tableIndex.containsKey(tname)) throw new EngineException(\"表名重复: \" + tname);\n        Table t = new Table(tname);\n        int idx = tables.size();\n        tableIndex.put(tname, idx);\n\n        // 列名（可选：若有 rows 可自动推导；显式给出用于只有 stats 没有数据的情形）\n        Object cols = td.get(\"columns\");\n        if (cols instanceof List) {\n            for (Object c : (List<?>) cols) t.columns.add(c.toString());\n        }\n\n        Object rowsObj = td.get(\"rows\");\n        if (rowsObj instanceof List) {\n            for (Object ro : (List<?>) rowsObj) {\n                Map<String, Object> row = Json.asObject(ro, \"tables[\" + tname + \"].rows[]\");\n                t.rows.add(new LinkedHashMap<>(row));\n                for (String k : row.keySet()) {\n                    if (!t.columns.contains(k)) t.columns.add(k);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Object stats = td.get(\"stats\");\n        if (stats instanceof Map) {\n            t.providedStats = parseStats(Json.asObject(stats, \"tables[\" + tname + \"].stats\"), t);\n        }\n        t.computeStatsFromData();\n        tables.add(t);\n    }\n\n    private Stats parseStats(Map<String, Object> st, Table t) {\n        Stats s = new Stats();\n        Object rc = st.get(\"rowCount\");\n        if (!(rc instanceof Number)) throw new EngineException(\"表 \" + t.name + \" 的 stats.rowCount 应为数字\");\n        s.rowCount = ((Number) rc).doubleValue();\n        if (s.rowCount < 0) throw new EngineException(\"表 \" + t.name + \" 的 rowCount 不能为负\");\n        Object nd = st.get(\"ndv\");\n        if (nd instanceof Map) {\n            for (Map.Entry<?, ?> e : ((Map<?, ?>) nd).entrySet()) {\n                ColumnRef cr = resolveColumn(e.getKey().toString(), t.name);\n                if (!(e.getValue() instanceof Number)) {\n                    throw new EngineException(\"ndv.\" + e.getKey() + \" 应为数字\");\n                }\n                double v = ((Number) e.getValue()).doubleValue();\n                if (v < 0) throw new EngineException(\"ndv 不能为负: \" + cr);\n                s.ndv.put(cr.canonical, v);\n            }\n        }\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /** \"t.c\" 或裸列名 \"c\"（在 defaultTable 内）解析。 */\n    public ColumnRef resolveColumn(String text, String defaultTable) {\n        if (text.indexOf('.') < 0) {\n            if (defaultTable == null) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"列引用 '\" + text + \"' 缺少表名限定\");\n            }\n            return ColumnRef.of(defaultTable, text);\n        }\n        ColumnRef cr = ColumnRef.parse(text);\n        Integer ti = tableIndex.get(cr.table);\n        if (ti == null) throw new EngineException(\"列引用了不存在的表: \" + cr.table);\n        Table t = tables.get(ti);\n        if (!t.columns.isEmpty() && !t.columns.contains(cr.column)) {\n            throw new EngineException(\"表 \" + cr.table + \" 不存在列 \" + cr.column);\n        }\n        return cr;\n    }\n\n    private void loadJoin(Map<String, Object> jd) {\n        List<Object> on = Json.arr(jd, \"on\");\n        if (on.isEmpty()) throw new EngineException(\"joins[].on 不能为空\");\n        Edge edge = null;\n        for (Object po : on) {\n            Map<String, Object> pm = Json.asObject(po, \"joins[].on[]\");\n            ColumnRef l = resolveColumn(Json.str(pm, \"left\"), null);\n            ColumnRef r = resolveColumn(Json.str(pm, \"right\"), null);\n            int a = tableIndex.get(l.table);\n            int b = tableIndex.get(r.table);\n            if (a == b) throw new EngineException(\"连接条件必须跨两张表: \" + l + \" = \" + r);\n            if (edge == null) {\n                edge = findOrCreateEdge(a, b);\n            } else if (!(edge.connects(a, b))) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"同一个 joins 条目中的条件必须在相同的两张表之间\");\n            }\n            edge.predicates.add(new EqPredicate(l, r));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Edge findOrCreateEdge(int a, int b) {\n        if (a > b) { int t = a; a = b; b = t; }\n        for (Edge e : edges) if (e.connects(a, b)) return e;\n        Edge e = new Edge(a, b);\n        edges.add(e);\n        return e;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- derive\n\n    private void derive() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        int total = 1 << n;\n        connected = new boolean[total];\n        int[] popcount = new int[total];\n        for (int mask = 0; mask < total; mask++) popcount[mask] = Integer.bitCount(mask);\n\n        // 单表连通；更大集合连通 <=> 存在一条边连接某单表与其余连通部分\n        for (int mask = 1; mask < total; mask++) {\n            if (popcount[mask] == 1) { connected[mask] = true; continue; }\n            boolean ok = false;\n            int bits = mask;\n            while (bits != 0) {\n                int bit = bits & -bits;\n                int rest = mask ^ bit;\n                int ti = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);\n                if (connected[rest] && hasEdgeTo(ti, rest)) { ok = true; break; }\n                bits ^= bit;\n            }\n            connected[mask] = ok;\n        }\n\n        // 连通分量（BFS over edges）\n        List<int[]> comps = new ArrayList<>();\n        int visited = 0;\n        while (visited != fullMask) {\n            int start = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(fullMask ^ visited);\n            int cmask = 0;\n java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 阶段1 —— 每个连通分量内部，Selinger 风格枚举：\n *     dp[mask] = 该连通表集合上代价最小的计划；\n * Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            memo.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        long considered = 0;\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n\n        // 阶段1：分量内稠密 DP。\n        // 标准做法：按子集大小递增处理每个“连通”子集；对其所有真二分（两侧也连通、\n        // 且有边跨越）取最优。用一个连通子问题（单表）即可经一条边扩展成更大连通集，\n        // 因此不允许分量内笛卡尔积不会漏掉最优连通计划。\n        for (int compMask : componentMasks(comps)) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(compMask) <= 1) continue;\n            // 收集该分量的所有连通子集，按 popcount 升序\n            List<Integer> subsets = new ArrayList<>();\n            int s = (compMask - 1) & compMask;\n            while (s != 0) {\n                if (model.isConnected(s)) subsets.add(s);\n                s = (s - 1) & compMask;\n            }\n            subsets.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n            for (int target : subsets) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(target) == 1) continue; // 扫描已在 memo\n                int sub = (target - 1) & target;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = target ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)) {\n                        List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                        if (!cross.isEmpty()) {\n                            considered++;\n                            combine(memo, sub, rest, cross);\n                        }\n                    }\n                    sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 阶段2：分量间笛卡尔积 DP（以“分量”为原子单位）。\n        // 注意 compDp 必须持有独立的计划对象：直接复用 memo 里的条目会在\n        // 两个分量组合后把“父计划”写回其自身所用的子条目，形成自引用。\n        if (comps.size() > 1) {\n            int[] cms = componentMasks(comps);\n            int compUniverse = 0;\n            for (int c : cms) compUniverse |= c;\n\n            // 枚举所有“若干分量的并集”，按 popcount 排序保证子问题先于父问题解决（n<=8，最多 255 次）\n            List<Integer> unions = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int u = 1; u <= compUniverse; u++) {\n                if ((u & ~compUniverse) == 0 && isUnionOfComponents(u, cms)) unions.add(u);\n            }\n            unions.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n            Map<Integer, OptEntry> compDp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int c : cms) compDp.put(c, memo.get(c)); // 叶子：共享分量最优计划（只读，安全）\n\n            for (int u : unions) {\n                if (compDp.containsKey(u)) continue; // 单分量\n                int sub = (u - 1) & u;\n                OptEntry best = null;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = u ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(sub, cms)\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(rest, cms)) {\n                        OptEntry a = compDp.get(sub);\n                        OptEntry b = compDp.get(rest);\n                        if (a != null && b != null) {\n                            considered++;\n                            Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, new ArrayList<>());\n                            double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                            if (best == null || cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                                    || (Math.abs(cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) {\n                                // 为该组合新建独立的 JoinNode\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, new ArrayList<>());\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                best = new OptEntry(u, j, s, cost);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    sub = (sub - 1) & u;\n                }\n                if (best != null) compDp.put(u, best);\n            }\n            // 只有最终全集（以及各并集）结果写回 memo 用于导出；写回独立对象，不复用叶子引用结构\n            for (Map.Entry<Integer, OptEntry> e : compDp.entrySet()) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(e.getKey()) > 1) memo.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());\n            }\n        }\n\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        OptEntry top = memo.get(full);\n        if (top == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean isUnionOfComponents(int mask, int[] comps) {\n        for (int c : comps) {\n            if ((mask & c) == c) mask &= ~c;\n            else if ((mask & c) != 0) return false;\n        }\n        return mask == 0;\n    }\n\n    private int[] componentMasks(List<int[]> comps) {\n        int[] r = new int[comps.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {\n            int m = 0;\n            for (int t : comps.get(i)) m |= 1 << t;\n            r[i] = m;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    /** 比较一次 (A ⋈ B)，更优则写入 memo。 */\n    private void combine(Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo,\n                         int leftMask, int rightMask, List<Edge> cross) {\n        OptEntry a = memo.get(leftMask);\n        OptEntry b = memo.get(rightMask);\n        if (a == null || b == null) return;\n        Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(leftMask, rightMask, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n        double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n        int key = leftMask | rightMask;\n        OptEntry cur = memo.get(key);\n        if (cur == null || better(cost, s.rowCount, cur)) {\n            JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n            j.estimated = s;\n            j.estimatedCost = cost;\n            memo.put(key, new OptEntry(key, j, s, cost));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private boolean better(double cost, double rows, OptEntry cur) {\n        if (cost < cur.cost - 1e-9) return true;\n        if (cost > cur.cost + 1e-9) return false;\n        return rows < cur.stats.rowCount - t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            memo.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        long considered = 0;\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n\n        // 阶段1：分量内稠密 DP。\n        // 标准做法：按子集大小递增处理每个“连通”子集；对其所有真二分（两侧也连通、\n        // 且有边跨越）取最优。用一个连通子问题（单表）即可经一条边扩展成更大连通集，\n        // 因此不允许分量内笛卡尔积不会漏掉最优连通计划。\n        for (int compMask : componentMasks(comps)) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(compMask) <= 1) continue;\n            // 收集该分量的所有连通子集，按 popcount 升序\n            List<Integer> subsets = new ArrayList<>();\n            int s = (compMask - 1) & compMask;\n            while (s != 0) {\n                if (model.isConnected(s)) subsets.add(s);\n                s = (s - 1) & compMask;\n            }\n            subsets.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n            for (int target : subsets) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(target) <= 1) continue; // 单表扫描已在 memo\n                int sub = (target - 1) & target;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = target ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)) {\n                        List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                        if (!cross.isEmpty()) {\n                            considered++;\n                            combine(memo, sub, rest, cross);\n                        }\n                    }\n                    sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 阶段2：分量间笛卡尔积 DP（以“分量”为原子单位）。\n        // 注意 compDp 必须持有独立的计划对象：直接复用 memo 里的条目会在\n        // 两个分量组合后把“父计划”写回其自身所用的子条目，形成自引用。\n        if (comps.size() > 1) {\n            int[] cms = componentMasks(comps);\n            int compUniverse = 0;\n            for (int c : cms) compUniverse |= c;\n\n            // 枚举所有“若干分量的并集”，按 popcount 排序保证子问题先于父问题解决（n<=8，最多 255 次）\n            List<Integer> unions = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int u = 1; u <= compUniverse; u++) {\n                if ((u & ~compUniverse) == 0 && isUnionOfComponents(u, cms)) unions.add(u);\n            }\n            unions.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n            Map<Integer, OptEntry> compDp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int c : cms) compDp.put(c, memo.get(c)); // 叶子：共享分量最优计划（只读，安全）\n\n            for (int u : unions) {\n                if (compDp.containsKey(u)) continue; // 单分量\n                int sub = (u - 1) & u;\n                OptEntry best = null;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = u ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(sub, cms)\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(rest, cms)) {\n                        OptEntry a = compDp.get(sub);\n                        OptEntry b = compDp.get(rest);\n                        if (a != null && b != null) {\n                            considered++;\n                            Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, new ArrayList<>());\n                            double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                            if (best == null || cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                                    || (Math.abs(cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) {\n                                // 为该组合新建独立的 JoinNode\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, new ArrayList<>());\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                best = new OptEntry(u, j, s, cost);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    sub = (sub - 1) & u;\n                }\n                if (best != null) compDp.put(u, best);\n            }\n            // 只有最终全集（以及各并集）结果写回 memo 用于导出；写回独立对象，不复用叶子引用结构\n            for (Map.Entry<Integer, OptEntry> e : compDp.entrySet()) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(e.getKey()) > 1) memo.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());\n            }\n        }\n\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        OptEntry top = memo.get(full);\n        if (top == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean isUnionOfComponents(int mask, int[] comps) {\n        for (int c : comps) {\n            if ((mask & c) == c) mask &= ~c;\n            else if ((mask & c) != 0) return false;\n        }\n        return mask == 0;\n    }\n\n    private int[] componentMasks(List<int[]> comps) {\n        int[] r = new int[comps.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {\n            int m = 0;\n            for (int t : comps.get(i)) m |= 1 << t;\n            r[i] = m;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    /** 比较一次 (A ⋈ B)，更优则写入 memo。 */\n    private void combine(Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo,\n                         int leftMask, int rightMask, List<Edge> cross) {\n        OptEntry a = memo.get(leftMask);\n        OptEntry b = memo.get(rightMask);\n        if (a == null || b == null) return;\n        Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(leftMask, rightMask, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n        double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n        int key = leftMask | rightMask;\n        OptEntry cur = memo.get(key);\n        if (cur == null || better(cost, s.rowCount, cur)) {\n            JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n            j.estimated = s;\n            j.estimatedCost = cost;\n            memo.put(key, new OptEntry(key, j, s, cost));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private boolean better(double cost, double rows, OptEntry cur) {\n        if (cost < cur.cost - 1e-9) return true;\n        if (cost > cur.cost + 1e-9) return false;\n        return rows < cur.stats.rowCount -
