t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            memo.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        long considered = 0;\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n\n        // 阶段1：分量内稠密 DP。\n        // 标准做法：按子集大小递增处理每个“连通”子集；对其所有真二分（两侧也连通、\n        // 且有边跨越）取最优。用一个连通子问题（单表）即可经一条边扩展成更大连通集，\n        // 因此不允许分量内笛卡尔积不会漏掉最优连通计划。\n        for (int compMask : componentMasks(comps)) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(compMask) <= 1) continue;\n            // 收集该分量的所有连通子集（含分量全集），按 popcount 升序\n            List<Integer> subsets = new ArrayList<>();\n            int s = compMask;\n            do {\n                if (model.isConnected(s)) subsets.add(s);\n                s = (s - 1) & compMask;\n            } while (s != compMask && s != 0);\n            subsets.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n            for (int target : subsets) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(target) <= 1) continue; // 单表扫描已在 memo\n                int sub = (target - 1) & target;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = target ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)) {\n                        List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                        if (!cross.isEmpty()) {\n                            considered++;\n                            combine(memo, sub, rest, cross);\n                        }\n                    }\n                    sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 阶段2：分量间笛卡尔积 DP（以“分量”为原子单位）。\n        // 注意 compDp 必须持有独立的计划对象：直接复用 memo 里的条目会在\n        // 两个分量组合后把“父计划”写回其自身所用的子条目，形成自引用。\n        if (comps.size() > 1) {\n            int[] cms = componentMasks(comps);\n            int compUniverse = 0;\n            for (int c : cms) compUniverse |= c;\n\n            // 枚举所有“若干分量的并集”，按 popcount 排序保证子问题先于父问题解决（n<=8，最多 255 次）\n            List<Integer> unions = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int u = 1; u <= compUniverse; u++) {\n                if ((u & ~compUniverse) == 0 && isUnionOfComponents(u, cms)) unions.add(u);\n            }\n            unions.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n            Map<Integer, OptEntry> compDp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int c : cms) compDp.put(c, memo.get(c)); // 叶子：共享分量最优计划（只读，安全）\n\n            for (int u : unions) {\n                if (compDp.containsKey(u)) continue; // 单分量\n                int sub = (u - 1) & u;\n                OptEntry best = null;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = u ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(sub, cms)\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(rest, cms)) {\n                        OptEntry a = compDp.get(sub);\n                        OptEntry b = compDp.get(rest);\n                        if (a != null && b != null) {\n                            considered++;\n                            Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, new ArrayList<>());\n                            double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                            if (best == null || cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                                    || (Math.abs(cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) {\n                                // 为该组合新建独立的 JoinNode\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, new ArrayList<>());\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                best = new OptEntry(u, j, s, cost);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    sub = (sub - 1) & u;\n                }\n                if (best != null) compDp.put(u, best);\n            }\n            // 只有最终全集（以及各并集）结果写回 memo 用于导出；写回独立对象，不复用叶子引用结构\n            for (Map.Entry<Integer, OptEntry> e : compDp.entrySet()) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(e.getKey()) > 1) memo.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());\n            }\n        }\n\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        OptEntry top = memo.get(full);\n        if (top == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean isUnionOfComponents(int mask, int[] comps) {\n        for (int c : comps) {\n            if ((mask & c) == c) mask &= ~c;\n            else if ((mask & c) != 0) return false;\n        }\n        return mask == 0;\n    }\n\n    private int[] componentMasks(List<int[]> comps) {\n        int[] r = new int[comps.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {\n            int m = 0;\n            for (int t : comps.get(i)) m |= 1 << t;\n            r[i] = m;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    /** 比较一次 (A ⋈ B)，更优则写入 memo。 */\n    private void combine(Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo,\n                         int leftMask, int rightMask, List<Edge> cross) {\n        OptEntry a = memo.get(leftMask);\n        OptEntry b = memo.get(rightMask);\n        if (a == null || b == null) return;\n        Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(leftMask, rightMask, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n        double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n        int key = leftMask | rightMask;\n        OptEntry cur = memo.get(key);\n        if (cur == null || better(cost, s.rowCount, cur)) {\n            JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n            j.estimated = s;\n            j.estimatedCost = cost;\n            memo.put(key, new OptEntry(key, j, s, cost));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private boolean better(double cost, double rows, OptEntry cur) {\n        if (cost < cur.cost - 1e-9) return true;\n        if (cost > cur.cost + 1e-9) return false;\n        return rows < cur.stats.rowCount - java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 基于行数与不同值数（NDV）的代价模型。\n *\n * 基数估计（各等值条件选择率独立假设）：\n *   sel(a = b) = 1 / max(ndv(R.a), ndv(S.b))\n *   |R ⋈ S| = |R| * |S| * Π sel\n * 结果不超过 joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 暴力枚举：对每个表集合递归枚举“全部合法二叉计划”，求最小估计代价，与 DP 比对。\n *\n * 合法计划 = 任意把表集合分成两个非空子集，两侧各取任意合法子计划：\n *   有连接边 => 等值连接；无连接边 => 笛卡尔积。\n * 该空间完整覆盖稠密 DP 与左深 DP。无序二叉计划数（仅按拓扑结构计）按\n *   t(S) = Σ_{A 为 S 的真二分, A &lt; S\\\\A} t(A)·t(S\\\\A)\n * 递推：n=1..8 约为 1,1,3,15,105,945,10395,135135。\n *\n * 最小代价用最优子结构（记忆化）求出——这是不做任何剪枝的朴素 DP；\n * 稠密 Optimizer 的剪枝是“分量内禁止笛卡尔积”，二者相等即证明该剪枝不改变最优值。\n */\npublic final class BruteForce {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    private double[] bestCost;\n    private Stats[] bestStats;\n    private long[] count;\n    private long totalTrees;\n    private long limit;\n    private boolean capped;\n\n    public BruteForce(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided, long maxTrees) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n        this.limit = maxTrees;\n    }\n\n    public static final class Report {\n        public boolean run;\n        public boolean capped;\n        public long planCount;\n        public double minCost;\n        public double topRows;\n        public int tables;\n        public List<String> optimalSplits = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Report enumerate() {\n        int total = 1 << model.n();\n        bestCost = new double[total];\n        bestStats = new Stats[total];\n        count = new long[total];\n        totalTrees = 0;\n        capped = false;\n        java.util.Arrays.fill(bestCost, -1);\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < model.n(); i++) {\n            int mask = 1 << i;\n            Stats s = Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            bestCost[mask] = cm.scanCost(s);\n            bestStats[mask] = s;\n            count[mask] = 1;\n        }\n        double minCost = solve(model.fullMask());\n\n        Report rep = new Report();\n        rep.run = !capped;\n        rep.capped = capped;\n        rep.planCount = totalTrees;\n        rep.minCost = minCost;\n        rep.topRows = bestStats[model.fullMask()].rowCount;\n        rep.tables = model.n();\n        if (rep.run) rep.optimalSplits = traceOptimal(model.fullMask());\n        return rep;\n    }\n\n    /** 返回 mask 上的最小代价；记忆化保存对应统计；超上限即放弃。 */\n    private double solve(int mask) {\n        if (bestCost[mask] >= 0) return bestCost[mask];\n\n        double bc = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        Stats bs = null;\n        long cnt = 0;\n\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                double ca = solve(sub);\n                double cb = solve(rest);\n                if (capped) return Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n\n                Stats stats = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, bestStats[sub], bestStats[rest],\n                        model.crossingEdges(sub, rest));\n                double cost = cm.joinCost(ca, cb, stats);\n                if (cost < bc - 1e-9\n                        || (Math.abs(cost - bc) <= 1e-9\n                            && (bs == null || stats.rowCount < rep.capped = capped;\n        rep.planCount = totalTrees;\n        rep.minCost = minCost;\n        rep.topRows = bestRows[model.fullMask()];\n        rep.tables = model.n();\n        rep.optimalSplits = traceOptimal(model.fullMask(), 0);\n        return rep;\n    }\n\n    /** 返回 mask 上的最小代价；顺带计算计划数，超上限即标记 capped 并放弃。 */\n    private double solve(int mask) {\n        if (count[mask] != 0) return bestCost[mask];\n\n        double bc = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        double br = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        long cnt = 0;\n\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                double ca = solve(sub);\n                double cb = solve(rest);\n                if (capped) return Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n\n                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, statsForBest(sub), statsForBest(rest),\n                        model.crossingEdges(sub, rest));\n                double cost = cm.joinCost(ca, cb, s);\n                if (cost < bc - 1e-9 || (Math.abs(cost - bc) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < br)) {\n                    bc = cost;\n                    br = s.rowCount;\n                }\n                long ways = count[sub] * count[rest];\n                cnt += ways;\n                totalTrees += ways;\n                if (totalTrees > limit) { capped = true; return Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY; }\n            }\n            sub = (sub - 1) & mask;\n        }\n        bestCost[mask] = bc;\n        bestRows[mask] = br;\n        count[mask] = cnt;\n        return bc;\n    }\n\n    private Stats statsForBest(int mask) {\n        if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == 1) {\n            return Optimizer.baseStats(model, Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask), useProvided);\n        }\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, statsForBest(sub), statsForBest(rest),\n                        model.crossingEdges(sub, rest));\n                double cost = cm.joinCost(bestCost[sub], bestCost[rest], s);\n                if (Math.abs(cost - bestCost[mask]) <= 1e-9) return s;\n            }\n            sub = (sub - 1) & mask;\n        }\n        throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：暴力枚举无法重建统计\");\n    }\n\n    /** 以表名列出最优计划在顶层可选择的全部最优分割（验证枚举结果时可读）。 */\n    private List<String> traceOptimal(int mask, int depth) {\n        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == 1) return out;\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, statsForBest(sub), statsForBest(rest),\n                        model.crossingEdges(sub, rest));\n                double cost = cm.joinCost(bestCost[sub], bestCost[rest], s);\n                if (Math.abs(cost - bestCost[mask]) <= 1e-9) {\n                    out.add(names(sub) + \"  ⋈  \" + names(rest)\n                            + (model.crossingEdges(sub, rest).isEmpty() ? \"  (笛卡尔积)\" : \"\"));\n                }\n            }\n            sub = (sub - 1) & mask;\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private String names(int mask) {\n        List<String> l = new ArrayList<>();\n        int bits = mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int b = bits & -bits;\n            l.add(model.table(Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(b)).name);\n            bits ^= b;\n        }\n        return l.toString();\n java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 阶段1 —— 每个连通分量内部，Selinger 风格枚举：\n *     dp[mask] = 该连通表集合上代价最小的计划；\n *     仅当存在连接边跨越两个连通子集时才组合（分量内不产生笛卡尔积）。\n *     复杂度 O(3^n)，n<=8 时最多数百次比较。\n *\n * 阶段2 —— 分量之间无等值条件，只能做笛卡尔积；再次 DP 决定合并顺序，\n *     对应 JoinNode.edgeIds 为空、输出中标记 cartesian=true。\n *     “不允许分量内笛卡尔积”在本代价模型下不改变最优值（由暴力枚举测试证明）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            memo.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        long considered = 0;\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n\n        // 阶段1：分量内稠密 DP。\n        // 标准做法：按子集大小递增处理每个“连通”子集；对其所有真二分（两侧也连通、\n        // 且有边跨越）取最优。用一个连通子问题（单表）即可经一条边扩展成更大连通集，\n        // 因此不允许分量内笛卡尔积不会漏掉最优连通计划。\n        for (int compMask : componentMasks(comps)) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(compMask) <= 1) continue;\n            // 收集该分量的所有连通子集（含分量全集），按 popcount 升序\n            List<Integer> subsets = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int u = 1; u <= compMask; u++) {\n                if ((u & ~compMask) == 0 && model.isConnected(u)) subsets.add(u);\n            }\n            subsets.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 阶段1 —— 每个连通分量内部，Selinger 风格枚举：\n *     dp[mask] = 该连通表集合上代价最小的计划；\n *     仅当存在连接边跨越两个连通子集时才组合（分量内不产生笛卡尔积）。\n *     复杂度 O(3^n)，n<=8 时最多数百次比较。\n *\n * 阶段2 —— 分量之间无等值条件，只能做笛卡尔积；再次 DP 决定合并顺序，\n *     对应 JoinNode.edgeIds 为空、输出中标记 cartesian=true。\n *     “不允许分量内笛卡尔积”在本代价模型下不改变最优值（由暴力枚举测试证明）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            memo.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        long considered = 0;\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n\n        // 阶段1：分量内稠密 DP。枚举每个连通子集 target（>=2 表）的全部非空真二分，\n        // 要求两侧各自连通（其计划已在更小数值的子问题中求出——数值上 sub,rest < target）\n        // 且二分有边跨越。不连通的 target 不属于任何单个分量，跳过；分量间组合在阶段2处理。\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        for (int target = 1; target <= full; target++) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(target) < 2 || !model.isConnected(target)) continue;\n            int sub = (target - 1) & target;\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = target ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                        && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)) {\n                    List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                    if (!cross.isEmpty()) {\n                        considered++;\n                        combine(memo, sub, rest, cross);\n                    }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 阶段2：分量间笛卡尔积 DP（以“分量”为原子单位）。\n        // 注意 compDp 必须持有独立的计划对象：直接复用 memo 里的条目会在\n        // 两个分量组合后把“父计划”写回其自身所用的子条目，形成自引用。\n        if (comps.size() > 1) {\n            int[] cms = componentMasks(comps);\n            int compUniverse = 0;\n            for (int c : cms) compUniverse |= c;\n\n            // 枚举所有“若干分量的并集”，按 popcount 排序保证子问题先于父问题解决（n<=8，最多 255 次）\n            List<Integer> unions = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int u = 1; u <= compUniverse; u++) {\n                if ((u & ~compUniverse) == 0 && isUnionOfComponents(u, cms)) unions.add(u);\n            }\n            unions.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n            Map<Integer, OptEntry> compDp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int c : cms) compDp.put(c, memo.get(c)); // 叶子：共享分量最优计划（只读，安全）\n\n            for (int u : unions) {\n                if (compDp.containsKey(u)) continue; // 单分量\n                int sub = (u - 1) & u;\n                OptEntry best = null;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = u ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(sub, cms)\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(rest, cms)) {\n                        OptEntry a = compDp.get(sub);\n                        OptEntry b = compDp.get(rest);\n                        if (a != null && b != null) {\n                            considered++;\n                            Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, new ArrayList<>());\n                            double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                            if (best == null || cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                                    || (Math.abs(cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) {\n                                // 为该组合新建独立的 JoinNode\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, new ArrayList<>());\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                best = new OptEntry(u, j, s, cost);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    sub = (sub - 1) & u;\n                }\n                if (best != null) compDp.put(u, best);\n            }\n            // 只有最终全集（以及各并集）结果写回 memo 用于导出；写回独立对象，不复用叶子引用结构\n            for (Map.Entry<Integer, OptEntry> e : compDp.entrySet()) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(e.getKey()) > 1) memo.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());\n            }\n        }\n\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        OptEntry top = memo.get(full);\n        if (top == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean isUnionOfComponents(int mask, int[] comps) {\n        for (int c : comps) {\n            if ((mask & c) == c) mask &= ~c;\n            else if ((mask & c) != 0) return false;\n        }\n        return mask == 0;\n    }\n\n    private int[] componentMasks(List<int[]> comps) {\n        int[] r = new int[comps.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {\n            int m = 0;\n            for (int t : comps.get(i)) m |= 1 << t;\n            r[i] = m;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    /** 比较一次 (A ⋈ B)，更优则写入 memo。 */\n    private void combine(Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo,\n                         int leftMask, int rightMask, List<Edge> cross) {\n        OptEntry a = memo.get(leftMask);\n        OptEntry b = memo.get(rightMask);\n        if (a == null || b == null) return;\n        Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(leftMask, rightMask, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n        double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n        int key = leftMask | rightMask;\n        OptEntry cur = memo.get(key);\n        if (cur == null || better(cost, s.rowCount, cur)) {\n            JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n            j.estimated = s;\n            j.estimatedCost = cost;\n            memo.put(key, new OptEntry(key, j, s, cost));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private boolean better(double cost, double rows, OptEntry cur) {\n        if (cost < cur.cost - 1e-9) return true;\n        if (cost > cur.cost + 1e-9) return false;\n        return rows < cur.stats.rowCount -      } else {\n            bushyCompare = new Optimizer(model, cm, useProvided).optimize();\n        }\n\n        // 暴力枚举校验（允许笛卡尔积的全空间最小代价）\n        Map<String, Object> verify = null;\n        if     // 执行\n        Map<String, Object> execution = null;\n        List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (bushy != null) warnings.addAll(bushy.warnings);\n        if (model.execute) collectDiffs(model, plan, diffs);\n            execution.put(\"estimateVsActual\", diffs);\n\n            Stats topActual = plan.actual;\n            Stats topEst = plan.estimated;\n            Map<String, Object> top = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            top.put(\"estimatedRows\", PlanNode.round(topEst.rowCount));\n            top.put(\"actualRows\", (long) topActual.rowCount);\n            top.put(\"estimatedCost\", PlanNode.round(plan.estimatedCost));\n            top.put(\"actualCost\", PlanNode.round(plan.actualCost));\n            top.put(\"rowRatio\", topActual.rowCount == 0\n                    ? null : PlanNode.round(topEst.rowCount / topActual.rowCount));\n            execution.put(\"root\", top);\n\n            // 结果预览\n            long limit = Math.max(0, preview.add(stripQualifiers(er.rows.get(i)));\n            }\n            execution.put(\"preview\", preview);\n            if (er.rows.size() > limit) {\n                execution.put(\"previewTruncated\", true);\n                warnings.add(\"结果共 \" + er.rows.size() + \" 行，仅预览前 \" + limit + \" 行\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        // DP 表导出\n        Map<String, resp.put(\"plan\", plan.toMap(model));\n        resp.put(\"planText\", plan.toTree(model).stripTrailing());\n        resp.put(\"dpTable\", dpDump);\n\n        // 策略对照\n        Map<String, Object> cmp cmp.put(\"leftDeepCost\",\n                PlanNode.round(ldCompare != null ? ldCompare.plan.estimatedCost : leftDeep.plan.estimatedCost));\n        double bushyC = bushy != null ? resp.put(\"execution\", execution);\n        if (!warnings.isEmpty()) resp.put(\"warnings\", warnings);\n        return resp;\n    }\n\n    private void checkExecutable(Model model, List<String> warnings) {\n        List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Table t : model.tables) {\n            if (t.rows.isEmpty()) missing.add(t.name);\n        }\n        if (!missing.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new EngineException(\"以下表没有内联数据（rows 为空），无法实际执行；\"\n                    + \"如需只做代价估计请设置 execute=false：\" + missing);\n        }\n        if 的优化器使用了请求中提供的统计（可能与真实数据不同，\"\n                            + \"用于演示估计偏差）；执行始终基于真实数据\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void collectDiffs(Model model, PlanNode p, out);\n        }\n        if (p.actual != null) {\n            Map<String, Object> d = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            d.put(\"node\", p.nodeType());\n            d.put(\"tables\", p.tableNames(model));\n            d.put(\"estimatedRows\", PlanNode.round(p.estimated.rowCount));\n            d.put(\"actualRows\", (long) p.actual.rowCount);\n            d.put(\"ratio\", p.actual.rowCount == 0 ? null\n                    : PlanNode.round(p.estimated.rowCount / p.actual.rowCount));\n            d.put(\"cartesian\", p.cartesian);\n            out.add(d);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> dumpMemo(Model model,\n                                         Map<Integer, OptEntry> bushyMemo,\n                                         Map<Integer, OptEntry> ldMemo) {\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = bushyMemo != null ? bushyMemo : ldMemo;\n        Map<String, Object> d = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        d.put(\"kind\", bushyMemo != null ? \"bushy-dp (subset)\" : \"left-deep-dp (prefix-set)\");\n        List<Object> entries = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (OptEntry e : memo.values()) entries.add(e.dump(model));\n        d.put(\"entries\", entries);\n        d.put(\"entryCount\", entries.size());\n        return d;\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> stripQualifiers(Map<String, Object> qualified) {\n        Map<String, Object> bare = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> e : qualified.entrySet()) {\n            String k = e.getKey();\n            int idx = k.indexOf('.');\n            bare.put(idx  dp[mask] = 该连通表集合上代价最小的计划集合；\n *     仅当存在连接边跨越两个连通子集时才组合（分量内不产生笛卡尔积）。\n *\n *     经典 System-R DP 只保留一个最小代价计划，但本模型中子计划的“边界列 NDV”\n *     会影响上层连接基数：两个根代价相同、根行数相同但 NDV 不同的计划，\n *     放到更大计划里优劣可能反转。因此每个子问题保留全部\n *     “最小代价（容差 1e-9）且输出统计（行数+各列 NDV）互不相同”的候选\n *     （Pareto/interesting-orders 思想的统计版本），组合时遍历候选对。\n *     n<=8 时候选数很小。\n *\n * 阶段2 —— 分量之间无等值条件，只能做笛卡尔积；再次 DP 决定合并顺序，\n *     对应 JoinNode.edgeIds 为空、输出中标记 cartesian=true。\n *     “不允许分量内笛卡尔积”在本代价模型下不改变最优值（由暴力枚举测试证明）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    /** 同代价候选集合中的一条。 */\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    private Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp;\n    private long considered;\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n        dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        considered = 0;\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            List<Cand> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            one.add(new Cand(scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n            dp.put(1 << i, one);\n        }\n\n        // 阶段1：分量内稠密 DP（跨所有连通子集；分量间不连通的 target 不会有合法分割）\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        for (int target = 1; target <= full; target++) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(target) < 2 || !model.isConnected(target)) continue;\n            List<Cand> best = null;\n            double bestCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n\n            int sub = (target - 1) & target;\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = target ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                        && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)) {\n                    List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                    if (!cross.isEmpty()) {\n                        for (Cand a : dp.get(sub)) {\n                            for (Cand b : dp.get(rest)) {\n                                considered++;\n                                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n                                double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                                if (cost > bestCost + 1e-9) continue;\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                Cand c = new Cand(j, s, cost);\n                                if (cost < bestCost - 1e-9) {\n                                    bestCost = cost;\n                                    best = new ArrayList<>();\n                                    best.add(c);\n                                } else if (statsDiffer(s, best.get(0).stats)) {\n                                    best.add(c); // 同代价、不同统计：保留\n                                }\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n            }\n            if (best != null) dp.put(target, best);\n        }\n\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n\n        // 阶段2：分量间笛卡尔积 DP。分量计划作为叶子候选（取各分量最小代价候选；\n        // 笛卡尔积对各列 NDV 只做 min(ndv,rows)，上层不再有等值边，统计差异不影响\n        // 分量间合并代价，故每分量只需一个最小代价候选）。\n        if (comps.size() > 1) {\n            int[] cms = componentMasks(comps);\n            int compUniverse = 0;\n            for (int c : cms) compUniverse |= c;\n\n            Map<Integer, Cand> compDp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int c : cms) compDp.put(c, cheapest(dp.get(c)));\n\n            List<Integer> unions = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int u = 1; u <= compUniverse; u++) {\n                if ((u & ~compUniverse) == 0 && isUnionOfComponents(u, cms)) unions.add(u);\n            }\n            unions.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n\n            for (int u : unions) {\n                if (compDp.containsKey(u)) continue;\n                Cand best = null;\n                int sub = (u - 1) & u;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = u ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(sub, cms)\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(rest, cms)) {\n                        Cand a = compDp.get(sub);\n                        Cand b = compDp.get(rest);\n                        if (a != null && b != null) {\n                            considered++;\n                            Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, new ArrayList<>());\n                            double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                            if (best == null || cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                                    || (Math.abs(cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9\n                                        && s.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) {\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, new ArrayList<>());\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                best = new Cand(j, s, cost);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    sub = (sub - 1) & u;\n                }\n                if (best != null) compDp.put(u, best);\n            }\n            // 写回 dp（独立对象，避免与分量叶子共享可变结构）\n            for (Map.Entry<Integer, Cand> e : compDp.entrySet()) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(e.getKey()) > 1) {\n                    List<Cand> l = new ArrayList<>();\n                    l.add(e.getValue());\n                    dp.put(e.getKey(), l);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<Cand> topCands = dp.get(full);\n        if (topCands == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n        // 展示时取最小代价、最小根行数者\n        Cand top = topCands.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : topCands) {\n            if (c.cost < top.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - top.cost) <= 1e-9 && c.stats.rowCount < top.stats.rowCount)) {\n                top = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 导出 memo（每个子问题展示选中的代表条目）\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memoDump = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<Cand>> e : dp.entrySet()) {\n            Cand c = cheapest(e.getValue());\n            memoDump.put(e.getKey(), new OptEntry(e.getKey(), c.plan, c.stats, c.cost));\n        }\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memoDump;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private Cand cheapest(List<Cand> cands) {\n        Cand best = cands.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : cands) {\n            if (c.cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9\n                        && c.stats.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) best = c;\n        }\n        return best;\n    }\n\n    private boolean statsDiffer(Stats a, Stats b) {\n        if (Math.abs(a.rowCount - b.rowCount) > 1e-9) return true;\n        if (!a.ndv.keySet().equals(b.ndv.keySet())) return true;\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Double> e : a.ndv.entrySet()) {\n            if (Math.abs(e.getValue() - b.ndv.get(e.getKey())) > 1e-9) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean isUnionOfComponents(int mask, int[] comps) {\n        for (int c : comps) {\n            if ((mask & c) == c) mask &= ~c;\n            else if ((mask & c) != 0) return false;\n        }\n        return mask == 0;\n    }\n\n    private int[] componentMasks(List<int[]> comps) {\n        int[] r = new int[comps.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {\n            int m = 0;\n            for (int t : comps.get(i)) m |= 1 << t;\n            r[i] = m;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_b0c501d383e08a64f6121e6a","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":746,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":126776,"output_tokens":3074,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_6n27elptci5lbt379c5a8owb":{"content":"package joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 阶段1 —— 每个连通分量内部，Selinger 风格枚举：\n *     dp[mask] = 该连通表集合上代价最小的计划集合；\n *     仅当存在连接边跨越两个连通子集时才组合（分量内不产生笛卡尔积）。\n *\n *     经典 System-R DP 只保留一个最小代价计划，但本模型中子计划的“边界列 NDV”\n *     会影响上层连接基数：两个根代价相同、根行数相同但 NDV 不同的计划，\n *     放到更大计划里优劣可能反转。因此每个子问题保留全部\n *     “最小代价（容差 1e-9）且输出统计（行数+各列 NDV）互不相同”的候选\n *     （Pareto/interesting-orders 思想的统计版本），组合时遍历候选对。\n *     n<=8 时候选数很小。\n *\n * 阶段2 —— 分量之间无等值条件，只能做笛卡尔积；再次 DP 决定合并顺序，\n *     对应 JoinNode.edgeIds 为空、输出中标记 cartesian=true。\n *     “不允许分量内笛卡尔积”在本代价模型下不改变最优值（由暴力枚举测试证明）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    /** 同代价候选集合中的一条。 */\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    private Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp;\n    private long considered;\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n        dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        considered = 0;\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            List<Cand> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            one.add(new Cand(scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n            dp.put(1 << i, one);\n        }\n\n        // 阶段1：分量内稠密 DP（跨所有连通子集；分量间不连通的 target 不会有合法分割）\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        for (int target = 1; target <= full; target++) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(target) < 2 || !model.isConnected(target)) continue;\n            List<Cand> best = null;\n            double bestCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n\n            int sub = (target - 1) & target;\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = target ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                        && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)) {\n                    List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                    if (!cross.isEmpty()) {\n                        for (Cand a : dp.get(sub)) {\n                            for (Cand b : dp.get(rest)) {\n                                considered++;\n                                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n                                double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                                if (cost > bestCost + 1e-9) continue;\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                Cand c = new Cand(j, s, cost);\n                                if (cost < bestCost - 1e-9) {\n                                    bestCost = cost;\n sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n            }\n            if (best != null) dp.put(target, best);\n        }\n\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n\n        // 阶段2：分量间笛卡尔积 DP。分量计划作为叶子候选（取各分量最小代价候选；\n        // 笛卡尔积对各列 NDV 只做 min(ndv,rows)，上层不再有等值边，统计差异不影响\n        // 分量间合并代价，故每分量只需一个最小代价候选）。\n        if (comps.size() > 1) {\n            int[] cms = componentMasks(comps);\n            int compUniverse = 0;\n            for (int c : cms) compUniverse |= c;\n\n            Map<Integer, Cand> compDp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int c : cms) compDp.put(c, cheapest(dp.get(c)));\n\n            List<Integer> unions = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int u = 1; u <= compUniverse; u++) {\n                if ((u & ~compUniverse) == 0 && isUnionOfComponents(u, cms)) unions.add(u);\n            }\n            unions.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n\n            for (int u : unions) {\n                if (compDp.containsKey(u)) continue;\n                Cand best = null;\n                int sub = (u - 1) & u;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = u ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(sub, cms)\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(rest, cms)) {\n                        Cand a = compDp.get(sub);\n                        Cand b = compDp.get(rest);\n                        if (a != null && b != null) {\n                            considered++;\n                            Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, new ArrayList<>());\n                            double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                            if (best == null || cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                                    || (Math.abs(cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9\n                                        && s.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) {\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, new ArrayList<>());\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                best = new Cand(j, s, cost);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    sub = (sub - 1) & u;\n                }\n                if (best != null) compDp.put(u, best);\n            }\n            // 写回 dp（独立对象，避免与分量叶子共享可变结构）\n            for (Map.Entry<Integer, Cand> e : compDp.entrySet()) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(e.getKey()) > 1) {\n                    List<Cand> l = new ArrayList<>();\n                    l.add(e.getValue());\n                    dp.put(e.getKey(), l);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<Cand> topCands = dp.get(full);\n        if (topCands == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n        // 展示时取最小代价、最小根行数者\n        Cand top = topCands.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : topCands) {\n            if (c.cost < top.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - top.cost) <= 1e-9 && c.stats.rowCount < top.stats.rowCount)) {\n                top = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 导出 memo（每个子问题展示选中的代表条目）\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memoDump = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<Cand>> e : dp.entrySet()) {\n            Cand c = cheapest(e.getValue());\n            memoDump.put(e.getKey(), new OptEntry(e.getKey(), c.plan, c.stats, c.cost));\n        }\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memoDump;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private Cand cheapest(List<Cand> cands) {\n        Cand best = cands.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : cands) {\n            if (c.cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9\n                        && c.stats.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) best = c;\n        }\n        return best;\n    }\n\n    private boolean statsDiffer(Stats a, Stats b) {\n        if (Math.abs(a.rowCount - b.rowCount) > 1e-9) return true;\n        if (!a.ndv.keySet().equals(b.ndv.keySet())) return true;\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Double> e : a.ndv.entrySet()) {\n            if (Math.abs(e.getValue() - b.ndv.get(e.getKey())) > 1e-9) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean isUnionOfComponents(int mask, int[] comps) {\n        for (int c : comps) {\n            if ((mask & c) == c) mask &= ~c;\n            else if ((mask & c) != 0) return false;\n        }\n        return mask == 0;\n    }\n\n    private int[] componentMasks(List<int[]> comps) {\n        int[] r = new int[comps.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {\n            int m = 0;\n            for (int t : comps.get(i)) m |= 1 << t;\n            r[i] = m;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n }"]}],"originalFile":"package joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 阶段1 —— 每个连通分量内部，Selinger 风格枚举：\n *     dp[mask] = 该连通表集合上代价最小的计划；\n *     仅当存在连接边跨越两个连通子集时才组合（分量内不产生笛卡尔积）。\n *     复杂度 O(3^n)，n<=8 时最多数百次比较。\n *\n * 阶段2 —— 分量之间无等值条件，只能做笛卡尔积；再次 DP 决定合并顺序，\n *     对应 JoinNode.edgeIds 为空、输出中标记 cartesian=true。\n *     “不允许分量内笛卡尔积”在本代价模型下不改变最优值（由暴力枚举测试证明）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            memo.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        long considered = 0;\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n\n        // 阶段1：分量内稠密 DP。枚举每个连通子集 target（>=2 表）的全部非空真二分，\n        // 要求两侧各自连通（其计划已在更小数值的子问题中求出——数值上 sub,rest < target）\n        // 且二分有边跨越。不连通的 target 不属于任何单个分量，跳过；分量间组合在阶段2处理。\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        for (int target = 1; target <= full; target++) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(target) < 2 || !model.isConnected(target)) continue;\n            int sub = (target - 1) & target;\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = target ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                        && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)) {\n                    List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                    if (!cross.isEmpty()) {\n                        considered++;\n                        combine(memo, sub, rest, cross);\n                    }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 阶段2：分量间笛卡尔积 DP（以“分量”为原子单位）。\n        // 注意 compDp 必须持有独立的计划对象：直接复用 memo 里的条目会在\n        // 两个分量组合后把“父计划”写回其自身所用的子条目，形成自引用。\n        if (comps.size() > 1) {\n            int[] cms = componentMasks(comps);\n            int compUniverse = 0;\n            for (int c : cms) compUniverse |= c;\n\n            // 枚举所有“若干分量的并集”，按 popcount 排序保证子问题先于父问题解决（n<=8，最多 255 次）\n            List<Integer> unions = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int u = 1; u <= compUniverse; u++) {\n                if ((u & ~compUniverse) == 0 && isUnionOfComponents(u, cms)) unions.add(u);\n            }\n            unions.sort((x, y) -> {\n                int cx = Integer.bitCount(x), cy = Integer.bitCount(y);\n                return cx != cy ? Integer.compare(cx, cy) : Integer.compare(x, y);\n            });\n            Map<Integer, OptEntry> compDp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (int c : cms) compDp.put(c, memo.get(c)); // 叶子：共享分量最优计划（只读，安全）\n\n            for (int u : unions) {\n                if (compDp.containsKey(u)) continue; // 单分量\n                int sub = (u - 1) & u;\n                OptEntry best = null;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = u ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(sub, cms)\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(rest, cms)) {\n                        OptEntry a = compDp.get(sub);\n                        OptEntry b = compDp.get(rest);\n                        if (a != null && b != null) {\n                            considered++;\n                            Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, new ArrayList<>());\n                            double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                            if (best == null || cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                                    || (Math.abs(cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) {\n                                // 为该组合新建独立的 JoinNode\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, new ArrayList<>());\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                best = new OptEntry(u, j, s, cost);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    sub = (sub - 1) & u;\n                }\n                if (best != null) compDp.put(u, best);\n            }\n            // 只有最终全集（以及各并集）结果写回 memo 用于导出；写回独立对象，不复用叶子引用结构\n            for (Map.Entry<Integer, OptEntry> e : compDp.entrySet()) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(e.getKey()) > 1) memo.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());\n            }\n        }\n\n        OptEntry top = memo.get(full);\n        if (top == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean isUnionOfComponents(int mask, int[] comps) {\n        for (int c : comps) {\n            if ((mask & c) == c) mask &= ~c;\n            else if ((mask & c) != 0) return false;\n        }\n        return mask == 0;\n    }\n\n    private int[] componentMasks(List<int[]> comps) {\n        int[] r = new int[comps.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {\n            int m = 0;\n            for (int t : comps.get(i)) m |= 1 << t;\n            r[i] = m;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    /** 比较一次 (A ⋈ B)，更优则写入 memo。 */\n    private void combine(Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo,\n                         int leftMask, int rightMask, List<Edge> cross) {\n        OptEntry a = memo.get(leftMask);\n        OptEntry b = memo.get(rightMask);\n        if (a == null || b == null) return;\n        Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(leftMask, rightMask, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n        double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n        int key = leftMask | rightMask;\n        OptEntry cur = memo.get(key);\n        if (cur == null || better(cost, s.rowCount, cur)) {\n            JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n            j.estimated = s;\n            j.estimatedCost = cost;\n            memo.put(key, new OptEntry(key, j, s, cost));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private boolean better(double cost, double rows, OptEntry cur) {\n        if (cost < cur.cost - 1e-9) return true;\n        if (cost > cur.cost + 1e-9) return false;\n        return rows < cur.stats.rowCount - 1e-9;\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"131df8f2-48f2-4154-989b-43e5f99d3d31","session_id":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/a","sessionId":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-a","slug":"validated-singing-puddle"}

{"parentUuid":"73d84b21-0900-4165-81ae-ba039d5e681b","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"**找到真正的根因了**：BF 的最优分割是 `{t0} ⋈ {t1..t5}`，其中 `{t1..t5}` 本身不连通——也就是说**在某个分割处做一次笛卡尔积，反而让整体代价更低**。我之前“分量内排除笛卡尔积不改变最优值”的假设在本代价模型下是错的！\n\n数学验证：这完全可能，因为笛卡尔积的代价是行数乘积，而先做小笛卡尔积可能让后续等值连接的输入变小。修复——让 DP 允许所有二分（用交叉边是否为空自然区分 hash/cartesian），不要求子集连通：\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_583b54b2a980aa3f3e499d65","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1272,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":132920,"output_tokens":2079,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"f4582301-7e6a-45d6-8499-f1cd4e29fec9","timestamp":"2026-09-23T03:55:33.321Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/a","sessionId":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-a","slug":"validated-singing-puddle"}

target <= full; target++) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(target) < 2 || !model.isConnected(target)) continue;\n            List<Cand> best = null;\n            double bestCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n\n            int sub = (target - 1) & target;\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = target ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                        && model.isConnected(sub) && model.isConnected(rest)) {\n                    List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                    if (!cross.isEmpty()) {\n                        for (Cand a : dp.get(sub)) {\n                            for (Cand b : dp.get(rest)) {\n                                considered++;\n                                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n                                double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                                if (cost > bestCost + 1e-9) continue;\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                Cand c = new Cand(j, s, cost);\n                                if (cost < bestCost - 1e-9) {\n                                    bestCost = cost;\n                                    best = new ArrayList<>();\n                                    best.add(c);\n                                } else if (statsDiffer(s, best.get(0).stats)) {\n                                    best.add(c); 1) & u;\n                while (sub != 0) {\n                    int rest = u ^ sub;\n                    if (rest != 0 && sub < rest\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(sub, cms)\n                            && isUnionOfComponents(rest, cms)) {\n                        Cand a = compDp.get(sub);\n                        Cand b = compDp.get(rest);\n                        if (a != null && b != null) {\n                            considered++;\n                            Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, new ArrayList<>());\n                            double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                            if (best == null || cost < best.cost - List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n {"parentUuid":"a1168afc-7e65-4e18-bb26-b6b361aabe64","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_knne57cs1ogrc35v3tuof806","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/a/src/main/java/joinorder/LeftDeepOptimizer.java","content":"package joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 左深连接顺序优化器（对照基线）。\n *\n * 状态 = 已接入的表集合；每一步只能把“一张”新基表放到右侧，与当前整棵左深树连接：\n *   新表与当前集合之间有边 => 等值连接；无边 => 笛卡尔积（笛卡尔积仍保持左深形状）。\n * 与稠密优化器一样保留“同代价、不同统计”的多个候选，避免边界 NDV 偏好反转。\n *\n * 复杂度 O(n²·2^n ·候选数)。左深是稠密搜索空间的真子集，故其最优代价 >= 稠密最优。\n */\npublic final class LeftDeepOptimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public LeftDeepOptimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        int n = model.n();\n        int total = 1 << n;\n        Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        Map<Integer, ScanNode> scans = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        long considered = 0;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            scans.put(1 << i, scan);\n            List<Cand> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            one.add(new Cand(scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n            dp.put(1 << i, one);\n        }\n\n        for (int mask = 1; mask < total; mask++) {\n            List<Cand> cands = dp.get(mask);\n            if (cands == null) continue;\n            int remaining = model.fullMask() ^ mask;\n            int bits = remaining;\n            while (bits != 0) {\n                int bit = bits & -bits;\n                int ti = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);\n                ScanNode rightScan = scans.get(bit);\n                List<Edge> cross = edgesFromMaskToTable(mask, ti);\n\n                List<Cand> out = null;\n                double bestCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n                for (Cand cur : cands) {\n                    considered++;\n                    Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(mask, bit, cur.stats, rightScan.estimated, cross);\n                    double cost = cm.joinCost(cur.cost, rightScan.estimatedCost, s);\n                    if (cost > bestCost + 1e-9) continue;\n                    JoinNode j = new JoinNode(cur.plan, rightScan, edgeIds(cross));\n                    j.estimated = s;\n                    j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                    Cand c = new Cand(j, s, cost);\n                    int key = mask | bit;\n                    if (cost < bestCost - 1e-9) {\n                        bestCost = cost;\n                        out = new ArrayList<>();\n                        out.add(c);\n                    } else if (out != null && statsDiffer(s, out.get(0).stats)) {\n                        out.add(c);\n                    } else if (out == null) {\n                        bestCost = cost;\n                        out = new ArrayList<>();\n                        out.add(c);\n                    }\n                }\n                if (out != null) {\n                    int key = mask | bit;\n                    dp.merge(key, out, (oldV, newV) -> mergeCands(oldV, newV));\n                }\n                bits ^= bit;\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<Cand> tops = dp.get(model.fullMask());\n        if (tops == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：左深规划失败\");\n        Cand top = tops.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : tops) {\n            if (c.cost < top.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - top.cost) <= 1e-9\n                        && c.stats.rowCount < top.stats.rowCount)) top = c;\n        }\n\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<Cand>> e : dp.entrySet()) {\n            Cand c = e.getValue().get(0);\n            memo.put(e.getKey(), new OptEntry(e.getKey(), c.plan, c.stats, c.cost));\n        }\n\n        Result r = new Result();\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        int[] cj = {0};\n        countCj(top.plan, cj);\n        r.cartesianJoins = cj[0];\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private List<Cand> mergeCands(List<Cand> a, List<Cand> b) {\n        // 两个来源到达同一 mask：保留较小代价集合里的统计不同候选\n        double ma = minCost(a), mb = minCost(b);\n        List<Cand> keep = ma <= mb ? a : b;\n        double min = Math.min(ma, mb);\n        List<Cand> r = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Cand c : keep) {\n            if (c.cost <= min + 1e-9) {\n                boolean dup = false;\n                for (Cand x : r) {\n                    if (!statsDiffer(c.stats, x.stats)) { dup = true; break; }\n                }\n                if (!dup) r.add(c);\n            }\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private double minCost(List<Cand> l) {\n        double m = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        for (Cand c : l) m = Math.min(m, c.cost);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private boolean statsDiffer(Stats a, Stats b) {\n        if (Math.abs(a.rowCount - b.rowCount) > 1e-9) return true;\n        if (!a.ndv.keySet().equals(b.ndv.keySet())) return true;\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Double> e : a.ndv.entrySet()) {\n            if (Math.abs(e.getValue() - b.ndv.get(e.getKey())) > 1e-9) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private List<Edge> edgesFromMaskToTable(int mask, int tableIdx) {\n        List<Edge> r = new ArrayList<>();\n        int bits = mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int bit = bits & -bits;\n            int other = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);\n            Edge e = model.edgeBetween(other, tableIdx);\n            if (e != j.estimated = s;\n                    j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                    Cand c = new Cand(j, s, cost);\n                    int key = mask | bit;\n                    if (cost < bestCost - out.get(0).stats)) {\n                        out.add(c);\n                    } else if (out == null) {\n                        bestCost = cost;\n                        out = new ArrayList<>();\n java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 左深连接顺序优化器（对照基线）。\n *\n * 状态 = 已经接入的表集合；每次只能把“一张”新表放到右侧与当前整棵左深树连接。\n * 新表必须通过连接边与当前集合相连（当前集合内不做笛卡尔积）；\n * 连接图断开时，不同分量之间的接入点同样是笛卡尔积并予以标记。\n *\n * 复杂度 O(n·2^n)，结果用于和稠密 DP 对比、展示稠密计划的优势。\n */\npublic final class LeftDeepOptimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public LeftDeepOptimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        int n = model.n();\n        int total = 1 << n;\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        long considered = 0;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            dp.put(1 << i, new OptEntry(1 << i, scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n        }\n\n        for (int mask = 1; mask < total; mask++) {\n            OptEntry cur = dp.get(mask);\n            if (cur == null) continue;\n            int remaining = model.fullMask() ^ mask;\n            int bits = remaining;\n            while (bits != 0) {\n                int bit = bits & -bits;\n                int ti = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);\n                int rightMask = bit;\n                List<Edge> cross = edgesFromMaskToTable(mask, ti);\n                considered++;\n                Stats rs = Optimizer.baseStats(model, ti, useProvided);\n                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(mask, rightMask, cur.stats, rs, cross);\n                double cost = cm.joinCost(cur.cost, rs.rowCount, s);\n                int key = mask | bit;\n                OptEntry existing = dp.get(key);\n                ScanNode rightScan = (ScanNode) dp.get(bit).plan;\n                if (existing == null || cost < existing.cost - 1e-9\n                        || (Math.abs(cost - existing.cost) <= 1e-9 && s.rowCount < existing.stats.rowCount)) {\n                    JoinNode j = new JoinNode(cur.plan, rightScan, edgeIds(cross));\n                    j.estimated = s;\n                    j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                    dp.put(key, new OptEntry(key, j, s, cost));\n                }\n                bits ^= bit;\n            }\n        }\n\n        OptEntry top = dp.get(model.fullMask());\n        if (top == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：左深规划失败\");\n        Result r = new Result();\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = dp;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        int[] cj = {0};\n        countCj(top.plan, cj);\n        r.cartesianJoins = cj[0];\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private List<Edge> edgesFromMaskToTable(int mask, int tableIdx) {\n        List<Edge> r = new ArrayList<>();\n        int bits = mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int bit = bits & -bits;\n            int other = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);\n            Edge e = model.edgeBetween(other, tableIdx);\n            if (e != null) r.add(e);\n            bits ^= bit;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private void countCj(PlanNode p, int[] c) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) c[0]++;\n            countCj(j.left, c);\n            countCj(j.right, c);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e93a8ea3-939b-47b5-9fb2-ed4a808c5030","session_id":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/a","sessionId":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-a","slug":"validated-singing-puddle"}

}\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n            }\n            if (best != null) dp.put(target, best);\n        }\n\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n
