java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 左深连接顺序优化器（对照基线）。\n *\n * 状态 = 已接入的表集合；每一步只能把“一张”新基表放到右侧，与当前整棵左深树连接：\n *   新表与当前集合之间有边 => 等值连接；无边 => 笛卡尔积（笛卡尔积仍保持左深形状）。\n * 与稠密优化器一样保留“同代价、不同统计”的多个候选，避免边界 NDV 偏好反转。\n *\n * 复杂度 O(n²·2^n ·候选数)。左深是稠密搜索空间的真子集，故其最优代价 >= 稠密最优。\n */\npublic final class LeftDeepOptimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public LeftDeepOptimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        int n = model.n();\n        int total = 1 << n;\n        Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        Map<Integer, ScanNode> scans = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        long considered = 0;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            scans.put(1 << i, scan);\n            List<Cand> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            one.add(new Cand(scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n            dp.put(1 << i, one);\n        }\n\n        for (int mask = 1; mask < total; mask++) {\n            List<Cand> cands = dp.get(mask);\n            if (cands == null) continue;\n            int remaining = model.fullMask() ^ mask;\n            int bits = remaining;\n            while (bits != 0) {\n                int bit = bits & -bits;\n                int ti = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);\n                ScanNode rightScan = scans.get(bit);\n                List<Edge> cross = edgesFromMaskToTable(mask, ti);\n\n                List<Cand> out = null;\n                double bestCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n                for (Cand cur : cands) {\n                    considered++;\n                    Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(mask, bit, cur.stats, rightScan.estimated, cross);\n                    double cost = cm.joinCost(cur.cost, rightScan.estimatedCost, s);\n                    if (cost > bestCost + 1e-9) continue;\n                    JoinNode j = new JoinNode(cur.plan, rightScan, edgeIds(cross));\n                    j.estimated = s;\n                    j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                    Cand c = new Cand(j, s, cost);\n                    int key = mask | bit;\n                    if (cost < bestCost - 1e-9) {\n                        bestCost = cost;\n                        out = new ArrayList<>();\n                        out.add(c);\n                    } else if (out != null && statsDiffer(s, out.get(0).stats)) {\n                        out.add(c);\n                    } else if (out == null) {\n                        bestCost = cost;\n                        out = new ArrayList<>();\n                        out.add(c);\n                    }\n                }\n                if (out != null) {\n                    int key = mask | bit;\n                    dp.merge(key, out, (oldV, newV) -> mergeCands(oldV, newV));\n                }\n                bits ^= bit;\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<Cand> tops = dp.get(model.fullMask());\n        if (tops == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：左深规划失败\");\n        Cand top = tops.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : tops) {\n            if (c.cost < top.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - top.cost) <= 1e-9\n                        && c.stats.rowCount < top.stats.rowCount)) top = c;\n        }\n\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<Cand>> e : dp.entrySet()) {\n            Cand c = e.getValue().get(0);\n            memo.put(e.getKey(), new OptEntry(e.getKey(), c.plan, c.stats, c.cost));\n        }\n\n        Result r = new Result();\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        int[] cj = {0};\n        countCj(top.plan, cj);\n        r.cartesianJoins = cj[0];\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private List<Cand> mergeCands(List<Cand> a, List<Cand> b) {\n        // 两个来源到达同一 mask：保留较小代价集合里的统计不同候选\n        double ma = minCost(a), mb = minCost(b);\n        List<Cand> keep = ma <= mb ? a : b;\n        double min = Math.min(ma, mb);\n        List<Cand> r = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Cand c : keep) {\n            if (c.cost <= min + 1e-9) {\n                boolean dup = false;\n                for (Cand x : r) {\n                    if (!statsDiffer(c.stats, x.stats)) { dup = true; break; }\n                }\n                if (!dup) r.add(c);\n            }\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private double minCost(List<Cand> l) {\n        double m = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        for (Cand c : l) m = Math.min(m, c.cost);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private boolean statsDiffer(Stats a, Stats b) {\n        if (Math.abs(a.rowCount - b.rowCount) > 1e-9) return true;\n        if (!a.ndv.keySet().equals(b.ndv.keySet())) return true;\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Double> e : a.ndv.entrySet()) {\n            if (Math.abs(e.getValue() - b.ndv.get(e.getKey())) > 1e-9) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private List<Edge> edgesFromMaskToTable(int mask, int tableIdx) {\n        List<Edge> r = new ArrayList<>();\n        int bits = mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int bit = bits & -bits;\n            int other = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);\n            Edge e = model.edgeBetween(other, tableIdx);\n            if (e != null) r.add(e);\n            bits ^= bit;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private void countCj(PlanNode p, int[] c) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) c[0]++;\n            countCj(j.left, c);\n            countCj(j.right, c);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":72,"oldLines":9,"newStart":72,"newLines":11,"lines":["                 int ti = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);"," paretoPrune(all));\n        }","originalFile":"package joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 单一 DP：dp[mask] = 表集合 mask 上代价最小的计划集合。枚举 mask 的全部非空真二分：\n *   二分跨越连接边 => 等值连接（使用该边上的全部谓词）；\n *   二分不跨越任何边 => 笛卡尔积。\n * 复杂度 O(3^n ·候选数²)，n<=8。\n *\n * 语义安全性：仅当二分不跨越任何连接边时才生成笛卡尔积节点，因此不会丢失谓词\n * （跨边的等值条件要么在两侧子树内部施加，要么在本次等值连接施加）。\n * 连接图的连通分量之间没有边，其顶层组合必然是笛卡尔积，计划中标记 cartesian=true；\n * 但连通分量“内部”的计划也可能包含一次降低总代价的中间笛卡尔积（此时该次分割\n * 同样不跨越任何边，语义合法）——这一可能性由全空间暴力枚举测试验证必须保留。\n *\n * 经典 System-R DP 只保留一个最小代价计划，但子计划的“边界列 NDV”会影响上层\n * 连接基数：根代价相同而 NDV 不同的两个计划，放到更大计划里优劣可能反转。\n * 因此每个子问题保留全部“最小代价（容差内）且输出统计互不相同”的候选，\n * 组合时遍历候选对（Pareto/interesting-order 思想的统计版本，n<=8 候选极少）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    /** 同代价候选集合中的一条。 */\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    private Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp;\n    private long considered;\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n        dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        considered = 0;\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            List<Cand> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            one.add(new Cand(scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n            dp.put(1 << i, one);\n        }\n\n        // 阶段1：稠密 DP。枚举每个表集合 target（>=2 表）的全部非空真二分：\n        //   有边跨越 => 等值连接；无边跨越 => 该次组合是笛卡尔积。\n        // 注意不能在“全局连通分量”内部禁止笛卡尔积：即使连接图整体连通，\n        // 最优计划也可能在中间步骤先做一次小规模笛卡尔积（本代价模型下经验证成立，\n        // 见 BruteForce 对 200+ 随机图的全空间枚举）。代价模型对笛卡尔积按行数\n        // 乘积计费，因此 DP 自然只会在其确实降低总代价时选择它。\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        for (int target = 1; target <= full; target++) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(target) < 2) continue;\n            List<Cand> best = null;\n            double bestCost = statsDiffer(Stats a, Stats b) {","originalFile":"package joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 单一 DP：dp[mask] = 表集合 mask 上代价最小的计划集合。枚举 mask 的全部非空真二分：\n *   二分跨越连接边 => 等值连接（使用该边上的全部谓词）；\n *   二分不跨越任何边 => 笛卡尔积。\n * 复杂度 O(3^n ·候选数²)，n<=8。\n *\n * 语义安全性：仅当二分不跨越任何连接边时才生成笛卡尔积节点，因此不会丢失谓词\n * （跨边的等值条件要么在两侧子树内部施加，要么在本次等值连接施加）。\n * 连接图的连通分量之间没有边，其顶层组合必然是笛卡尔积，计划中标记 cartesian=true；\n * 但连通分量“内部”的计划也可能包含一次降低总代价的中间笛卡尔积（此时该次分割\n * 同样不跨越任何边，语义合法）——这一可能性由全空间暴力枚举测试验证必须保留。\n *\n * 经典 System-R DP 只保留一个最小代价计划，但子计划的“边界列 NDV”会影响上层\n * 连接基数：根代价相同而 NDV 不同的两个计划，放到更大计划里优劣可能反转。\n * 因此每个子问题保留全部“最小代价（容差内）且输出统计互不相同”的候选，\n * 组合时遍历候选对（Pareto/interesting-order 思想的统计版本，n<=8 候选极少）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    /** 同代价候选集合中的一条。 */\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    private Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp;\n    private long considered;\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n        dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        considered = 0;\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new {"parentUuid":"07becd8b-7819-4838-99d9-14a6482c682b","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"等等，我的支配判定声称“NDV 更小不更差”——但在 `max(ndvL, ndvR)` 分母中，你这一侧 NDV 更小**可能更差**（若对方 NDV 大，你的小 NDV 不起作用；若对方小，你的 NDV 反而是分母）。这不是单调关系。安全的剪枝只有：\n\n**保留所有候选**（n≤8 时组合数有界吗？）——其实最简单且保证正确的是不做 NDV 支配剪枝，只对（cost 相同且 stats 完全相同）去重，另外对“代价严格更高且行数严格更高”这种安全支配剪枝。但要保证找到全局最优，真正安全的 Pareto 维度是 **(cost, rowCount)** 加上 NDV 全集不可比较。采用最保守策略：\n\n- 丢弃被严格安全支配者：cost ≤、rows ≤ 且每个 NDV **≥** 或 ≤ 的论证不可靠 → 干脆只按完整统计去重，不做 NDV 剪枝。\n\n检查候选规模是否可控：\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_368fab045bd479b064d2c47d","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1128,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":148280,"output_tokens":1443,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"73ab2ff9-1ba7-4642-a006-5acb027cb151","timestamp":"2026-09-23T04:09:40.434Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/a","sessionId":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-a","slug":"validated-singing-puddle"}

           if (!dup) target.add(c);\n                }\n                bits ^= bit;\n            }\n        }","originalFile":"package joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 左深连接顺序优化器（对照基线）。\n *\n * 状态 = 已接入的表集合；每一步只能把“一张”新基表放到右侧，与当前整棵左深树连接：\n *   新表与当前集合之间有边 => 等值连接；无边 => 笛卡尔积（笛卡尔积仍保持左深形状）。\n * 与稠密优化器一样保留“同代价、不同统计”的多个候选，避免边界 NDV 偏好反转。\n *\n * 复杂度 O(n²·2^n ·候选数)。左深是稠密搜索空间的真子集，故其最优代价 >= 稠密最优。\n */\npublic final class LeftDeepOptimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public LeftDeepOptimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        int n = model.n();\n        int total = 1 << n;\n        Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        Map<Integer, ScanNode> scans = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        long considered = 0;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            scans.put(1 << i, scan);\n            List<Cand> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            one.add(new Cand(scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n            dp.put(1 << i, one);\n        }\n\n        for (int mask = 1; mask < total; mask++) {\n            List<Cand> cands = dp.get(mask);\n            if (cands == null) continue;\n            int remaining = model.fullMask() ^ mask;\n            int bits = remaining;\n            while (bits != 0) {\n                int bit = bits & -bits;\n                int ti = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);\n                ScanNode rightScan = scans.get(bit);\n                List<Edge> cross = edgesFromMaskToTable(mask, ti);\n                int key = mask | bit;\n                List<Cand> existing = dp.get(key);\n                double bestCost = existing == null\n                        ? Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY : minCost(existing);\n\n                for (Cand cur : cands) {\n                    considered++;\n                    Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(mask, bit, cur.stats, rightScan.estimated, cross);\n                    double cost = cm.joinCost(cur.cost, rightScan.estimatedCost, s);\n                    if (cost > bestCost + 1e-9) continue;\n                    JoinNode j = new JoinNode(cur.plan, rightScan, edgeIds(cross));\n                    j.estimated = s;\n                    j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                    Cand c = new Cand(j, s, cost);\n                    if (cost < bestCost - 1e-9) {\n                        existing = new ArrayList<>();\n                        bestCost = cost;\n                    } else if (existing == null) {\n                        existing = new ArrayList<>();\n                        bestCost = cost;\n                    }\n                    boolean dup = false;\n                    for (Cand x : existing) {\n                        if (!statsDiffer(c.stats, x.stats)) { dup = true; break; }\n                    }\n                    if (!dup) existing.add(c);\n                }\n                if (existing != null) dp.put(key, existing);\n                bits ^= bit;\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<Cand> tops = dp.get(model.fullMask());\n        if (tops == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：左深规划失败\");\n        Cand top = tops.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : tops) {\n            if (c.cost < top.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - top.cost) <= 1e-9\n                        && c.stats.rowCount < top.stats.rowCount)) top = c;\n        }\n\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<Cand>> e : dp.entrySet()) {\n            Cand c = e.getValue().get(0);\n            memo.put(e.getKey(), new OptEntry(e.getKey(), c.plan, c.stats, c.cost));\n        }\n\n        Result r = new Result();\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        int[] cj = {0};\n        countCj(top.plan, cj);\n        r.cartesianJoins = cj[0];\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private List<Cand> mergeCands(List<Cand> a, List<Cand> b) {\n        // 两个来源到达同一 mask：保留较小代价集合里的统计不同候选\n        double ma = minCost(a), mb = minCost(b);\n        List<Cand> keep = ma <= mb ? a : b;\n        double min = Math.min(ma, mb);\n        List<Cand> r = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Cand c : keep) {\n            if (c.cost <= min + 1e-9) {\n                boolean dup = false;\n                for (Cand x : r) {\n                    if (!statsDiffer(c.stats, x.stats)) { dup = true; break; }\n                }\n                if (!dup) r.add(c);\n            }\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private double minCost(List<Cand> l) {\n        double m = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        for (Cand c : l) m = Math.min(m, c.cost);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private boolean statsDiffer(Stats a, Stats b) {\n        if (Math.abs(a.rowCount - b.rowCount) > 1e-9) return true;\n        if (!a.ndv.keySet().equals(b.ndv.keySet())) return true;\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Double> e : a.ndv.entrySet()) {\n            if (Math.abs(e.getValue() - b.ndv.get(e.getKey())) > 1e-9) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private List<Edge> edgesFromMaskToTable(int mask, int tableIdx) {\n        List<Edge> r = new ArrayList<>();\n        int bits = mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int bit = bits & -bits;\n            int other = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);\n            Edge e = model.edgeBetween(other, tableIdx);\n            if (e != null) r.add(e);\n            bits ^= bit;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private void countCj(PlanNode p, int[] c) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) c[0]++;\n            countCj(j.left, c);\n            countCj(j.right, c);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":73,"oldLines":33,"newStart":73,"newLines":26,"lines":["                 ScanNode rightScan = scans.get(bit);","                 List<Edge> cross = edgesFromMaskToTable(mask, ti);","                 int key = mask | bit;","-                List<Cand> existing = dp.get(key);","-                double bestCost = existing == null","-                        ? joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 暴力枚举：对每个表集合递归枚举“全部合法二叉计划”，求最小估计代价，与 DP 比对。\n *\n * 合法计划 = 任意把表集合分成两个非空子集，两侧各取任意合法子计划：\n *   有连接边 => 等值连接；无连接边 => 笛卡尔积。\n * 该空间完整覆盖稠密 DP 与左深 DP。计划数（仅按拓扑结构）按\n *   t(S) = Σ_{A 为 S 的真二分, A &lt; S\\\\A} t(A)·t(S\\\\A)\n * 递推：n=1..8 约为 1,1,3,15,105,945,10395,135135。\n *\n * 与优化器相同，子问题保留全部“(代价, 输出统计) 互不相同”的候选——不同 NDV\n * 会改变上层基数，只留单条最优会错误剪枝。得到的最小代价就是无剪枝的全空间答案；\n * 稠密 Optimizer 与之相等即证明其剪枝/去重没有损失最优值。\n */\npublic final class BruteForce {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(Stats stats, double cost) { this.stats = stats; this.cost = cost; }\n    }\n\n    private List<Cand>[] dp;\n    private long[] count;\n    private long totalTrees;\n    private long limit;\n    private boolean capped;\n\n    public BruteForce(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided, long maxTrees) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n        this.limit = maxTrees;\n    }\n\n    public static final class Report {\n        public boolean run;\n        public boolean capped;\n        public long planCount;\n        public double minCost;\n        public double topRows;\n        public int tables;\n        public List<String> optimalSplits = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public Report enumerate() {\n        int total = 1 << model.n();\n        dp = new List[total];\n        count = new long[total];\n        totalTrees = 0;\n        capped = false;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < model.n(); i++) {\n            int mask = 1 << i;\n            Stats s = Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            List<Cand> l = new ArrayList<>();\n            l.add(new Cand(s, cm.scanCost(s)));\n            dp[mask] = l;\n            count[mask] = 1;\n        }\n        for (int mask = 1; mask < total; mask++) solve(mask);\n\n        Report rep = new Report();\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        rep.run = !capped;\n        rep.capped = capped;\n        rep.planCount = totalTrees;\n        if (!capped) {\n            double min = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n            double rows = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n            for (Cand c : dp[full]) {\n                if (c.cost < min - 1e-9 || (Math.abs(c.cost - min) <= 1e-9 && c.stats.rowCount < rows)) {\n                    min = c.cost;\n                    rows = c.stats.rowCount;\n                }\n            }\n            rep.minCost = min;\n            rep.topRows = rows;\n            rep.tables = model.n();\n            rep.optimalSplits = traceOptimal(full, min);\n        }\n        return rep;\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private void solve(int mask) {\n        if (dp[mask] != null) return;\n        List<Cand> all = new ArrayList<>();\n        long cnt = 0;\n\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                solve(sub);\n                solve(rest);\n                if (capped) return;\n                for (Cand a : dp[sub]) {\n                    for (Cand b : dp[rest]) {\n                        Stats stats = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats,\n                                model.crossingEdges(sub, rest));\n                        double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, stats);\n                        boolean dup = false;\n                        for (Cand x : all) {\n                            if (Math.abs(x.cost - cost) <= 1e-9 && !statsDiffer(x.stats, stats)) {\n                                dup = true;\n                                break;\n                            }\n                        }\n                        if (!dup) all.add(new Cand(stats, cost));\n                    }\n                }\n                long ways = count[sub] * count[rest];\n                cnt += ways;\n                totalTrees += ways;\n                if (totalTrees > limit) { capped = true; return; }\n            }\n            sub = (sub - 1) & mask;\n        }\n        dp[mask] = all;\n        count[mask] = cnt;\n    }\n\n    private boolean statsDiffer(Stats a, Stats b) {\n        if (Math.abs(a.rowCount - b.rowCount) > 1e-9) return true;\n        if (!a.ndv.keySet().equals(b.ndv.keySet())) return true;\n        for (java.util.Map.Entry<String, Double> e : a.ndv.entrySet()) {\n            if (Math.abs(e.getValue() - b.ndv.get(e.getKey())) > 1e-9) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private List<String> traceOptimal(int mask, double minCost) {\n        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == 1) return out;\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                for (Cand a : dp[sub]) {\n                    for (Cand b : dp[rest]) {\n                        Stats stats = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats,\n                                model.crossingEdges(sub, rest));\n                        double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, stats);\n                        if (Math.abs(cost - minCost) <= 1e-6) {\n                            String label = names(sub) + \"  ⋈  \" + names(rest)\n                                    + (model.crossingEdges(sub, rest).isEmpty() ? \"  (笛卡尔积)\" : \"\");\n                            if (!out.contains(label)) out.add(label);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            sub = (sub - 1) & mask;\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private String names(int mask) {\n        List<String> l = new ArrayList<>();\n        int bits = mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int b = bits & -bits;\n            l.add(model.table(Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(b)).name);\n            bits ^= b;\n        }\n        return l.toString();\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_2dec52ec727606dae07c83fe","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1581,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":150328,"output_tokens":1877,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_htk1avbvv3zjh3l3evwzps94":{"content":"package java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 暴力枚举：对每个表集合递归枚举“全部合法二叉计划”，求最小估计代价，与 DP 比对。\n *\n * 合法计划 = 任意把表集合分成两个非空子集，两侧各取任意合法子计划：\n *   有连接边 => 等值连接；无连接边 => 笛卡尔积。\n * 该空间完整覆盖稠密 DP 与左深 DP。无序二叉计划数（仅按拓扑结构计）按\n *   t(S) = Σ_{A 为 S 的真二分, A &lt; S\\\\A} t(A)·t(S\\\\A)\n * 递推：n=1..8 约为 1,1,3,15,105,945,10395,135135。\n *\n * 最小代价用最优子结构（记忆化）求出——这是不做任何剪枝的朴素 DP；\n * 稠密 Optimizer 的剪枝是“分量内禁止笛卡尔积”，二者相等即证明该剪枝不改变最优值。\n */\npublic final class BruteForce {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    private double[] bestCost;\n    private Stats[] bestStats;\n    private long[] count;\n    private long totalTrees;\n    private long limit;\n    private boolean capped;\n\n    public BruteForce(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided, long maxTrees) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n        this.limit = maxTrees;\n    }\n\n    public static final class Report {\n        public boolean run;\n        public boolean capped;\n        public long planCount;\n        public double minCost;\n        public double topRows;\n        public int tables;\n        public List<String> optimalSplits = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public Report enumerate() {\n        int total = 1 << model.n();\n        bestCost = new double[total];\n        bestStats = new Stats[total];\n        count = new long[total];\n        totalTrees = 0;\n        capped = false;\n        java.util.Arrays.fill(bestCost, -1);\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < model.n(); i++) {\n            int mask = 1 << i;\n            Stats s = Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            bestCost[mask] = cm.scanCost(s);\n            bestStats[mask] = s;\n            count[mask] = 1;\n        }\n        double minCost = solve(model.fullMask());\n\n        Report rep = new Report();\n        rep.run = !capped;\n        rep.capped = capped;\n        rep.planCount = totalTrees;\n        rep.minCost = minCost;\n        rep.topRows = bestStats[model.fullMask()].rowCount;\n        rep.tables = model.n();\n        if (rep.run) rep.optimalSplits = traceOptimal(model.fullMask());\n        return rep;\n    }\n\n    /** 返回 mask 上的最小代价；记忆化保存对应统计；超上限即放弃。 */\n    private double solve(int mask) {\n        if (bestCost[mask] >= 0) return bestCost[mask];\n\n        double bc = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        Stats bs = null;\n        long cnt = 0;\n\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                double ca = solve(sub);\n                double cb = solve(rest);\n                if (capped) return Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n\n                Stats stats = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, bestStats[sub], bestStats[rest],\n                        model.crossingEdges(sub, rest));\n                double cost = cm.joinCost(ca, cb, stats);\n                if (cost < bc - 1e-9\n                        || (Math.abs(cost - bc) <= 1e-9\n                            && (bs == null || stats.rowCount < bs.rowCount))) {\n                    bc = cost;\n                    bs = stats;\n                }\n                long ways = count[sub] * count[rest];\n                cnt += ways;\n                totalTrees += ways;\n                if (totalTrees > limit) { capped = true; return Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY; }\n            }\n            sub = (sub - 1) & mask;\n        }\n        bestCost[mask] = bc;\n        bestStats[mask] = bs;\n        count[mask] = cnt;\n        return bc;\n    }\n\n    /** 列出顶层达到最优代价的全部二分（可读校验信息）。 */\n    private List<String> traceOptimal(int mask) {\n        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == 1) return out;\n        int sub = (mask - 1) & mask;\n        while (sub != 0) {\n            int rest = mask ^ sub;\n            if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                Stats stats = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, bestStats[sub], bestStats[rest],\n                        model.crossingEdges(sub, rest));\n                double cost = cm.joinCost(bestCost[sub], bestCost[rest], stats);\n                if (Math.abs(cost - bestCost[mask]) <= 1e-6) {\n                    out.add(names(sub) + \"  ⋈  \" + names(rest)\n                            + (model.crossingEdges(sub, rest).isEmpty() ? \"  (笛卡尔积)\" : \"\"));\n                }\n            }\n            sub = (sub - 1) & mask;\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private String names(int mask) {\n        List<String> l = new ArrayList<>();\n        int bits = mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int b = bits & -bits;\n            l.add(model.table(Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(b)).name);\n            bits ^= b;\n        }\n        return l.toString();\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"12ae7625-67d5-47f1-90de-90c4a123a847","session_id":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/a","sessionId":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-a","slug":"validated-singing-puddle"}

   static void bruteForceMatchesDpDisconnected() {\n        // 3 分量：a⋈b 相连，c、d 各自孤立（4 表）。\n        // 手算（a:100 ndv50, b:200 ndv50 => a⋈b=400；c:300；d:400）：\n        //   分量计划 Pab: scan100+scan200+join400=700\n        //   分量间全笛卡尔积，输出行数恒为 400*300*400=48_000_000；\n        //   最优合并顺序先合并两个小输入 (Pab ⋈ c=120000, 代价 700+300+120000=121000)，\n        //   再 ⋈d：121000+400+48_000_000 = 48_121_400。\n        B b = new B(\"disc-bf\")\n                .statsTable(\"a\", 100, \"a.k\", 50)\n                .statsTable(\"b\", 200, \"b.k\", 50)\n                .statsTable(\"c\", 300)\n                .statsTable(\"d\", 400)\n                .join(\"a.k\", \"b.k\");\n        Model m = b.model();\n        Optimizer.Result or = bushy(m, true);\n        BruteForce.Report rep = new BruteForce(m, new CostModel(m), true, 5_000_000).enumerate();\n        checkEq(rep.minCost, or.plan.estimatedCost, \"断开图：枚举最小值 == DP（分量合并顺序也最优）\");\n        checkEq(or.plan.estimatedCost, 48_121_400, \"断开图最优代价手算 48,121,400\");\n        check(or.cartesianJoins == 2, \"断开 3 分量计划含 2 个笛卡尔积节点\");\n    }","new_string":"    static void bruteForceMatchesDpDisconnected() {\n        // 3 分量：a⋈b 相连，c、d java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 单一 DP：dp[mask] = 表集合 mask 上代价最小的计划集合。枚举 mask 的全部非空真二分：\n *   二分跨越连接边 => 等值连接（使用该边上的全部谓词）；\n *   二分不跨越任何边 => 笛卡尔积。\n * 复杂度 O(3^n ·候选数²)，n<=8。\n *\n * 语义安全性：仅当二分不跨越任何连接边时才生成笛卡尔积节点，因此不会丢失谓词\n * （跨边的等值条件要么在两侧子树内部施加，要么在本次等值连接施加）。\n * 连接图的连通分量之间没有边，其顶层组合必然是笛卡尔积，计划中标记 cartesian=true；\n * 但连通分量“内部”的计划也可能包含一次降低总代价的中间笛卡尔积（此时该次分割\n * 同样不跨越任何边，语义合法）——这一可能性由全空间暴力枚举测试验证必须保留。\n *\n * 经典 System-R DP 只保留一个最小代价计划，但子计划的“边界列 NDV”会影响上层\n * 连接基数：根代价相同而 NDV 不同的两个计划，放到更大计划里优劣可能反转。\n * 因此每个子问题保留全部“最小代价（容差内）且输出统计互不相同”的候选，\n * 组合时遍历候选对（Pareto/interesting-order 思想的统计版本，n<=8 候选极少）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    /** 同代价候选集合中的一条。 */\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    private Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp;\n    private long considered;\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n        dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        considered = 0;\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            List<Cand> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            one.add(new Cand(scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n            dp.put(1 << i, one);\n        }\n\n        // 阶段1：稠密 DP。枚举每个表集合 target（>=2 表）的全部非空真二分：\n        //   有边跨越 => 等值连接；无边跨越 => 该次组合是笛卡尔积。\n        // 注意不能在“全局连通分量”内部禁止笛卡尔积：即使连接图整体连通，\n        // 最优计划也可能在中间步骤先做一次小规模笛卡尔积（本代价模型下经验证成立，\n        // 见 BruteForce 对 200+ 随机图的全空间枚举）。代价模型对笛卡尔积按行数\n        // 乘积计费，因此 DP 自然只会在其确实降低总代价时选择它。\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        for (int target = 1; target <= full; target++) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(target) < 2) continue;\n            List<Cand> all = new ArrayList<>();\n\n            int sub = (target - 1) & target;\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = target ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                    List<Cand> aList = dp.get(sub);\n                    List<Cand> bList = dp.get(rest);\n                    if (aList != null && bList != null) {\n                        List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                        for (Cand a : aList) {\n                            for (Cand b : bList) {\n                                considered++;\n                                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n                                double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                all.add(new Cand(j, s, cost));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n            }\n            if (!all.isEmpty()) dp.put(target, paretoPrune(all));\n        }\n\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n        // 阶段1已经允许任意二分（含分量间的笛卡尔积），因此整体最优已在 dp[full] 中；\n        // 这里不再需要独立的阶段2 DP——但仍保留分量信息用于告警与 cartesian 标记。\n        boolean disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n\n        List<Cand> topCands = dp.get(full);\n        if (topCands == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n        // 展示时取最小代价、最小根行数者\n        Cand top = topCands.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : topCands) {\n            if (c.cost < top.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - top.cost) <= 1e-9 && c.stats.rowCount < top.stats.rowCount)) {\n                top = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 导出 memo（每个子问题展示选中的代表条目）\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memoDump = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<Cand>> e : dp.entrySet()) {\n            Cand c = cheapest(e.getValue());\n            memoDump.put(e.getKey(), new OptEntry(e.getKey(), c.plan, c.stats, c.cost));\n        }\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memoDump;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = disconnected;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private Cand cheapest(List<Cand> cands) {\n        Cand best = (j==i+1)\n                : shape.equals(\"star\") ? (i==0) : false;\n            if (add){Map<String,Object> jj=new LinkedHashMap<>();List<Object> on=new ArrayList<>();\n                Map<String,Object> p=new LinkedHashMap<>();p.put(\"left\",\"t\"+i+\".c\"+j);p.put(\"right\",\"t\"+j+\".c\"+i);on.add(p);\n                jj.put(\"on\",on);joins.add(jj);}\n        }\n        req.put(\"joins\",joins);\n        Model m=Model.fromRequest(req);\n        Optimizer opt = new Optimizer(m,new CostModel(m),true);\n        long t0=System.nanoTime();\n        var r=opt.optimize();\n        long ms=(System.nanoTime()-t0)/1_000_000;\n        Field f=Optimizer.class.getDeclaredField(\"dp\"); f.setAccessible(true);\n        Map<?,?> dp=(Map<?,?>)f.get(opt);\n        int max=0; int argMax=0;\n        long totalCand=0;\n        for (var e: dp.entrySet()){int sz=((List<?>)e.getValue()).size(); totalCand+=sz; if(sz>max){max=sz;argMax=(Integer)e.getKey();}}\n        System.out.printf(\"%s n=%d edges=%d ms=%d considered=%d maxCand=%d @%s avgCand=%.1f%n\",\n            shape,n,m.edges.size(),ms,r.candidatesConsidered,max,Integer.toBinaryString(argMax),\n            totalCand/(double)dp.size());\n    }\n}\nEOF\njavac -cp build/classes -d /tmp /tmp/Perf2.java\nfor shape in chain star noedges; 组合时遍历候选对（Pareto/interesting-order 思想的统计版本，n<=8 候选极少）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    /** 同代价候选集合中的一条。 */\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    private Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp;\n    private long considered;\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n        dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        considered = 0;\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new scan.estimatedCost));\n            dp.put(1 << i, one);\n        }\n\n        // 阶段1：稠密 DP。枚举每个表集合 target（>=2 表）的全部非空真二分：\n        //   有边跨越 => 等值连接；无边跨越 => 该次组合是笛卡尔积。\n        // model.fullMask();\n        for (int target = 1; target <= full; target++) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(target) < 2) continue;\n            List<Cand> all = new ArrayList<>();\n\n            int cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n                                double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                all.add(new Cand(j, s, cost));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n            }\n            if (!all.isEmpty()) dp.put(target, paretoPrune(all));\n        }\n\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n        // 阶段1已经允许任意二分（含分量间的笛卡尔积），因此整体最优已在 dp[full] 中；\n        // 这里不再需要独立的阶段2 DP——但仍保留分量信息用于告警与 cartesian 标记。\n        boolean disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n\n        List<Cand> topCands = dp.get(full);\n        if (topCands == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n        // 展示时取最小代价、最小根行数者\n }\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memoDump;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = disconnected;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" cands.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : cands) {\n            if (c.cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9\n                        && c.stats.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) best = c;\n        }\n        return best;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 候选保留策略：不做 NDV 维度的支配剪枝——在 sel = 1/max(ndv) 的公式里，\n     * 自身列 NDV 变小既可能有利（自身是分母主导侧）也可能无利（对方主导），\n     * 不构成单调支配。因此只做两种安全缩减：\n     *   1) (累计代价, 完整输出统计) 完全相同 => 去重；\n     *   2) x 代价严格更低（>=1e-9）且输出行数严格更低时，x 是否支配 y 仍需 NDV 信息，\n     *      故这里也不采用。\n     * n<=8 时每子问题的候选数在我们的统计测试中为个位数到几十，\n     * O(3^n ·候选²) 完全可承受（8 表样例毫秒级）。\n     */\n    private List<Cand> paretoPrune(List<Cand> all) {\n        List<Cand> survivors = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Cand c : all) {\n            boolean dup = false;\n            for (Cand s : survivors) {\n                if (Math.abs(s.cost - c.cost) <= 1e-9 && !statsDiffer(s.stats, c.stats)) {\n                    dup = true;\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            if (!dup) survivors.add(c);\n        }\n        return survivors;\n    }\n\n    private boolean statsDiffer(Stats a, Stats b) {\n        if if (Math.abs(e.getValue() - b.ndv.get(e.getKey())) > 1e-9) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof }\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.Collections;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashSet;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.Set;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * dp[mask] = 表集合 mask 上的候选计划集合。枚举 mask 的全部非空真二分：\n *   二分跨越连接边 => 等值连接（使用该边上的全部谓词）；\n *   二分不跨越任何边 => 笛卡尔积。\n * 复杂度 O(3^n ·候选数²)，n<=8。\n *\n * 候选保留（正确性关键）：\n *   两个子计划根代价相同/相近但输出统计不同，放到更大的计划里可能优劣互换，\n *   因此经典“每子问题只留最小代价计划”是错的（本项目的随机图测试曾暴露该错误）。\n *   但只有“边界列”的 NDV 会影响该子计划之上的连接——边界列 = 出现在跨越 mask\n *   与外部表的连接边上、且属于 mask 一侧的列；内部列的 NDV 在 mask 之上的任何\n *   连接中都不会被读取。因此按“边界签名”（输出行数 + 各边界列 NDV）分组，\n *   每组只保留累计代价最小的候选。这既保证最优性，又把候选数压到 n<=8 可忽略。\n *\n * 语义安全性：仅当二分不跨越任何连接边时才生成笛卡尔积节点，等值谓词不会丢失\n * （跨边谓词要么在两侧子树内施加，要么在本次等值连接施加）。连接图的连通分量\n * 之间没有边，其最终组合必然是笛卡尔积，计划中标记 cartesian=true；连通分量\n * 内部的计划也可能包含降低总代价的中间笛卡尔积（该次分割同样不跨越任何边）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 边界签名：输出行数 + 各边界列 NDV（列按字典序排序后取值，保证相等判定确定）。 */\n    private static final class BoundarySig {\n        final double rows;\n        final double[] ndvs;\n        final int hash;\n\n        BoundarySig(Stats s, List<String> boundary) {\n            this.rows = s.rowCount;\n            this.ndvs = new double[boundary.size()];\n            for (int i = 0; i < boundary.size(); i++) {\n                ndvs[i] = s.ndv.getOrDefault(boundary.get(i), s.rowCount);\n            }\n            int h = Double.hashCode(rows);\n            for (double v : ndvs) h = 31 * h + Double.hashCode(v);\n            this.hash = h;\n        }\n\n        @Override public boolean equals(Object o) {\n            if (!(o instanceof BoundarySig)) return false;\n            BoundarySig b = (BoundarySig) o;\n            if (Math.abs(rows - b.rows) > 1e-9 || ndvs.length != b.ndvs.length) return false;\n            for (int i = 0; i < ndvs.length; i++) {\n                if (Math.abs(ndvs[i] - b.ndvs[i]) > 1e-9) return false;\n            }\n            return true;\n        }\n        @Override public int hashCode() { return hash; }\n    }\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public int maxCandidatesPerSubproblem;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n        Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        long considered = 0;\n\n        List<String>[] boundaryCols = computeBoundaryCols();\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            List<Cand> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            one.add(new Cand(scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n            dp.put(1 << i, one);\n        }\n\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        int maxCands = 1;\n        for (int target = 1; target <= full; target++) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(target) < 2) continue;\n            Map<BoundarySig, Cand> bestBySig = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n\n            int sub = (target - 1) & target;\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = target ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                    List<Cand> aList = dp.get(sub);\n                    List<Cand> bList = dp.get(rest);\n                    if (aList != null && bList != null) {\n                        List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                        for (Cand a : aList) {\n                            for (Cand b : bList) {\n                                considered++;\n                                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n                                double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                                BoundarySig sig = new BoundarySig(s, boundaryCols[target]);\n                                Cand cur = bestBySig.get(sig);\n                                if (cur == null || cost < cur.cost - 1e-9) {\n                                    JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n                                    j.estimated = s;\n                                    j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                    bestBySig.put(sig, new Cand(j, s, cost));\n                                }\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n            }\n            if (!bestBySig.isEmpty()) {\n                List<Cand> cands = new ArrayList<>(bestBySig.values());\n                dp.put(target, cands);\n                maxCands = Math.max(maxCands, cands.size());\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n        boolean disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n\n        List<Cand> topCands = dp.get(full);\n        if (topCands == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n        Cand top = cheapest(topCands);\n\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memoDump = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<Cand>> e : dp.entrySet()) {\n            Cand c = cheapest(e.getValue());\n            memoDump.put(e.getKey(), new OptEntry(e.getKey(), c.plan, c.stats, c.cost));\n        }\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memoDump;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = disconnected;\n        r.maxCandidatesPerSubproblem = maxCands;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 计算每个表集合的边界列：遍历每条连接边，边两端列分别加入各自端点所属的\n     * “包含该端点但不包含另一端点”的集合签名。实现上对 mask 逐个加入更直接：\n     * 对每条边 (u,v) 与每条 mask，若 mask 含 u 不含 v，则 u 侧列是 mask 的边界列。\n     */\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private List<String>[] computeBoundaryCols() {\n        int total = 1 << model.n();\n        Set<String>[] sets = new Set[total];\n        for (int m = 0; m < total; m++) sets[m] = new LinkedHashSet<>();\n        for (Edge e : model.edges) {\n            int ub = 1 << e.tableA, vb = 1 << e.tableB;\n            for (EqPredicate p : e.predicates) {\n                ColumnRef ca = p.columnOnSide(ub, model);\n                ColumnRef cb = p.columnOnSide(vb, model);\n                if (ca != null) addBoundary(sets, e.tableA, e.tableB, ca.canonical);\n                if (cb != null) addBoundary(sets, e.tableB, e.tableA, cb.canonical);\n            }\n        }\n        List<String>[] out = new List[total];\n        for (int m = 0; m < total; m++) {\n            List<String> l = new ArrayList<>(sets[m]);\n            Collections.sort(l);\n            out[m] = l;\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    /** 列 ownerCol（属于 owner 表）加入所有“含 owner 不含 other”的 mask 的边界集。 */\n    private void addBoundary(Set<String>[] sets, int owner, int other, String ownerCol) {\n        int ob = 1 << owner, xb = 1 << other;\n        int total = sets.length;\n        for (int m = 0; m < total; m++) {\n            if ((m & ob) != 0 && (m & xb) == 0) sets[m].add(ownerCol);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Cand cheapest(List<Cand> cands) {\n        Cand best = cands.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : cands) {\n            if (c.cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9\n                        && c.stats.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) best = c;\n        }\n        return best;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_a7f7ba7250b7236ae2752a77","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1704,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":156472,"output_tokens":2907,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_iwnowzsy96iyvxvc0mn3aaay":{"content":"package         JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;"]}],"originalFile":"package joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * 单一 DP：dp[mask] = 表集合 mask 上代价最小的计划集合。枚举 mask 的全部非空真二分：\n *   二分跨越连接边 => 等值连接（使用该边上的全部谓词）；\n *   二分不跨越任何边 => 笛卡尔积。\n * 复杂度 O(3^n ·候选数²)，n<=8。\n *\n * 语义安全性：仅当二分不跨越任何连接边时才生成笛卡尔积节点，因此不会丢失谓词\n * （跨边的等值条件要么在两侧子树内部施加，要么在本次等值连接施加）。\n * 连接图的连通分量之间没有边，其顶层组合必然是笛卡尔积，计划中标记 cartesian=true；\n * 但连通分量“内部”的计划也可能包含一次降低总代价的中间笛卡尔积（此时该次分割\n * 同样不跨越任何边，语义合法）——这一可能性由全空间暴力枚举测试验证必须保留。\n *\n * 经典 System-R DP 只保留一个最小代价计划，但子计划的“边界列 NDV”会影响上层\n * 连接基数：根代价相同而 NDV 不同的两个计划，放到更大计划里优劣可能反转。\n * 因此每个子问题保留全部“最小代价（容差内）且输出统计互不相同”的候选，\n * 组合时遍历候选对（Pareto/interesting-order 思想的统计版本，n<=8 候选极少）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    /** 同代价候选集合中的一条。 */\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- result\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    private Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp;\n    /** 每个表集合的“边界列”：出现在跨越该集合与外部表的连接边上的列规范名。 */\n    private List<String>[] boundaryCols;\n    private long considered;\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n        dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        considered = 0;\n\n        // 基表扫描\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            List<Cand> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            one.add(new Cand(scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n            dp.put(1 << i, one);\n        }\n\n        // 阶段1：稠密 DP。枚举每个表集合 target（>=2 表）的全部非空真二分：\n        //   有边跨越 => 等值连接；无边跨越 => 该次组合是笛卡尔积。\n        // 注意不能在“全局连通分量”内部禁止笛卡尔积：即使连接图整体连通，\n        // 最优计划也可能在中间步骤先做一次小规模笛卡尔积（本代价模型下经验证成立，\n        // 见 BruteForce 对 200+ 随机图的全空间枚举）。代价模型对笛卡尔积按行数\n        // 乘积计费，因此 DP 自然只会在其确实降低总代价时选择它。\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        for (int target = 1; target <= full; target++) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(target) < 2) continue;\n            List<Cand> all = new ArrayList<>();\n\n            int sub = (target - 1) & target;\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = target ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                    List<Cand> aList = dp.get(sub);\n                    List<Cand> bList = dp.get(rest);\n                    if (aList != null && bList != null) {\n                        List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                        for (Cand a : aList) {\n                            for (Cand b : bList) {\n                                considered++;\n                                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n                                double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                                JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n                                j.estimated = s;\n                                j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                                all.add(new Cand(j, s, cost));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n            }\n            if (!all.isEmpty()) dp.put(target, paretoPrune(all));\n        }\n\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n        // 阶段1已经允许任意二分（含分量间的笛卡尔积），因此整体最优已在 dp[full] 中；\n        // 这里不再需要独立的阶段2 DP——但仍保留分量信息用于告警与 cartesian 标记。\n        boolean disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n\n        List<Cand> topCands = dp.get(full);\n        if (topCands == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n        // 展示时取最小代价、最小根行数者\n        Cand top = topCands.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : topCands) {\n            if (c.cost < top.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - top.cost) <= 1e-9 && c.stats.rowCount < top.stats.rowCount)) {\n                top = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 导出 memo（每个子问题展示选中的代表条目）\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memoDump = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<Cand>> e : dp.entrySet()) {\n            Cand c = cheapest(e.getValue());\n            memoDump.put(e.getKey(), new OptEntry(e.getKey(), c.plan, c.stats, c.cost));\n        }\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memoDump;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = disconnected;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private Cand cheapest(List<Cand> cands) {\n        Cand best = cands.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : cands) {\n            if (c.cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9\n                        && c.stats.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) best = c;\n        }\n        return best;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 候选保留策略：不做 NDV 维度的支配剪枝——在 sel = 1/max(ndv) 的公式里，\n     * 自身列 NDV 变小既可能有利（自身是分母主导侧）也可能无利（对方主导），\n     * 不构成单调支配。因此只做两种安全缩减：\n     *   1) (累计代价, 完整输出统计) 完全相同 => 去重；\n     *   2) x 代价严格更低（>=1e-9）且输出行数严格更低时，x 是否支配 y 仍需 NDV 信息，\n     *      故这里也不采用。\n     * n<=8 时每子问题的候选数在我们的统计测试中为个位数到几十，\n     * O(3^n ·候选²) 完全可承受（8 表样例毫秒级）。\n     */\n    private List<Cand> paretoPrune(List<Cand> all) {\n        List<Cand> survivors = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Cand c : all) {\n            boolean dup = false;\n            for (Cand s : survivors) {\n                if (Math.abs(s.cost - c.cost) <= 1e-9 && !statsDiffer(s.stats, c.stats)) {\n                    dup = true;\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            if (!dup) survivors.add(c);\n        }\n        return survivors;\n    }\n\n    private boolean statsDiffer(Stats a, Stats b) {\n        if (Math.abs(a.rowCount - b.rowCount) > 1e-9) return true;\n        if (!a.ndv.keySet().equals(b.ndv.keySet())) return true;\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Double> e : a.ndv.entrySet()) {\n            if (Math.abs(e.getValue() - b.ndv.get(e.getKey())) > 1e-9) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) r.cartesianJoins++;\n            countCartesian(j.left, r);\n            countCartesian(j.right, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<Integer> edgeIds(List<Edge> cross) {\n        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Edge e : cross) ids.add(model.edges.indexOf(e));\n        return ids;\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"5e7c1252-1509-4839-b217-4abe51164eed","session_id":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/a","sessionId":"4217ffba-0ebb-4a20-afcf-898df781a397","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-a","slug":"validated-singing-puddle"}

java.util.Set;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * dp[mask] = 表集合 mask 上的候选计划集合。枚举 mask 的全部非空真二分：\n *   二分跨越连接边 => 等值连接（使用该边上的全部谓词）；\n *   二分不跨越任何边 => 笛卡尔积。\n * 复杂度 O(3^n ·候选数²)，n<=8。\n *\n * 之上的任何\n *   连接中都不会被读取。因此按“边界签名”（输出行数 + 各边界列 NDV）分组，\n *   每组只保留累计代价最小的候选。这既保证最优性，又把候选数压到 n<=8 可忽略。\n *\n * 语义安全性：仅当二分不跨越任何连接边时才生成笛卡尔积节点，等值谓词不会丢失\n * （跨边谓词要么在两侧子树内施加，要么在本次等值连接施加）。连接图的连通分量\n * 之间没有边，其最终组合必然是笛卡尔积，计划中标记 cartesian=true；连通分量\n * 内部的计划也可能包含降低总代价的中间笛卡尔积（该次分割同样不跨越任何边）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 边界签名：输出行数 + 各边界列 NDV（列按字典序排序后取值，保证相等判定确定）。 */\n    private static final class BoundarySig {\n        final double rows;\n        final double[] ndvs;\n        final int hash;\n\n        BoundarySig(Stats s, List<String> boundary) {\n            this.rows = s.rowCount;\n            this.ndvs = new double[boundary.size()];\n            for (int i = 0; i < boundary.size(); i++) {\n                ndvs[i] = s.ndv.getOrDefault(boundary.get(i), s.rowCount);\n            }\n            int h = Double.hashCode(rows);\n            for (double v : ndvs) h = 31 * h + Double.hashCode(v);\n            this.hash = h;\n        }\n\n        @Override public boolean equals(Object o) {\n            if (!(o instanceof BoundarySig)) return false;\n            BoundarySig b = (BoundarySig) o;\n            if (Math.abs(rows - b.rows) > 1e-9 || ndvs.length != b.ndvs.length) return false;\n            for (int i = 0; i < ndvs.length; i++) {\n                if (Math.abs(ndvs[i] - b.ndvs[i]) > 1e-9) return false;\n            }\n            return true;\n        }\n        @Override public int hashCode() { return hash; }\n    }\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src public int maxCandidatesPerSubproblem;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n        Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        long considered = 0;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                        for (Cand a : aList) {\n                            for (Cand b : bList) {\n                                considered++;\n                                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n                                double cost = cm.joinCost(a.cost, b.cost, s);\n                                BoundarySig sig = new BoundarySig(s, boundary);\n                                Cand cur = bestBySig.get(sig);\n                                if (cur == null || cost < cur.cost - 1e-9) {\n                                    JoinNode j = new JoinNode(a.plan, b.plan, edgeIds(cross));\n                                    j.estimated = s;\n                                    j.estimatedCost = }\n                }\n                sub = (sub - 1) & target;\n            }\n            if (!bestBySig.isEmpty()) {\n                List<Cand> cands = new ArrayList<>(bestBySig.values());\n                dp.put(target, cands);\n                maxCands = Math.max(maxCands, cands.size());\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<int[]> comps = model.components();\n        boolean disconnected = comps.size() > 1;\n\n        List<Cand> topCands = dp.get(full);\n        if (topCands == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：未能生成完整查询计划\");\n        Cand top = cheapest(topCands);\n\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memoDump = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<Cand>> e : dp.entrySet()) {\n            Cand c = cheapest(e.getValue());\n            memoDump.put(e.getKey(), new OptEntry(e.getKey(), c.plan, c.stats, c.cost));\n        }\n\n        countCartesian(top.plan, r);\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memoDump;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        r.connectedComponents = comps.size();\n        r.disconnected = disconnected;\n        r.maxCandidatesPerSubproblem = maxCands;\n        if (r.disconnected) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] c : comps) {\n                List<String> tn = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (int i : c) tn.add(model.table(i).name);\n                names.add(tn.toString());\n            }\n            r.warnings.add(\"连接图不连通，检测到 \" + comps.size() + \" 个连通分量 \" + names\n                    + \"；分量之间没有等值条件，将以笛卡尔积连接（计划中已标记 cartesian=true）\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private Cand cheapest(List<Cand> cands) {\n        Cand best = cands.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : cands) {\n            if (c.cost < best.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - best.cost) <= 1e-9\n                        && c.stats.rowCount < best.stats.rowCount)) best = c;\n        }\n        return best;\n    }\n\n    private void countCartesian(PlanNode p, Result r) {\n        if (p instanceof JoinNode) {\n            JoinNode j = (JoinNode) p;\n            if (j.edgeIds.isEmpty()) java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 稠密（bushy）连接顺序动态规划优化器。\n *\n * dp[mask] = 表集合 mask 上的候选计划集合。枚举 mask 的全部非空真二分：\n *   二分跨越连接边 => 等值连接（使用该边上的全部谓词）；\n *   二分不跨越任何边 => 笛卡尔积。\n * 复杂度 O(3^n ·候选数²)，n<=8。\n *\n * 候选保留（正确性关键）：\n *   两个子计划根代价相同/相近但输出统计不同，放到更大的计划里可能优劣互换，\n *   因此经典“每子问题只留最小代价计划”是错的（本项目的随机图测试曾暴露该错误）。\n *   但只有“边界列”的 NDV 会影响该子计划之上的连接——边界列 = 出现在跨越 mask\n *   与外部表的连接边上、且属于 mask 一侧的列；内部列的 NDV 在 mask 之上的任何\n *   连接中都不会被读取。因此按“边界签名”（输出行数 + 各边界列 NDV）分组，\n *   每组只保留累计代价最小的候选。这既保证最优性，又把候选数压到 n<=8 可忽略。\n *\n * 语义安全性：仅当二分不跨越任何连接边时才生成笛卡尔积节点，等值谓词不会丢失\n * （跨边谓词要么在两侧子树内施加，要么在本次等值连接施加）。连接图的连通分量\n * 之间没有边，其最终组合必然是笛卡尔积，计划中标记 cartesian=true；连通分量\n * 内部的计划也可能包含降低总代价的中间笛卡尔积（该次分割同样不跨越任何边）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 边界签名：输出行数 + 各边界列 NDV（列按字典序排序后取值，保证相等判定确定）。 */\n    private static final class BoundarySig {\n        final double rows;\n        final double[] ndvs;\n        final int hash;\n\n        BoundarySig(Stats s, List<String> boundary) {\n            this.rows = s.rowCount;\n            this.ndvs = new double[boundary.size()];\n            for (int i = 0; i < boundary.size(); i++) {\n                ndvs[i] = s.ndv.getOrDefault(boundary.get(i), s.rowCount);\n            }\n            int h = Double.hashCode(rows);\n            for (double v : ndvs) h = 31 * h + Double.hashCode(v);\n            this.hash = h;\n        }\n\n        @Override public boolean equals(Object o) {\n            if (!(o instanceof BoundarySig)) return false;\n            BoundarySig b = (BoundarySig) o;\n            if (Math.abs(rows - b.rows) > 1e-9 || ndvs.length != b.ndvs.length) return false;\n            for (int i = 0; i < ndvs.length; i++) {\n                if (Math.abs(ndvs[i] - b.ndvs[i]) > 1e-9) return false;\n            }\n            return true;\n        }\n        @Override public int hashCode() { return hash; }\n    }\n\n    public Optimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    public static Stats baseStats(Model model, int idx, boolean useProvided) {\n        Table t = model.table(idx);\n        Stats src = useProvided && t.providedStats != null ? t.providedStats : t.actualStats;\n        return src.copy();\n    }\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n        public int connectedComponents;\n        public boolean disconnected;\n        public int maxCandidatesPerSubproblem;\n        public List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public Result optimize() {\n        Result r = new Result();\n        int n = model.n();\n        Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        long considered = 0;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            List<Cand> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            one.add(new Cand(scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n            dp.put(1 << i, one);\n        }\n\n        int full = model.fullMask();\n        int maxCands = 1;\n        for (int target = 1; target <= full; target++) {\n            if (Integer.bitCount(target) < 2) continue;\n            List<String> boundary = model.boundaryColumns(target);\n            Map<BoundarySig, Cand> bestBySig = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n\n            int sub = (target - 1) & target;\n            while (sub != 0) {\n                int rest = target ^ sub;\n                if (rest != 0 && sub < rest) {\n                    List<Cand> aList = dp.get(sub);\n                    List<Cand> bList = dp.get(rest);\n                    if (aList != null && bList != null) {\n                        List<Edge> cross = model.crossingEdges(sub, rest);\n                        for (Cand a : aList) {\n                            for (Cand b : bList) {\n                                considered++;\n                                Stats s = cm.estimateJoin(sub, rest, a.stats, b.stats, cross);\n                                double cost joinorder;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 左深连接顺序优化器（对照基线）。\n *\n * 状态 = */\npublic final class LeftDeepOptimizer {\n\n    private final Model model;\n    private final CostModel cm;\n    private final boolean useProvided;\n\n    public LeftDeepOptimizer(Model model, CostModel cm, boolean useProvided) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cm = cm;\n        this.useProvided = useProvided;\n    }\n\n    private static final class Cand {\n        final PlanNode plan;\n        final Stats stats;\n        final double cost;\n        Cand(PlanNode plan, Stats stats, double cost) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n            this.cost = cost;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static final class Result {\n        public PlanNode plan;\n        public Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo;\n        public long candidatesConsidered;\n        public int cartesianJoins;\n    }\n\n    public Result optimize() {\n        int n = model.n();\n        int total = 1 << n;\n        Map<Integer, List<Cand>> dp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        Map<Integer, ScanNode> scans = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        long considered = 0;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Stats s = Optimizer.baseStats(model, i, useProvided);\n            ScanNode scan = new ScanNode(i);\n            scan.estimated = s;\n            scan.estimatedCost = cm.scanCost(s);\n            scans.put(1 << i, scan);\n            List<Cand> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            one.add(new Cand(scan, s, scan.estimatedCost));\n            dp.put(1 << i, one);\n        }\n\n        for (int mask = 1; mask < total; mask++) {\n            List<Cand> cands = dp.get(mask);\n            if (cands == null) continue;\n            int remaining = model.fullMask() ^ mask;\n            int bits = remaining;\n  List<Edge> cross = edgesFromMaskToTable(mask, ti);\n                int key = mask | bit;\n                List<Cand> target = dp.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>());\n\n                for cm.joinCost(cur.cost, rightScan.estimatedCost, s);\n                    JoinNode j = new JoinNode(cur.plan, rightScan, edgeIds(cross));\n                    j.estimated = s;\n                    j.estimatedCost = cost;\n                    Cand c = new Cand(j, s, cost);\n                    // 仅对“同代价且完整统计相同”去重；不同代价/统计全部保留\n                    boolean dup = false;\n                    for              }\n                    }\n                    if (!dup) target.add(c);\n                }\n                bits ^= bit;\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<Cand> tops = dp.get(model.fullMask());\n        if (tops == null) throw new EngineException(\"内部错误：左深规划失败\");\n        Cand top = tops.get(0);\n        for (Cand c : tops) {\n            if (c.cost < top.cost - 1e-9\n                    || (Math.abs(c.cost - top.cost) <= 1e-9\n                        && c.stats.rowCount < top.stats.rowCount)) top = c;\n        }\n\n        Map<Integer, OptEntry> memo = new c.stats, c.cost));\n        }\n\n        Result r = new Result();\n        r.plan = top.plan;\n        r.memo = memo;\n        r.candidatesConsidered = considered;\n        int[] cj = {0};\n        countCj(top.plan, cj);\n        r.cartesianJoins = cj[0];\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private boolean statsDiffer(Stats a, Stats b) {\n        if (Math.abs(a.rowCount - b.rowCount) > 1e-9) return mask;\n        while (bits != 0) {\n            int bit = bits & -bits;\n            int other = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bit);\n            Edge e = model.edgeBetween(other, tableIdx);\n
